review_text: I stayed here for 4 times and will keep staying here for the next times. Staff are super friendly and supportive. Clean room, lift is available and big space for parking. Wi-Fi is good enough for my personal needs.
The receptionist named Linh was so friendly and supportive. It was a nice and cozy experience.

Wonderful! Highly recommended! You should definitely experience REY. The staff are super enthusiastic and lovely, the rooms are beautiful, clean, spacious, and we absolutely loved it. We will definitely come back next time. Thank you REY for giving our family a wonderful vacation.

This hotel is highly recommended. The rooms are comfortable, the mattresses are soft, and everything works perfectly. The amenities are complete, including a water heater. The service is excellent, and the staff are friendly and responsive.
The hotel is in a very central location, easy to move to attractions, Very clean, from public spaces to rooms. Staff were friendly and enthusiastic.

hotel_name: Dolce by Wyndham Hanoi Golden Lake
review_text: I was very pleased with my wonderful experience at the hotel. The service was truly professional and attentive. The facilities were modern and luxurious, creating a relaxing atmosphere. The meals were delicious and varied, leaving a lasting impression. I will definitely return and recommend it to my friends.
Very good hotel, clean, strategic location, helpful staff. Also good breakfast taste & menu

hotel_name: The Bloom Classic - An Excellent Blend of Cozy Living and Urban Relaxation
review_text: The unit is absolutely stunning. It's a one-bedroom apartment, but it's very spacious and comfortable. The location is far from the Old Quarter, but the neighborhood is quiet and safe. Breakfast is served per person. There's not a wide variety, but the portions and taste are quite good. The restaurant staff are very friendly and helpful.
Great service, great staff. Very friendly. Outstanding room. Best hotel experience. Thank you, Annie.
Everything was absolutely fantastic. Impeccable cleanliness, lots of useful amenities, a beautiful room design, and amazing city views at night.
The location is close to places to eat, just walk, the rooms are comfortable and clean

The staff were incredibly friendly and accommodating, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The room was beautiful, spacious, and impeccably clean - truly a comfortable and relaxing place to stay. We had a wonderful experience and would gladly return.

hotel_name: Signature By M Village Tho Nhuom
review_text: More contemporary than other hotels I stayed in Hanoi. Has everything you need. The room's very clean and the bed is comfortable. There are plenty of restaurants around. 15 minutes walk to the old quarter. I am very happy with my stay there. Highly recommended especially for those from western countries.
The hotel is so good and the staff were friendly. Hung is really helpful for our check-in and check-out.

hotel_name: InterContinental Hotels HANOI WESTLAKE by IHG
review_text: Spacious room, clean, good service staff. Air conditioner in the room is difficult to adjust so the room is a bit cold. Breakfast is ok.
Melia Ba Vi is a great place to rest if you need a retreat from your busy life. Room and service are good, however dinner does not have many options and is a bit boring.

Stayed there based on friend’s recommendation and it didn’t disappoint. Location by the busy road but it was quiet in the room. Only 1km walk to busy old quarter area. Many food stalls nearby. Front desk staffs are all friendly and helpful. Breakfast was great! I would recommend this hotel and will definitely come back.
Fully equipped hotel, good service, close to tourist attractions. Enthusiastic and friendly staff!

Good service, clean room, enthusiastic staff. The only minus point is that there is no green campus, the hotel lobby is too small, there is not much experience. Overall rating 3/5 stars. Worth recommending to those who like modern and new room space.
I am very satisfied with the hotel service. The receptionists are very enthusiastic, especially Hanh and Long took good care of me. This is a hotel worth experiencing. I will come back here.
The hotel is located in the center, convenient for walking, convenient for eating and drinking around, clean, tidy and fragrant rooms. Next time I come to Hanoi, I will come here again.
Nice room, clean, great swimming pool

The location is incredibly convenient for visiting attractions, very easy to find, the staff are friendly, the rooms are clean and well-equipped. My family had a wonderful vacation in Hanoi. Thank you to the hotel for the excellent support. We will definitely return to this hotel if we have the opportunity to visit Hanoi again in the future.
The staff here I am very satisfied, convenient for travel, reasonable price, clean and beautiful rooms ..

Friendly staff at the reception, arrived earlier than check-in time, allowed early check-in without additional charges, the room condition is clean and according to the photo, thank you for the service.
I will stay here again when I am in Hanoi. The staffs are friendly, the room was super clean, and very comfortable.

The hotel has a beautiful view, quite ok facilities, enthusiastic and polite staff, very delicious and varied breakfast! However, the food in the room is limited (only Western dishes, no Vietnamese dishes), I hope the resort will soon add a menu to the menu for variety. Another small suggestion is that each villa should have an outdoor dining table with a roof so that families can eat privately and more cleanly! Currently, there is only a small tea table that does not meet the needs, eating in the room is inconvenient! 🥰
Excellent service. Clean and tidy room. Best hotel in Thanh Xuan district. I will come back.
I have never seen a hotel with such good service as here. The staff are polite, kind, and enthusiastic. Next time I come to Hanoi, I will continue to rent here.

The hotel is comfortable, clean, and strategically located near Hoan Kiem Lake. There are plenty of restaurants nearby. The staff is also friendly and helpful, recommending local attractions and tours during your stay in Hanoi.
The hotel is suitable for a stay in Hanoi, located near the center of the lakeside, near the amusement parks. Hotel staff are enthusiastic and friendly
The room is small but clean and beautiful. Right in the center, walking distance to the lake. Staff are very friendly and enthusiastic. I will come back when I come to Hanoi.

A pleasant stay experience! The hotel staff are friendly, have good English skills, and provide clear explanations. The hotel is clean and well-equipped, with laundry facilities, complete amenities, and a dining area available. I will definitely stay here again when I visit Hanoi.

hotel_name: Blue Sky Noi Bai Hotel & Pool
review_text: Since we were close to the airport and had an early departure, they started breakfast earlier than usual and provided a free shuttle to the airport. What great service.
The service was excellent, with each guest treated with kindness and sincerity. I left my luggage for two nights, and they happily accepted it. Excellent!

hotel_name: Le Grand Hanoi hotel – The Sun
review_text: Free minibar including instant noodles and soft drinks, that was excellent service. They gave me a free upgraded room. This is the newly renovated hotel. The location is in the center that is opposite La Thanh Station. Good for business trips and couples.
Very friendly staff, clean and comfortable room. I felt very comfortable and would happily recommend the hotel! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

The uncles and staff here are very enthusiastic and cheerful, especially the receptionist Anh. Rooms are clean. The hotel is convenient for traveling around the old town. If I have the opportunity to return to Hanoi, I will still choose to stay here
Professional airport shuttle service as well as great breakfast + fully equipped and luxurious high-class interior facilities.
Great place, have very good facilities, staffs are very cooperative, also near to city.
Stayed there for one night. It was awesome. Everything is exactly as it should be, Japanese style hotel, clean & spacious. Recommended
Spacious 2 bed room for 3 people, with a balcony overlooking the Mariot hotel is quite open. Clean, comfortable room.

hotel_name: Le Grand Hanoi Hotel - The Oriental
review_text: The room is spacious, beautiful, clean, with free food and drinks in the room / I have been to many 3-4 star hotels but have never stayed in a hotel with such free services for guests, so I am very happy. If you are hungry at night, you can have free cup noodles with snacks in the room. There is free underground parking. Will definitely come back. Central location in Cau Giay district, convenient for business trips.
Nice, spacious, and clean room with an excellent environment, good breakfast, and helpful staff. Surely, I'll return if I'm coming back to Ha Noi in the future.
The room is clean, beautiful, spacious, with airy bancol. Enthusiastic, cute staff, flexible solutions
Clean room, convenient to move, very enthusiastic support, a great place to stay.
The room is small but fully equipped and clean. It's very convenient on Giai Phong street😁
Polite and gentle staff, clean hotel!

I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel. The room was very clean, spacious, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The staff at the front desk were extremely friendly and always willing to help. The location is great too—it’s close to many popular attractions, restaurants, and cafes, which made exploring the city super easy. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting the old quarter!

The room is clean, the staff is enthusiastic, the electricity and water are both very strong so the voltage is very stable. The location is right on the dining street so it is suitable for food enthusiasts. If I have a chance to go to Hanoi, I will stop by again
Outstanding customer service, receptionist friendly and professional. Worth the experience for the price paid.
Best place to stay in Ha Noi, home very welcoming and the place is neat and tidy and clean, kitchen full equipped, a washer for convenient! Perfect place thank you Crescendo!

The hotel is in the center of West Street, so everything is complete and convenient, there are many restaurants. Beautiful rooms. I went to Hanoi on a business trip at 2am, but the staff still warmly welcomed me and helped me carry my luggage to my room. I asked to book a taxi, the reception also enthusiastically supported. If I have a chance, I will come back.

The hotel is adjacent to the airport. Can walk Depart from Hanoi Airport Turn right at the fence. Value for money, there is a shuttle to the airport and breakfast is a watermelon banana, bread, tea and coffee.
The hotel is great, the toilet area is very well designed, the room is spacious, new and clean. Will stay again on the next trip.

I booked a sup room but because I went in the peak season, I ran out of rooms and was upgraded to a vip room. Everything is very satisfactory, the hotel is clean, safe and the reception is also very friendly. I like the layout in the room from the floor to the very complete and beautiful items. Will definitely come back if the opportunity arises.
Friendly staff. Always available.
Hotel is very nice and clean. I've been here twice and I think every time I return to Hanoi I have to come back here to stay comfortably forever

hotel_name: New Sky Airport Hotel Noi Bai
review_text: The staffs are friendly and helpful. We can check out at any time, the hotel is very clean and smells good. Very near to the airport so we are not afraid of missing our flights.
2 super enthusiastic + friendly staff. The staff are very supportive and super lovely. A big plus for the 2 staff here. The room is clean, comfortable, and the bathtub is comfortable.

The best hotel out of all my stay in Vietnam. Very friendly and helpful staff, even helped us communicate with our tour guides and recommended restaurants. The room was spacious and clean. Location is close to lots of restaurants and cute shops. Would return next time I visit Hanoi for sure.
The room is spacious and quite clean, the staff is enthusiastic and attentive
This is my second time staying at this brand new hotel. The service and facilities are excellent.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Had a wonderful stay here! The staff were friendly and welcoming from the moment we checked in. The rooms were all good and the bed was very comfortable.

I had a 3-night business trip in Hanoi and stayed at Marina Hotel. Its location is perfect for soaking up the daily Hanoi vibe. You can have a short walk around Hoan Kiem Lake in the morning and enjoy the different dishes in the old quarter late at night. The receptionist is friendly and helpful.
Great staff, the service of Metropole staff is the best in all 5 star hotels I have been to, very attentive, very enthusiastic, quick check out, no time wasted. Good quality breakfast.
I had a great stay here. Friendly, cheerful staff. Nice, clean room.

What a wonderful experience at a homestay in Hanoi! The space is clean, cozy and very delicately decorated. Convenient location, close to the center but still quiet. Friendly, handsome, attentive and enthusiastic staff. I am really satisfied and will definitely come back next time ❤️
I am satisfied with the room and style of the hotel, the receptionist and hotel staff are all enthusiastic and polite, I will come again next time🤗
Nice room, lots of places to eat around, clean hotel and room, very comfortable.

The Hotel very clean, the staff very helpful and friendly. I’ve stayed twice and Love it 🥰 
Very recommended. When I come again to Hanoi I will stay here again.  And I I would like to say Thank you for the Hotel because given the breakfast take away 🙏🙏
Friendly reception, quick check in, clean and fragrant room
Breakfast very tasty, location too convenient for walking

The new hotel is very clean and beautiful! The view is very open to the Nhat Tan peach gardens, and in the distance is the Red River. The breakfast is also very delicious. Worth the money spent for a new experience far from the noisy, crowded inner city!

hotel_name: Paragon Noi Bai Hotel and Pool
review_text: The staff is extremely friendly and enthusiastic. There are many shops around, the location is very close to the airport, it takes about 5-7 minutes by car. The room is spacious and clean. In general, 10 points, I will come back next time.
Good service, breakfast delivered to room was thoughtful and delicious
The bed is very comfortable and spacious, the staff is friendly and very helpful, thank you. One more thing, there is an elevator 😁
Clean hotel, beautifully decorated, harmonious layout, polite and enthusiastic staff, helpful when guests need. Convenient location.
Excellent service—all the staff speak English. Perfect location in the heart of the Old Quarter, just steps away from many popular restaurants and coffee shops

Absolutely a great stay at Aurora Premium Hotel. We booked two rooms, and both were cozy and clean, with good water quality too.

The location is perfect – right in the Old Quarter, within walking distance to many shops and tourist attractions.

Their breakfast was nice, and I loved that they served pho every day – my comfort food while in Vietnam.

The staff were extremely friendly, which made us feel welcome.

We even decided to book again after our two-day trip to Sapa, staying here for a total of four room nights. Definitely a place we’d return to next time!

Staff were friendly and enthusiastic. The room is spacious and clean. If I have the opportunity to return to Hanoi, I will continue to choose to stay here and recommend it to my friends to experience.
Room is as pictured. Quite clean and hotel staff is very enthusiastic.
Location near everything, good breakfast, clean rooms, staff very friendly and helpful. I was very satisfied with my stay here.
Can't wait for such a reasonable price, clean rooms, friendly staff, a great experience

hotel_name: A25 Premium Hotel - 15 Tran Quoc Toan
review_text: The reception was very polite and professional. The room was well stocked, branded soap and toothpaste not the low quality hotel stuff.

hotel_name: CiBi Homes - Hanoi Central Living Space
review_text: The staff were friendly, and the homestay gave us great local tips that really helped us explore the old town
Overall, my stay at VnaHomes was very good. The room was clean and comfortable, and the service provided was satisfactory. I had a pleasant experience and truly appreciate your hospitality.

It was an amazing experience during stay at Galaxy. At the first time while check in, got welcome very friendly and helpful from the owner. The owner helped me to guide to the room and explain regarding the room and help me for order taxi to go to airport. The room is clean and wide and also the bathroom. If I go to Hanoi, I will stay again at Galaxy. The location is very strategic to get food.

The hotel is close to many places and commercial centers, many dining areas, spacious bedrooms, fully equipped for an apartment, I booked a standard room but arrived late and the hotel upgraded to my room. the apartment is more spacious and comfortable, the room has windows and the view is very chill, the bathroom and stuff are all new, feel comfortable staying here, next time I will come back

I've been here several times in the past year, but this time I was surprised to come back because the rooms have been completely redesigned and are completely beautiful and cleaner. The service is good and the staff is very friendly to guests. Will come back again 👍

hotel_name: Cong Doan Viet Nam Hotel Hanoi
review_text: Convenient location, clean room, good price.

Every hotel staff that we interacted with was unfailingly friendly and helpful. The level of service was unparalleled. Special mention to Ms. Sabrina who helped us to check in, book a spa session, and even to cross the road to get to our Grab hired car. The location is ideal. The weekend night market is literally at the doorstep of the hotel, Hoan Kiem Lake is just 2 minutes' walk away, and all the major Old Quarter shopping streets are within a short walking distance. The room was clean and well appointed, making for a comfortable stay during our five days in Hanoi. We would definitely recommend Oriental Suites Hotel to travelers looking to stay in the Old Quarter.
Excellent service from Emily and Ivy! And a great experience overall as usual!

hotel_name: HB Serviced Apartment - Lac Long Quan
review_text: Convenient location near the entertainment center, especially the room is very clean and fully equipped. I will come back here every time I come to Hanoi

I had an amazing stay at this hotel! The staff were extremely friendly, professional, and always willing to help with anything I needed. The room was very clean, spacious, and comfortable, with all the amenities I could ask for. The location is also perfect—close to many attractions, restaurants, and shops, yet still quiet and relaxing.

hotel_name: La Sinfonia del Rey Hotel and Spa
review_text: Location! Location! Location! It's centre of the centre and near everything. The hotel is new, luxury with exceptional customer service. Breakfast is delicious, not too many choices like other big hotels, but all choices are very good, especially their daily soup and homemade juice. Make sure to have a drink in their roof top bar and you can have the full view of Hoan Kiem Lake.

I had a wonderful stay at Hotel Minerva Church in Hanoi. The service was excellent—staff were friendly, attentive, and always willing to help. A special thanks to the receptionist, Lili, who was incredibly kind and made our check-in process smooth and pleasant. She also kindly assisted us in booking a taxi for our airport transfer the next morning, which made everything much easier for us. Overall, a very comfortable and enjoyable experience. Highly recommended!

The accommodation is close to famous tourist attractions in Hanoi, so it is quite close to travel. Breakfast is also quite delicious and diverse. The hotel staff is also quite enthusiastic. The room rate is also very good compared to the location and services. Next time I return to Hanoi, I will come back to stay here again.

If you are looking for the perfect place to stay in Hanoi, I highly recommend this hotel. It offers not only comfort and convenience, but also an experience that captures the best of Vietnamese hospitality.

hotel_name: Le Grand Hanoi hotel – The Tryst
review_text: The hotel is close to the center, very convenient for travel, entertainment, and dining. Clean room, ok equipment
Great view, reasonable price, air conditioning is a bit weak, if it's too hot you can borrow a fan from the reception.
Clean and affordable price. Just far away from Noi Bai International Airport.

Excellent service from the staff. Special shout-out to Mr. Trung for being extremely helpful in contacting the driver for our airport transfer on our behalf. Following the call, he also took extra care to ensure that we were able to get on and not miss our flight back. Thank you for the pleasant experience at M Village!
The room is clean and has basic amenities. Staff are very enthusiastic and supportive.
The room is big, clean, I booked many rooms because I had to go to Hanoi to take an exam once a month, this room is the best and has many facilities 🌞
Lovely staff. Spacious and clean room.
The hotel is clean, the location is good, the staff is enthusiastic and polite

I stayed here for 3 nights, the room was clean, fully equipped (there was a convenient washer and dryer for short-term guests like me, a microwave, a rice cooker and other necessary items), I interacted with the receptionists Hoang Anh, Liem and Viet. What they have in common is that they spoke politely, gently, and were always willing to introduce me to places to visit in Hanoi very enthusiastically, making me feel comfortable and friendly like at home. I would like to thank Moonlight in general and the 3 receptionists Hoang Anh, Liem and Viet in particular.
The staff were friendly. The room amenities were excellent and the room was spotlessly clean. The location is very convenient for visiting attractions and exploring the old town.

Very recommend hotel if you stay in hanoi. honestly receptionist very helpful especially his name DAVID.. thank you for hospitality, soon I will go back to stay in epic tower swiss-belresidences hanoi
Stayed in the family room which is spacious and has a bathtub. All of my kids are very happy. The breakfast was also good. The staff was also friendly and helpful. It's a nice stay.

hotel_name: Charming Moon Hotel - Hanoi Old Quarter
review_text: Charming Moon is an amazing hotel. It's amazing in the middle of Old Quarter, amazing vibes in the evening. Mr. Jay, the reception staff, is very friendly and caring always. He guides on shopping places and other transportation-related queries. Overall, we were a group of 12 people, we really enjoyed staying here in this hotel. We highly recommend this hotel for all travelers looking to have an amazing stay at an affordable cost in the middle of the Old Quarter.
friendly service, clean and airy
Very good hotel facility as well as location, room is clean, staff friendly.
The staff are very friendly, and try to make the guests as comfortable as possible, it was a pleasure to stay at this hotel.
The hotel room is like a mini apartment, check-in is like the photo, full of appliances: kitchen counter, microwave, refrigerator, steam iron, washing machine... very convenient for long trips.

ONE OF THE BEST HOTEL SERVICE, THE ROOM IS COMPLETE EVERYTHING EVEN TO SHAMPOO ETC. VERY SATISFACTORY, ESPECIALLY THE FOOD I CONSIDER THIS IS ONE OF THE HOTELS WITH THE BEST BREAKFAST I HAVE EVER FOUND. If I go to Hanoi again I will choose this hotel again.
Very satisfied, clean hotel, delicious food, friendly staff, will definitely come back

The staff is English speaking and the hotel is at a very good location with walking distance to all night good cafes, shopping streets, or the infamous train street! The staff is very accommodating and they even have a free jacuzzi to relax after a tired and hot day!

The room is very fitting but also comfortable.
Very good service by Hotel Staff.
Linh and Alex, thank you for helping me during this holiday.

I will definitely come back to this hotel if I go back to Hanoi
Clean, wide. Comfortable, friendly.

The room is quiet while still close to the city center, just a short ride away. Staff is very nice, an old lady and her husband sharing their house space. They took me in even though my flight was delayed and I arrived past midnight.
Clean hotel, airy space, enthusiastic staff, professional spa, soft bed, beautifully decorated rooms, worth the experience
The room is very clean, the price is so cheap and the staff is extremely cute, I checked out 1 hour late but the staff were still very happy and no extra charge. I will definitely come back!

We have a wonderful time staying at Hanoi Chic Boutique Hotel. All the staff was very friendly, especially Mia. She gave us help without a doubt. They keep the room and hotel environment clean. Thank you!

Spacious space. Attentive service.
I really like the decor of this hotel.
Location near Uncle Ho's mausoleum, near the center of the capital.
Breakfast is diverse, delicious, fresh fruit.
Gave me great experiences. Will definitely come back often.
Friendly and enthusiastic staff, someone opened the door. The room was spacious, comfortable and clean. My aunt and I had a great trip ❤️ I will come back next time

A good experience, convenient location, I appreciate the professionalism and thoughtfulness of the staff, very very delicate, easy to eat and delicious food (I am vegetarian, there is a separate menu for vegetarians). Thank you Hôtel Du Lac for a wonderful 3-day stay!
Quiet place to stay. Close to the center of the city, it only takes you 5 minutes to get there. The service is amazing, staff are supportive and friendly. Highly recommend.
Great, clean accommodation with clear view, enthusiastic and supportive staff, will come back
Clean, comfortable room. Good reception
Thank you to all the staff who helped make our family vacation a great one. Thank you.

At first it took quite a while to find the hotel because there was no sign outside, the entrance was quite small, making up for the super nice and clean decor. Located in the heart of Hanoi, so convenient to travel.
Actually, we were very surprised by the hotel cleanliness and facilities. Super worth the price!! Very recommended especially for long stay. The kitchenware was very complete! Great hotel to stay!
Great services. I got a wrong room which is not capable for the family, but they supported really well to adjust. I love how friendly they are during the stay, 5 stars.
Thank you hotel for giving our family a wonderful stay! We will be back
very strategic location, near the cathedral and hospital. can upgrade the room for free with a balcony. friendly staff. clean

Good service - enthusiastic - comfortable. Friendly employee. This is a suitable place for m.n when coming to Hanoi. Near the My Dinh football field should be an interesting choice for those who are passionate about football. 😁

hotel_name: Le Jardin Hotel Haute Couture Hanoi
review_text: Everything here is wonderful. Especially the staff are very friendly.
I had a comfortable and classy stay
Perfect stay! Everything was well prepared. The room is very clean. The reception Ms. Linh Le was very helpful and can speak English very well.

I stayed in Canary Hotel for 4 days 3 nights. Such good memories! The room was clean enough, breakfast okay with a view, aircon works properly, amenities okay, water heater works properly, the receptionist was humble and helpful, security also stands by 24 hours. I used airport pick up transfer from Canary Hotel, the car was big, clean, and I felt safe. The room was exactly the same as the picture in the app. If I come to Hanoi again, I will stay again in Canary Hotel for sure.
Very satisfied, the staff are cheerful and enthusiastic, the room is clean, in the center of the Old Quarter but the price is cheap

Great! Clean room, full facilities, soft and quiet bed. Friendly staff, enthusiastic support. Central location, close to many places to eat and visit. Reasonable price compared to quality. Will come back when the opportunity arises.
If I have a chance to go to Hanoi again, I will choose here! Friendly staff, clean rooms, convenient location, airport shuttle service with a cute driver.

A great place to stay, value for money, just in time for the holidays. The hostess is not very enthusiastic but quite comfortable. The hotel is always open, motorbikes are always locked in front of the hotel, but security is absolute because the hotel is opposite the ward police headquarters. I went alone but was placed in a rather large room, with 2 single beds, beautifully decorated. One minus point is that the water is quite weak but I only rent it to sleep and store things so that's okay.
The staff is enthusiastic, the view is beautiful, the laundry is cheap.
Exceeded expectations. Very professional, clean, attentive service.
Clean hotel, lovely enthusiastic staff
This hotel is great for me, the only minus point is that there is no motorbike rental service for guests, the rest is very OK.

Room quality (wall-mounted air conditioner, 4 pillows included, odorless, white, clean bedding; quiet, good soundproofing; bathroom with quick odor removal, clean, fully equipped; fast, strong wifi, enough lines to sit anywhere in the room; new TV; comfortable room and bed size for a family of 2 couples and 1 small child); cheerful, polite, and enthusiastic support staff (I asked the staff to help make a little surprise for my wife). Breakfast was okay, not much but complete with 1-2 dishes of each type. Will still come back next time if I have the chance
Such a wonderful experience and your service is so good, the staff is friendly, very enthusiastic & professional. Thank you very much Amour Resort Ba Vi 🥰🥰🥰
The receptionist and staff here are very friendly and enthusiastic, the rooms are beautiful and soundproofed quite well, clean and comfortable.

Good service. They will reach out to you through WhatsApp and make sure that they will assist you during your stay. The hotel is located within walking distance to Hanoi Opera House, which is very close to the VinBus stop to Mega Grand World. There’s also plenty of food and coffee places around the area.
Great support. 10 points for the service here. I will continue to support next time. The room is very ok.
Very nice room. Fully equipped from refrigerator, washing machine to kitchen dishes. Has bathtub. Super clean and fully equipped. Will definitely come back if I have the chance.
Excellent services. Really nice staying at L'Heritage Hanoi.

Nice experience, reasonable price, very friendly staff. The hotel is located in the center of the old town, making it easy to walk around. The room is clean, well-lit, airy with many windows, and there are enough facilities. We had an enjoyable stay here for 3 days and will definitely come back!

hotel_name: R103 Building Vinhomes Ocean Park - 20 October Homestay
review_text: Ms. M.A. provided excellent guidance, and the room was clean and smelled nice. It had all the amenities; there was nothing to complain about.
nice room, very friendly and supportive staff, cheap price
The hotel has a great location in the Old Quarter, just a short walk from the Cathedral, making it very convenient to get around. The staff are friendly and helpful.

The staff is very enthusiastic and friendly. The location is convenient for traveling, many restaurants around. The hotel is clean and beautiful. The staff take care very thoughtfully. The room is newly built. New equipment, clean. I like the paintings on the wall. Reasonable price. Next time I will definitely come back.
Everything was perfect, from the room to the service. Staff was kind, the space was airy. Definitely worth a visit!
The place is a bit inside the alley, but close to cafes, accessory shopping places and also delicious food. There is a lift and this is very helpful. The staff are very friendly and agile 🙌🏻
I had a very good stay. The room and everything was okay, I have recommended this place to my friend.
The vacation was very pleasant, the space was clean and airy. The reception staff was enthusiastic and friendly. I wish you a happy vacation at the hotel.
Good and clean. Breakfast ok. Quick staff. Good service
The owner is attentive, enthusiastic, the room is clean, full of personal items, right in the center, very easy to walk.
The room is exactly like the picture. In the center of the old town so it is very convenient to visit the old town.
Very good facilities and service
The hotel is clean, the staff is very friendly and dedicated. I will stay here again if I come back to Hanoi.

hotel_name: AncyrA TamTam Hotel Center Old Quarter - Next to Hoan Kiem Lake
review_text: The hotel is right in the strategic location, the central of the Old Quarter. It's close to everything. The room is not quite specious but clean and comfy. There's everything I need from the fridge to hairdryer. The food is ok, small variety but neat and tasty. Staff are friendly and helpful.
The day I went in it was raining so it was hard to catch a taxi, but the receptionist enthusiastically found a taxi for me and everyone here is very friendly. The room is also very nice.
Thank you very much. Service is amazing. Location is perfect. Sandy is very nice. I will come back.
Clean, quiet room, friendly staff.

This hotel is strategically located in the Old Quarter. The surrounding area can be noisy at night, but it's not noticeable in the hotel room. The room is quite large. The bathroom is also spacious. The shower is in the bathtub. The lighting is bright. The air conditioning is okay, not super cold, but it works well. The hotel staff is friendly. Overall, I recommend this hotel because of its spacious room size.

Highly recommended. Close to many tourist attractions in Hanoi. The rooms are very comfortable and the service is excellent. Plus, they have an iron available upon request. The food is delicious, and Muslim-friendly options include veggie options, fruit options, bread options, and eggs. Thank you 😍
Service ok, enthusiastic, reasonable price
A great place for a stay in Hanoi. They've got great services and food. Highly recommended.
Clean and new hotel with modern design.
Room and toilet so clean… Staffs are so friendly and helpful. Don't hesitate to ask anything. I will book this hotel again
Spacious hotel, nice for the price

hotel_name: WECOZY NOI MIEU - Self check-in, Heart of Old Quarter
review_text:

Nestled on a quieter street just a short walk from Hanoi's vibrant Old Quarter, the Conifer Hotel offers a perfect blend of peaceful retreat and urban convenience. It’s a great choice for travelers who want to be close to the action but still be able to retreat to a calm and comfortable space at the end of the day.

The location is arguably the hotel's biggest strength. Just minutes away from iconic landmarks like the Hanoi Opera House and Hoan Kiem Lake, you are perfectly positioned to explore the city's main attractions on foot. Despite being so central, the hotel is tucked away enough to provide a peaceful and quiet environment, away from the constant buzz of the city streets.

Upon arrival, guests are consistently impressed by the warmth and hospitality of the staff. Many reviews highlight the team's exceptional friendliness and willingness to go above and beyond, whether it's helping with tour bookings, arranging transportation, or simply offering a warm greeting. This high level of service makes the stay feel personal and welcoming.

The rooms themselves are clean, well-appointed, and comfortable, offering all the necessary amenities for a pleasant stay. While some rooms may be a bit smaller, they are efficiently designed and many feature lovely balconies with city views. The hotel also offers a delicious breakfast with a variety of options, including both Vietnamese and Western dishes, which many guests rave about.

Overall, the Conifer Hotel stands out as a charming and excellent value boutique option in Hanoi. It delivers a high-quality experience through its prime location, impeccable service, and comfortable accommodations. It's an ideal choice for tourists seeking a well-rounded and hospitable base for their adventures in Vietnam’s capital.

The hotel is surrounded by cheap and safe street eats such as beef salad/noodles, dumplings, banh mi, banana-sweet potato fritters, and BBQ meat/sausage in a baguette. Fine kerb side dining. The main Hanoi cathedral, St. Joseph, is within walking distance. All the trade streets, e.g., for shoes, sports gear, fashion, toys in the old quarter, are in the vicinity. Excellent location for exploring old Hanoi. Thank you to Gracie and Julia for making our stay as comfortable as home.

review_text: They're right on the river in sight of the Dragon Bridge. Plenty of restaurants nearby. Staff is super helpful and friendly. Everything clean and polished. Happy Day is now my go-to lodging in Da Nang.
Everything is great. When I return to Danang, I will continue to choose this hotel
Clean room, beautiful sea view. Friendly and enthusiastic staff. Convenient location for moving and commuting.

hotel_name: Signature by M Village Beachfront Hotel
review_text: Room service is quite new and clean. Appreciate for a satisfying breakfast. Staff cheerful and enthusiastic. In addition, there are cases where the power is turned off, then I count within 10 that there is electricity back to standard hotel.
Stayed there for 2 nights and it was great. I really enjoyed my stay thanks to the lovely staff. The facilities were great, the beach club as well as the lovely afternoon tea.

It was a great experience at Cicilia. The room was clean and smelled nice, the location was central and convenient, just a 50-meter walk to the beach, and the staff were very enthusiastic and friendly. I will definitely come back again.
Had a great 3 days stay here. Walking distance to the beach, mini-market, cafes, restaurants, etc. Clean room and nice breakfast. Definitely recommend this hotel when you stay in Danang.

Booking a room at the hotel is the perfect choice for the trip. Convenient location to visit attractions. Enthusiastic hotel staff, attentive customer care. Beautiful, clean room with a beautiful sea view. Delicious breakfast with a variety of dishes. You can leave your luggage waiting for check-in time. After checking out, you can still leave your luggage at the hotel. This is a great experience for my first time in Da Nang. I will definitely come back to the hotel next time I return to Da Nang.

The location is excellent, just a 2-minute (150m) walk to Danang's popular beach. The hotel is surrounded by souvenir shops, minimarkets, motorbike rentals, laundry facilities, restaurants, and cafes. The staff is friendly and check-in and check-out are fast. Recommended!

hotel_name: Wink Hotel Danang Centre, Unscripted by Hyatt
review_text: The room is small, but the view of Ham Rong Bridge is so great, the style is suitable for young people, near the center. Overall it's ok.

The hotel is very ok from good service, breakfast is also very delicious, clean, everything is great, I have never stayed at a hotel as good as this 💯💯 also set up and supported me to decorate the birthday room for my boyfriend very meticulously and neatly and I also thank Ms. "Tra My" for taking care of me very thoughtfully and wholeheartedly, everything I need is always available and the staff are extremely cute 🥰 Although the location is not near the sea, what you get in return is completely worth the money you spend 🥹💯 Next time I have the opportunity to come back, I will definitely book this hotel again because for me this will be the best choice when coming to Da Nang 😚

Everything was great. The receptionists were friendly and kind. The rooms were new and clean. The hostel was very new and clean. The dorm beds were very spacious, the bathroom was inside the room. I found nothing to complain about this place. The only thing is that the location is on a small street, and when I stayed there, the road was under construction so it was a bit difficult to get to and not very clean. I think this hostel is worth the money.
Very nice hotel, the staff are nice, food delicious, I also tried the spa and it was very enjoyable.

The rooms are comfortable, airy, designed with bright colors to bring a feeling of relaxation and comfort. With a cheap price, you can own a room with a view directly overlooking the city, a super beautiful and super chill scene, making me want to go back to Da Nang to play again immediately.
Very pleasant stay at Nesta Celia Danang. The room is big, comfortable, and clean. The buffet breakfast is amazing with multiple choices.

I stayed at MiAn Hotel Danang and was very satisfied. Clean room, comfortable, rooftop swimming pool with nice view, friendly staff. Close to the beach and Dragon Bridge, reasonable price. Will come back if I have the chance.
One of the best hotels we have stayed at. Everything was perfect and the location was great.
Going on the occasion of Da Nang to reopen after the epidemic. Free villa room upgrade. 5 star experience. Will be back <3
The room is clean, the receptionist is very cute, enthusiastic and supportive, the location is convenient near My Khe beach, there are many 24-hour convenience stores around.

The location is very strategic, the rooms are clean and spacious. The hotel staff are friendly and helpful, especially Jack and Duy. During our four-night stay, we were constantly greeted with "How are you?", knowing we were from Indonesia.

I used to stay here twice when I had the opportunity to go to Danang. The staff was very enthusiastic, friendly, although the room was small but very clean, moreover right near the sea (about 50m from the beach). Great
Great hotel for the price, new, beautiful rooms, clean bathrooms. Especially the staff here are very cute, thoughtful and enthusiastic, always helping guests very well.
Every time I come here, it's always in San San, the hotel is all cute and friendly, the room is always clean and fragrant, will continue to stay when I go to Da Nang, here are a few more cute cats 🥰

The hotel is close to the sea, the room is large, clean and fully equipped, but the room is not fully filled in the minibar and the bathroom is probably due to the epidemic situation but the staff will very quickly fill you. Staff were very friendly and enthusiastic. I will come back here many times

I feel very happy and comfortable here, the room is spacious and airy, the breakfast buffet is delicious and varied, thank you Ms. Nhung for helping me a lot, she is very beautiful and kind, her English is very good so I don't have difficulties in language barriers like other places I have lived, Everything is great

I had a wonderful 3 days 2 nights experience at Bonny. The room was so beautiful, clean, and convenient to go to the beach. The staff was very enthusiastic. Next time I will still choose Bonny for the next trip.

hotel_name: Tuyet Son Hotel ( TS Ocean Hotel )
review_text: Room T10 has a direct sea view, very chill, unexpectedly the price is so reasonable, the staff is very enthusiastic and friendly, breakfast is varied, the room is clean and quiet. 10 points. Everyone should experience it.

Great experience at Radisson Hotel Danang – The most impressive thing is Ha Nguyen at the infinity pool!

My family just had a 3-day, 2-night vacation at Radisson Hotel Danang and was really satisfied with the quality of service here.

The hotel has a modern space, the rooms are very clean, fully equipped and always cleaned carefully every day. The reception team is friendly, enthusiastic and always ready to support whenever needed. The breakfast buffet service is very diverse, the dishes are rich, suitable for both adults and children in the family.

The most impressive point of the vacation is the infinity pool area and especially the excellent service of Ha Nguyen - the pool area staff. Ha Nguyen is very enthusiastic, friendly, always happy to support guests. She not only makes delicious cocktails but also helps our whole family take beautiful souvenir photos. Thanks to your support, we had wonderful photos to preserve memorable moments in Da Nang.

Thank you to the Radisson Hotel Da Nang team, especially Ha Nguyen. My family will definitely come back and recommend to friends and relatives!
Check-in and check-out were quick and easy. Friendly staff. Convenient location, near Dragon Bridge. Clean room, fully equipped.
They have a really good roof top bar and a fantastic breakfast selection, a very highly recommended place for a stay in Da Nang:)

The staff were very helpful, the room was so cozy. And the best part is the location, near My Khe Beach, and so many famous Michelin Guide restaurants you can get to by walking. Everything is perfect. When I go to Da Nang, I'll make sure to stay in this hotel again.

I went on my wedding anniversary, although I only stayed for 1 night, I was really impressed, the staff was very nice, the room was clean, I was given a nice cake for the anniversary, the bed was beautifully decorated. 
My husband and I went to the restaurant to try it at night, it was really delicious and the price was reasonable. We were invited to try some dishes while drinking craft beer. It's also close to the beach
I will definitely come back to Fusion when I have the chance 🩷🩷🩷
If you want to go to Hoi An, you should stay at Fusion because I think the distance is quite close, but compared to the center, it is far
clean new hotel. Enthusiastic staff and friendly guide. Will come back if Danang.

I go to 2 families my parents love, the hotel has beautiful views, the location is right, the buffet breakfast is delicious, the restaurant staff is happy and fast, thanks to the friendly and friendly restaurant manager enthusiastically taking care of our guests and advising our family on places to eat and drink in Danang and the old town, my family had a wonderful stay at the Nalod Hotel, and had a chance to return to Danang. Certainly my family will choose nalod

Thank you, Senorita staff, for your kindness and support during my stay here. The hotel's location is wonderful, less than a 5-minute walk from the beach. The room is clean and airy, with a view of the sea. The hotel also offers motorbike rental service and taxi, which is very convenient.

Warm holiday. The staff are very friendly and knowledgeable about their work, advising guests very effectively. Rooms are very clean, cozy, reasonably arranged. The restaurant is compact, the food is okay but not plentiful. The drink is quite tasty. The highlight is the spa service, professional and good advice. The majority of employees are skilled.
Everything works well: clean room, friendly staff, great location. Just a short walk to the beach. Perfect for a short stay in Da Nang.
The hotel is very good. Great vacation.
Extremely friendly staff, neat and clean rooms, I have stayed at this hotel more than 10 times in the past few years, very good!

The staff is very enthusiastic, supporting 24/7. The hotel is near the beach, very convenient to travel. The room quality is quite good, clean, the furniture shows no signs of being old or broken. Will come back another time.

hotel_name: Ocean Garden Boutique Da Nang by Haviland
review_text: A destination worth experiencing when traveling to Da Nang. The receptionists are friendly, the room attendants are enthusiastic... In general, everything here is very good and the service quality is excellent.

hotel_name: Grandvrio City Danang By Route Inn Group
review_text: My room at this hotel is comfortable. The room is clean. The staff are friendly and very supportive. Thank you, and I will choose again next time.

We booked a room urgently and accidentally booked the last room of MK, didn't expect much but was very surprised when we received the room, the facilities were very good, modern, the equipment was prepared very thoughtfully and fully. The receptionists supported us very enthusiastically and cutely. I really recommend everyone to experience here. There is nothing to complain about ❤️
The staff is very enthusiastic, the room is very clean. 100 places to stay when coming to Da Nang
Nice hotel! Good location, friendly staff, great view, clean facilities. Would recommend.

hotel_name: M Village Hotel Da Nang Centre - Free Laundry and Kitchen
review_text: The hotel has an impressive design. Prime location opposite the pink Da Nang church. A few steps to the Han River and the Han River market. Moreover, there is a free 24/7 washer and dryer area, which is extremely convenient because after a trip you still have a fragrant suitcase to return. I will experience it again when I come back 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

We have an amazing time staying here. The hotel is worth the price. We got the best view. The room is very clean and comfortable, the staff are very friendly and welcoming, breakfast is amazing, and has many options for you to choose. The pool has a nice view, and they also have a playroom for my kid. She enjoyed it a lot. We definitely will come back again.🥰
The location near Da Nang International Airport is very convenient. The rooms are clean. The staff is friendly and nice. I will come back next time.
The staff are very friendly and enthusiastic.
The room is clean and beautiful, the equipment and design of the room are comfortable and smart. The swimming pool is also very clean, good service, reasonable prices
The staff were friendly, polite, gentle, and enthusiastic. The hotel was clean and had good amenities. It made my stay very comfortable. Thank you, Mandila.

The hotel is near the beach, just across the street to Pham Van Dong beach, very convenient. The staff is enthusiastic. My family has 2 children, so the staff changed to a bigger room without extra charge, very ok, and also has a sea view. The minus point is that the breakfast is not diverse, the swimming pool is a bit small.

hotel_name: Prince Hotel Da Nang (Formerly Sel de Mer Hotel & Suites)
review_text: Nice room , enthusiastic staff I had a very good impression of the hotel . Everything is great!!

The Economic room is a moderately spacious corner room, airy, fully equipped, with a standing mirror, a 45-inch TV with Youtube, Netflix. Clean, good ventilation, strong water faucet. Convenient location, big road, within 50m there are supermarkets, coffee shops, pharmacies, restaurants. The hotel serves breakfast until 9am. Friendly staff. Clean rooftop swimming pool. The hallway smells of lemongrass

I give this hotel 10 points without any buts. The hotel is centrally located, convenient for traveling to places in Da Nang city (including walking), has rooms with a view of Dragon Bridge. Reasonable price. The owner is friendly, lovely, enthusiastic and also helps book tour tickets around Da Nang. There are motorbikes for rent, very convenient for those who want to visit and explore Da Nang by motorbike. If I have the opportunity to come back, I will still choose to stay here.
The staff were really enthusiastic, very dedicated and thoughtful, showed me good places to eat, and supported very quickly. I really like it.
We had such a great experience here. Will definitely come back.

The hotel here must be called 100/10, the staff is super enthusiastic and supports guests with all their might. Beautiful, fragrant room with full amenities. The food at the restaurant is delicious. The downside is that there's a bit of a lack of places to go around, but the hotel is great
New and clean rooms, enthusiastic friendly staff, simple quick services. Hotels near travel destinations are very convenient, next time to Danang will continue to return.

My second time staying here and hopefully I will return again. Rooms are clean and have comfy bed. Restaurant downstairs has very nice food and the staff are friendly and helpful. Close to the beach, city, and the Dragon Bridge. Thanks again to the staff.
Great vacation, hotel near the beach, enthusiastic staff, spacious room, extremely cheap price, great

hotel_name: Sujet Beach Hotel and Apartment Danang by Haviland
review_text: The hotel is very nice, the rooms are clean and fully equipped. The swimming pool is also clean and large. The breakfast is delicious and complete. The staff is super enthusiastic, I recommend everyone to come here.

The hotel is too satisfied from the design of luxurious, modern, comfortable and beautiful rooms to the friendly staff. Breakfast has many dishes from Asia to Europe. Especially, the location of the hotel is located on the city center road, very convenient to move. Overall too quality. Will come back again
The hotel is in the center, very easy to find. The room is spacious, clean and beautiful. The staff is friendly, compared to the price it is really good, very satisfied. 10 VND for the hotel.
The hotel has a beautiful sea view, dedicated and attentive staff, the hotel's services are fully provided.
Extremely great, convenient location.
Clean room, nice view, affordable car rental service.
Beautiful hotel, airy, friendly and lovely staff. Especially the 2 receptionists Nga and Nguyen are polite, friendly and professional 👍. Will return to Paris Deli hotel to stay when coming to Da Nang
The hotel is located right in the city center near Con market, airport. Room is clean and spacious. Breakfast was delicious. Every time I come to Danang, I stay in this hotel.

Such a great hotel. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful! They saw some problems we were having (not related to the hotel) and helped us out. Location is great. I wish the restaurant was open a bit later but other than that, this was a great place to spend a few days in Son Tra/Danang. Again, great staff!
Overall, the hotel ticks all the boxes, especially the nice staff (Ms. Sarah and Ms. Tracy at the reception). Definitely will stay here again when visiting Da Nang.
Delicious food, clean and beautiful rooms, friendly and professional staff

It's a compact but beautiful place, the staffs are very nice, attentive, and flexible. Extremely clean and comfortable stay. Although the breakfast menu is relatively simple, the food is delicious and fulfilling, with plenty of fruits and snacks provided as well. The Memory is a highlight to our Danang trip and would definitely book again if we return to Danang
The hotel has new rooms, clean, beautiful view, enthusiastic staff, especially Mr. Hoang who was extremely enthusiastic in helping with luggage. Highly recommend! 🥰
The hotel is in the central area, so it's close to everywhere, the rooms are beautiful. The staff is friendly and pleasant, the breakfast is a bit small but delicious. In general everything is good.

hotel_name: Nui Than Tai - Ebisu Onsen Resort
review_text: The resort is clean, in harmony with nature, suitable for both relaxation and children's play. The staff is enthusiastic and attentive.

hotel_name: Satya Hotel Da Nang Han Market
review_text: Clean hotel with enthusiastic staff

The room is very clean and airy. Fully equipped with washing machine, induction cooker, dishes, refrigerator, strong water. Room 501 has a luxurious bathtub with hot water 24/24. Beautiful view. The staff and uncles are very cute and polite. In general, when visiting Da Nang again, I will definitely stay at Shi House again.
I had a wonderful vacation here. The receptionists took great care of me. I hope that next time I have more time, I will come back and stay longer here. 10 points.
The room is clean, fully equipped, with a beautiful view of the Han River and Dragon Bridge. The reception staff are especially enthusiastic and friendly.
staffs are very friendly and fun, room is small but full, bathroom is spacious
Friendly staff, good customer support, service suitable for the price, many amenities around the hotel, close to the beach. Very satisfied
9 points. Normal hotel room, cheerful, enthusiastic staff. Near sea. Elevator fast ok. Everything is ok

The room facing the sun is very hot, the air conditioner is hidden in the ceiling but not cold enough. The reception waiting room is also hot, the homeowner should add a fan or turn on the air conditioner. The room lacks a place to hang towels and a place to put shower soap, which is very inconvenient.

Rooms are clean, comfortable, staff clean every day. Reasonable price, breakfast buffet is quite ok. Staff is enthusiastic and polite. The hotel is near the beach so it is convenient for swimming and traveling in the center. If there is a chance, I will book again.
The host is very welcoming and hospitable. The place is clean and quiet, at a walkable distance to My Khe beach. Number 1 is the free water.

Fast check-in, clean room, friendly staff and helped us a lot. The reception staff enthusiastically advised us on some entertainment and dining areas in Da Nang, we were very satisfied with that. Thank you to the entire hotel and the reception staff Dat, Giang, Tra My
Very recommended this hotel, the room is very clean and comfortable. The staff also nice and helpful. Everything is good 👍
Everything was good: nice staff, reasonable price, good services, etc. We would come back soon :)

Sea view hotel, 8-10 minutes walk to the beach
Clean room, friendly and enthusiastic receptionist
Room price is ok
Breakfast is quite rich and easy to eat
Good experience
15th floor has a swimming pool with panoramic sea view
Rooms are fully equipped. But the furniture is old, wooden cabinets cracked. Bathrooms, showers, faucets, etc. are generally not up to standard for Hotel 4*.
The hotel is old but quite nice and very spacious, quiet, convenient location to hang out.

hotel_name: Samdi Da Nang Airport Hotel - 3 minutes to Central
review_text: Great Sami. I stayed in the smallest room of the hotel which was 18m2 but still found it not cramped at all. The design room is not noisy. TV in big room. The kids love it. Will definitely come back to Samdi when I have the opportunity to go to Da Nang
Clean hotel, delicious breakfast. It's just a house with drawn curtains but no door, which is a bit inconvenient

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Shine Hotel for 8 days with my wife while we participated in the IronMan Danang 2025, and I can confidently say it was an exceptional experience. From the moment we arrived, the hotel staff were incredibly helpful and attentive, ensuring that all our needs were met. They provided us with local insights and recommendations that enhanced our stay. The hospitality was genuinely warm, making us feel at home. The rooms were comfortable and well-appointed, providing a perfect retreat after our long days of training and participating in the event. The location of Shine Hotel was ideal, allowing us to easily access the IronMan event as well as local attractions. We appreciated being in a vibrant area that offered plenty of dining and entertainment options within walking distance. Overall, I highly recommend Shine Hotel for anyone visiting Danang, whether for an event like IronMan or simply for leisure. The combination of excellent service, comfortable accommodations, and a great location makes it a top choice.
Enthusiastic staff, free airport pick-up, free afternoon tea when staying 2 nights, diverse breakfast buffet, location right at My An night beach
Located next to the beautiful beach and surrounded by many restaurants. Comfy rooms and good breakfast. Great place to stay in Da Nang.

Nice location, sea view, near the center. The receptionist, restaurant, and room staff are very enthusiastic, cute, and support guests very well. The swimming pool is clean. Rooms are clean, beautiful, fully equipped. Next time I visit Da Nang I will definitely still choose this hotel. The family had a great vacation here!
The owners are very enthusiastic, the room is clean, has an elevator and full 5-star amenities.

This is the best hotel during my visit in Vietnam, 1, when I arrived the reception was very friendly, they gave me a welcome drink, basically super friendly. 2. The room is very clean and I like the details of their amenities, with cookies, it was quite impressive for us, and the bed was very big, super clean and comfortable. 3. The breakfast in my opinion during my visit to Vietnam was the best, the food has taste, for Muslims there are many choices of food that can be chosen. 4. I also had a spa, for 2 hours it was quite relaxing after a trip to Marble Mountain, this was the best choice, the price is still okay, there is a discount for those who stay at the hotel. 5. The pool is big, for family, or with friends it's quite fun, although there is no beach view but the distance to the beach is only 7 minutes on foot. 6, the location is close to everywhere, you can order grab and it is very cheap and easy.
Hotel clean, nice. Good food. Friendly staff, enthusiastic support. I will continue to stay here when I return to Da Nang.

The hotel is located right on Pham Van Dong Street, convenient for both going to the city center and to the beach. The hotel is beautiful, the staff is good. The room is a bit small but very clean, nice view. Next time I come to Da Nang, I will choose this hotel again.
I had a wonderful stay here. The room was airy and clean. The location was close to the beach.

Our stay at Halina Hotel is very memorable. All the staff, especially Rosie, are very accommodating and they always see to it we are enjoying our room, food, and everything! We definitely recommend Halina Hotel and we would love to come back!😍

Hotel vi tri good, room spacious, airy, clean, new and modern equipment, suitable for family outing, location near the beach. Friendly staff, good breakfast, cozy atmosphere. Will come back to enjoy the next vacation.

hotel_name: Animor Green Home Villa Da Nang
review_text: Hotel near My Khe beach. About 5 minutes walk, spacious and clean room. Every day someone comes to clean the room. The hotel owner is very cute. Come to Animor Green, everyone ❤️
The hotel is close to the places of entertainment, eating and drinking that make travel extremely good, so the trip is smoother.

The hotel is easy to find, located near the famous areas in Da Nang. I really like the service attitude as well as the support is very enthusiastic and fast. If I have the opportunity to go back to Da Nang, I will choose Lavender as my next resting place ^^

hotel_name: Cordial Grand Hotel Da Nang Beach - Infinity Rooftop Pool
review_text: I had a wonderful 4 days 3 nights experience at the hotel. The hotel has a beautiful panoramic view of the sea, clean hygiene and high quality service. The staff at the hotel are very enthusiastic and thoughtful. I highly recommend everyone to stay at the hotel.

The room is relatively good, clean, the bathroom is a bit old, I don't know how the other rooms are, but my room does not have hot water, fortunately it's cool so I don't need hot water. Breakfast buffet delicious with many dishes, full of food. Next time will have the opportunity to visit again. Friendly employee.
Very good quality room for the price. Hotel staff are enthusiastic.

I stayed in a room with a city view, a beautiful view. The room isn't too big, but it's just right for our needs, reasonable price. The hotel is located in the city center, making it very convenient for getting around, especially very close to Golden Bridge. Plus, the staff are friendly. Highly recommend if you visit Danang~

The hotel is located right in the center so it's easy to get to, there are 2 male receptionists who are very friendly and lovely. Good service, enthusiastic, next time I come back to Da Nang I will choose to stay here again.
Awesome, the owner is so cute, he told me to wait until he comes back from playing to lock the door 🖤

This is the 3rd time coming back to May Hotel , the room is still clean , value for money , the staff is very friendly and hospitable , especially the room attendant aunt I forgot to ask for my name , meeting the needs The customer service is timely and attentive, the way people treat guests is also very enthusiastic and warm like the people of Da Nang, that's why I want to come here after a stressful and stressful working period, the hotel is close. the beach and shopping areas so it's very easy to use the service here! Only 1 minus point is that the elevator is too close to the guest room, the room is not well soundproofed, so outside noises such as the sound of the elevator, the sound of the car in the basement every time there are guests in and out, the sound of children will be heard. little impact on the guest experience ! I also work at a hotel, so pay special attention to the above issues! Anw will continue to support May Hotel every time he comes to Da Nang! From Phu Quoc with love ❤️
The owner and staff are enthusiastic and cheerful, the accommodation is clean, and the breakfast is delicious. Will come back next time!
The location is very good in the heart of the city center of Da Nang. The room is clean, and breakfast is delicious. The receptionist is friendly.
The receptionist is very friendly, explaining carefully. Modern room, very clean, fully equipped. I am very satisfied with my experience here.

Location: The hotel is conveniently located near the beach and the city center, making it an ideal spot for tourists. It's close to My Khe Beach and various attractions such as Cau Rong and Cau Tran Thi Ly. Facilities and Services: The hotel offers a range of amenities, including free WiFi, a mini kitchen, minibar, and TV in the rooms. Guests also have access to services like airport shuttle, laundry, and bicycle rental. The hotel provides family-friendly accommodations, with policies for children under 5 years old to stay for free if using existing beds. Cleanliness and Safety: The hotel maintains good hygiene standards, with regular cleaning and disinfection practices. They also offer hand sanitizers and masks to guests, along with other health and safety measures. Customer Service: Reviews frequently praise the helpful and friendly staff. Receptionists and housekeeping staff are noted for their courteous and supportive service. Value for Money: Many guests find the hotel to offer good value for money, especially considering its location and the amenities provided. Room rates are generally affordable, with occasional discounts available.
Hotel staff are very friendly. Hotel is just over 100m from the beach. Reasonable room rates. like

It's my first visit to Da Nang and the trip was very enjoyable. The city has lots of nice places to visit, many restaurants, massage/spas, salons, coffee shops, and many more. The people are very nice and courteous, same as in the hotel that I stayed. Most importantly, everything is not expensive at all. I will plan a return trip to Da Nang soon, probably next year.
Beautiful hotel. Professional friendly happy staff. Breakfast was delicious. Nice pool view. There will be occasions for 5-star quality to come back
Room is exactly as pictured. Relatively clean. There is a mini supermarket nearby. Very close to the beach, convenient for travel.

hotel_name: Seahorse Signature Danang Hotel by Haviland
review_text: I found this hotel through Traveloka and Google maps and saw high votes and good reviews. My 1-night stay here was really good, the staff and security were all friendly and attentive, the rooms were beautiful and clean. I really like the decor, natural and with a skylight with harmonious light. I like the rooftop swimming pool the most, it's the best. I recommend it to anyone visiting Da Nang to experience Seahorse. Thank you Duyen, Thao and Ty, Uncle Tien... for enthusiastically welcoming me in room 204.1
Best hotel in Da Nang! Very clean and service friendly. Cara and Sun are very lovely, and their hospitality is very nice.
It takes about 10 minutes to walk to the beach from the hotel. Around many eateries. Spacious, clean room. Breakfast was delicious.

Super good hotel service, beautiful room with swimming pool, daily breakfast buffet, beautiful location near the sea but still quiet and not too noisy, in the morning use the hotel buffet with piano, French music making the space super chill, the staff is 10 points, very dedicated, always trying to meet the requirements so that customers can feel most comfortable, in general, I don't know what to complain about, it's the best I've ever been to
Large room, nice view, enthusiastic staff

hotel_name: Nhat Linh Hotel & Suites Da Nang
review_text: Great, above expectations, enthusiastic friendly staff, clean rooms, delicious breakfast. The next time you visit, will continue to Nhat Linh hotel and will recommend to friends!

The hotel overlooking the Han River (Dragon Bridge and Han River Bridge) is very beautiful! Convenient to eat and play. Hotel staff is very cute and mindset service: Support very enthusiastic guests (receive train ticket help, pay, rent car). Good price. We will continue here if we return to Danang.
A great stay at the hotel, the price is cheap but the interior and service from the staff are very good. Everyone should choose a hotel to experience their vacation in Da Nang
The owners are lovely, the room is clean, airy and pretty. There is also a very chill cafe downstairs. 10 points 🫶🏻

I am in the 10th floor room, the city view is very beautiful. the room is small but tidy and clean, staff are cleaning the room every day. Very attentive and enthusiastic staff. Very reasonable price. how the sea is tiny. Around the many dining restaurants. Very pleased. Wish the hotel is always crowded.
The room is very clean, airy and right in the center, I really like the space here, will definitely come back and introduce relatives and friends to come here to relax.
Newly built hotel, spacious rooms, high-class equipment, very okay
I would like to thank the host and the staff for their warm welcome, friendliness and hospitality. If I have the chance to go to Da Nang again, I will visit you again ^^ See you and everyone again!!!

I checked in early but the hotel was free for me and upgraded the room to a better room for me. Thank you! Room is clean, nice, panoramic view over the city. Delicious breakfast, friendly staff. The pool is extremely beautiful, the location is good near restaurants, minimarts, .... so there's no need to go far.
Stay here for 3 days and all was good! Walking distance to beach, cafes, stores, etc. High-speed Wi-Fi, spacious and clean room. Staff also very helpful. Love it!

The hotel is nice, close to the beach, the hotel is very friendly, the staff was very enthusiastic because of the incident so the family did not follow the schedule, the staff and the manager helped us change the new check-in date without any additional cost. Any surcharges, next time will definitely come back Richico
The room is lovely, the swimming pool is quite chill and the staff is also enthusiastic

The hotel is located in a spacious car alley, quick procedure friendly staff, fully equipped rooms with kitchens, beautiful campus for those who like to live virtual. I checked out 30p late and not being urged. Sitting in the lobby, waiting for the flight time, the staff also invited to stay and swim to reduce sadness

Clean room, polite and helpful staff. Central location so very convenient.

The hotel is right in the center, convenient for travel.
The hotel is near the center, easy to move to places. The room has a nice view, lovely staff. 5 stars now and forever
Th hotel Lacation at side Ho Chi Minh boulevard and around 800 m from ben than market and also near from ho chi minh museum, war museum and independent palace.

hotel_name: Signature by M Village Le Thanh Ton
review_text: We had a wonderful stay at Signature M. The staff were all very friendly and helpful. The location is in the Japan Town area. Plenty of restaurants, bars, and street foods around. Modern spacious room. Good service.

hotel_name: Ohana Hotel - Near Ben Thanh Market
review_text: The room is spacious and clean. Will come back when I have the opportunity to work here.

We had a wonderful stay here. Staffs are very friendly, extremely helpful. Very safe to spend your weekend here. Our in room breakfast was excellent. The river view and sunset are amazing. We definitely will come back when everything back to normal.

hotel_name: Sedona Suites Ho Chi Minh City
review_text: Will come back to this hotel surely. Just perfect !
I booked the wrong dates, but the friendly staff helped me out and let me stay in my room. Great service!

The hotel is very close to the airport (5-10 minutes by walk). The staff were very friendly, polite, and very helpful. The room is spacious, clean, and decent. Totally recommend this place, especially if you have a long layover.
Great hotel. Clean, convenient to travel. Especially the staff is very enthusiastic, attentive service. 10 points

Convenient location in District 4, easy to move to surrounding districts. Good facilities, nice room, airy & bright. There is a place to cook, wash, dry clothes very conveniently. The staff is enthusiastic and friendly.

If you come to HCM for a long time, you should choose this place, it is more convenient & optimal than staying at a hotel. I will definitely come back.
Clean, comfortable room. Friendly enthusiastic service. I will be back
The waitresses are clean, towels are always freshly washed. Attentive and enthusiastic. Every time I visit Saigon for work, I always book here.
Because my flight was delayed, I arrived at the hotel too late. But you guys still waited to welcome me. Thank you very much for giving me a wonderful trip.
Big room. Good breakfast. Fruit welcome in room.

hotel_name: M Village Living Le Van Sy
review_text: The staff are really helpful and kind. The room is spacious, clean, and tidy. Recommended place to stay. Will come back later for sure.

Hotel near the airport, access everywhere is close. 24-hour receptionist and responsive. We checked in at 3 am and were still promptly assisted. Spacious, clean room. Everything in the room is complete. Very good and recommended.

The hotel is not located very close to the center, but it exceeded my expectations. The room is fully equipped, the hotel supports early check-in if there is a vacant room, even after checking out, I can still temporarily leave my suitcase if it is not time to go to the bus station or airport, the support staff is attentive, I went out until 3-4am and there was still a support staff with a quite pleasant voice. I met 2 security guards, an older guy was normal, the younger guard was very enthusiastic, helping me carry my suitcase and open the car door very enthusiastically. Overall, I highly recommend this hotel.
Nice, fully equipped, with a refrigerator, microwave, electric stove, and even a rice cooker. Perfect for family vacations or extended stays, it's safe, and very private.

The hotel is so impressive and thoughtful to my family, the space is clean and quiet, the receptionists are very cute, there is always someone opening the door for guests, my family has a small baby that was welcomed by the guests. The staff took care very attentively, the breakfast buffet was delicious. The hotel location is right in the center, walking out the door on the left is the Independence Palace, on the right is Ben Thanh market, opposite is a very chill bar, near the mini stop store, the location is very close to famous attractions . I really like it.
The staff is very nice and support guests, at midnight I was too tired to call the staff but still came. Next time I will definitely come back 😉😉😉😉

The hotel gave us a special favor on request, giving us a room with a window. When we checked in, we didn't have it, thank you for letting us feel happy, grateful for the enthusiastic and cheerful service.

The room was clean and tidy. The staff were friendly and helpful from check-in to check-out. The facilities were complete and suitable for both leisure and business trips. I will return if I have the opportunity.
I stayed here in 3 nights and everything was perfect.Room was cleaned neatly everyday.Staff are friendly also.You can walk to have meal or coffee nearby.
Nice room, clean, attentive reception and service. Good breakfast and nice space. Will continue to stay in the upcoming holidays.
The room is small, the equipment is not good, the soundproofing is poor, the cleaning is not very clean, the staff responds to support messages quickly.

hotel_name: Express By M Village Dong Du
review_text: Very good budget hotel in District 1, location is good, there are marts and restaurants nearby. The room is nice and clean with everything needed provided, and the service is really good. I recommend this hotel for those who are looking for a budget hotel.

hotel_name: M Village Living Vo Thi Sau
review_text: Friendly staff, comfortable room, clean, cozy, very good experience

Great location, walking distance to many sights. Friendly staff and great service.

Good price as described. Convenient for traveling in District 1 Center

Fast, clean, friendly and satisfying service

The hotel in the center of the city is quite convenient to move, because my needs only need a room to stay, so I don't have too high a requirement, with the room price and quality of service I receive is reasonable.

hotel_name: Sazi Ben Thanh Hotel - Near Ben Thanh Market
review_text: Very comfortable, clean and safe.

I didn't check in until 2am but the staff here were very enthusiastic. I stayed another day because the service was so great.

hotel_name: M Village Living Hoang Van Thu
review_text: My first time in Da Lat, but M Village literally made me feel like I was home. This homestay is one of my most favorite places so far since I have started my traveling journey. Highly recommend it if you are looking for a clean, spacious, and beautiful place to stay in Da Lat.

The room was clean, spacious, and well-equipped with complete toiletries, and all the facilities worked perfectly. I was also allowed to check in an hour early. The service provided exceeded the value of the hotel cost.

My stay was a 10/10, absolutely nothing to critique from the moment I arrived.
