The hotel is in a great central location, right next to Bui Vien walking street. Convenient to travel to tourist attractions, enthusiastic staff. The price is very reasonable. If I have the opportunity to go to Saigon, I will definitely come back!

I love the view from the hotel, I could see the fireworks from there, which was outstanding. The food was ok and the staff is very friendly. I’d love to visit this place again. Thanks for making my new year wonderful
The hotel is very clean and very quiet with a balcony to sit and enjoy. If I have a chance to go to the city, I would definitely enjoy a laverce boat

The facilities are a bit old, there are no windows so it's a bit stuffy, the shower water is weak. However, it cannot be denied that the room is very clean, the receptionists are extremely friendly and enthusiastic.

hotel_name: Luan Vu Hotel Near Bui Vien Walking Street
review_text: Room is great! It's really what you pay for! It's worth the price. Breakfast is good also. Staff are accommodating and nice. Location is also great. Just along pham Ngu Lao Street. Definitely a nice place to rest. 😊

The room was clean and very spacious for 3 people.
If I go to Ho Chi Minh City, I'd stay here again.
Good location, clean room, friendly staff.
Best hotel with great location. Surrounded by interesting local food store. Helpful and friendly staffs! Would highly recommend.
Spacious bedroom. Ok. Enthusiastic support staff.

hotel_name: Otis Apartment - 33 Tran Ke Xuong Rooftop
review_text: Fully equipped and very nice room! Will come back if I have a chance
Friendly staff, clean and airy rooms, convenient location, and many good restaurants near the hotel. Very satisfied, will support them again next time.
Centrally located, great service, clean and comfortable - you can't ask for much more. Perfect for a short business trip and I will continue to use T-Ritz for future visits
The hotel is located near the airport, very convenient for traveling. The area has many restaurants and eateries, very convenient for living. Clean rooms, friendly and enthusiastic staff.

A very strategic place, from entertainment and places to eat, the hotel is very clean, all the employees are friendly, and the cleaning service is very friendly. Every time I go to Ho Chi Minh, I always stay here. I give it a star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Friendly staff, very enthusiastic. Clean room, no smell, convenient location, not noisy

The hotel left a bad impression and don't want to come back! + The staff is not very enthusiastic. + About the room: no one to clean, also no kettle, hangers, hot and cold water for bathing. I stayed at the deluxe room in room no 804. It's clean and comfortable. The amenities are ready, the room is cleaned every two days. These all meet my expectation. The other good reasons are: strategic location, nearly from every tourism destination (just walk using Maps/Google Maps), 24 hours tavern and cafe for breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner, supper. Will stay here again for my next visit
I went to 4 people but 2 children are young so the hotel also supports no extra charge ok no problem❤️

As a person who often travels for work and leisure, I highly appreciate Sogo Hotel for the following reasons (you can refer to it): The hotel receptionist is very enthusiastic, takes care of guests attentively and always supports to resolve guests' requests WITH JOY!!! (I arrived 6 hours early and checked out 1 hour late, the female receptionist - I think the hotel only has 2 receptionists - was very enthusiastic in supporting. Not to mention I booked an extra night because I had to stay overnight. She also helped me change rooms very thoughtfully. Because the room I was staying in was already booked by the next guest. However, she helped me move the room from the 2nd floor to the 3rd floor so that I could move my luggage more easily. I was very satisfied with the receptionist's thoughtfulness even though she did not proactively tell the guest that she moved the room from the 2nd floor to the 3rd floor because of that. The receptionist on the evening shift was also very okay, helpfull and very respectful of the guest) In terms of personality, I rate 10 points! The hotel room is also very clean (I noticed the housekeeping lady cleaning the other rooms, she cleaned very neatly. Not to mention she is also very enthusiastic and friendly!), the room space is airy and the air conditioner is very cool, even though the hotel has been in operation for quite a long time, I am satisfied with the way the hotel is maintained and taken care of to bring a good experience to guests. Besides, although this hotel is located in the central area of District 1, the space is very quiet and not noisy, the soundproofing between rooms is also very good. Regarding transportation, major tourist attractions, large shopping centers and hospitals are all within a radius of 1-2km and very easy to get to; you can walk to save money, or if the sun is hot, take a taxi, it will only cost 20-30k. The hotel is also very close to the offices of major bus companies in SG, very convenient to transfer from the bus station to the hotel and vice versa; very convenient!!! Finally, if you are looking for a place that is cost-effective and has adequate amenities, clean rooms, and easy access to locations in District 1 and even other districts of Ho Chi Minh City, I highly recommend this hotel ✨✨✨✨✨

I booked a night here, thinking it would be noisy near the airport but I didn't hear any airplane noise at all. The room was spacious and clean. In the morning I even made myself a free cup of coffee, very chill. If there are any activities nearby next time, I will book a room here again.

Top notch hospitality and worth the money for the price you paid. Staff super duper good and responsive, room super comfort, bed super fluffy and not to mention the food is finger licking good. Definitely recommend it!!
Great hotel and reasonable prices. Clean rooms and very helpful staff. Highly recommend!

hotel_name: Express by M Village Nguyen Du

Very good service, thoughtful service

hotel_name: Yen Nam Hotel Nguyen Thai Son
review_text: There is nothing to complain about, the hotel is beautiful from the outside to the inside. Easy check-in, fully equipped and luxurious rooms. Because of work, I have to come back many times, will definitely book again.

hotel_name: Apec Wander Hotel - Near Tan Dinh Market, District 1
review_text: The reception staff were lovely and very helpful. The room was new, smelled nice, the bed was comfortable, the water pressure was strong, and there was minimal noise. I would definitely stay here again if I have the opportunity.

service ok, room clean, will come back

This hotel is great, located on a busy street, staff is friendly, treats me and my friends very nice, will come back here for next business trip.

hotel_name: The Bloom Pham Viet Chanh - Modern Living Space in Saigon - Unbeatable Offer with Flight

The food is great. Very near to the airport. The room is clean, and the staff are very respectful and attentive to our needs.

Great place! Will be back!

Rooms are spacious and airy. I like the bathroom the best. Attentive staff, if not, call the receptionist to solve it very quickly and friendly. Near the hotel, there is a delicious noodle shop, convenient for traveling.
The room is beautiful, spacious like the photo, fully equipped, reasonable price. The staff are enthusiastic, lovely and thoughtful
The hotel is clean. Very okay. Next time I will continue to stay. Room is very comfortable
Friendly and enthusiastic receptionist. Clean and beautiful hotel, near the beach. Reasonable price.
The 2nd time coming back, the hotel is clean, fully furnished, near the center. Quiet space, friendly staff.

New hotel, beautiful, fully equipped, especially the breakfast is super delicious, lots of dishes to fill the stomach. Next time I go to Ha Long, I will definitely come back.

review_text: Spacious room, very convenient to stay with the whole family. But because we live in Hon Gai, if we want to go to Sun World and the Fire Beach, we have to drive quite a distance. The parking space has to be outdoors so that's not very satisfactory.

hotel_name: Condotel Halong Apartment - Green Bay Towers
review_text: Great experience staying there.
Ok, everyone, try this 3-star hotel with affordable prices

The hotel is very clean, the staff is enthusiastic. Central location in Hon Gai, easy to move around and many delicious dishes around

Coto Eco Lodge is a great place to rest, relax and meditate. Early in the morning, we invite each other to the sea to watch the sunrise, breathe in the fresh air of the sea and then return to the Ecolodge porch, practice yoga in the soothing meditation music. The landlord and sister lent the kitchen to cook, the kitchen was neat and clean with all kinds of pots, pans, dishes, spices, so each of us created a dish, making a colorful tray of rice. Ecolodge is delicately designed with lots of cute little corners, and we choose a corner for each of us when the afternoon falls, a cafe corner, a reading corner, a music corner, a wandering corner… Love our vacation, love Coto Eco Lodge

The whole team consists of 12 people from 3 regions of the country to stay. Although only 1 night, but the host is extremely hospitable, agile. Clean hotel, professional service.

Nice view, very convenient location very near amusement parks, beaches.
The hotel is clean. The owner is friendly. I will come back when I have the opportunity to go to Ha Long.

New hotel, spacious, clean and airy. Very satisfied! The location is suitable for young people because they have to walk 10 minutes to get to the center. Homeowners are very enthusiastic and happy! Definitely come back to the hotel if coming to Ha Long!
Staff friendly and helpful. Room is clean and spacious. Will definitely come back if I come to Ha Long again.
Clean room, friendly staff, enthusiastic support
Clean hotel, comfortable rooms and nice surrounding. Compared to the price, it is a reasonable hotel to rest on business trips or travel.

The hotel staff were enthusiastic and helpful, and check-in times were quite flexible (early check-in is possible if rooms are available). The rooms were clean, well-equipped, and comfortable. The hotel is located opposite the beach, making it very convenient for activities such as swimming, sunbathing, and dining. There are also many amenities, restaurants, and convenience stores in the surrounding area. It's very suitable for couples or families on vacation.

We had a big group staying at Oyster Bay Hotel and the staff was very friendly and courteous to us. That made part of our experience wonderful. The rooftop pool was great for the kids and adults. The rooms were clean and comfy and the AC works. Thank you for a great experience.
A wonderful holiday experience, very satisfied with the hotel and staff.

hotel_name: The Imperial Vung Tau Hotel & Resort
review_text: Imperial Hotel Vũng Tàyou exceeded all my expectations—from the stunning architecture to the exceptional level of service, everything was truly top-notch. Every staff member was warm, attentive, and genuinely cared about my experience, making me feel truly valued as a guest. The room was impeccably clean, beautifully decorated, and offered a breathtaking view—I felt like I was living in a dream. This is hands down one of the best hotel experiences I've ever had in Vietnam—thank you, Imperial Vũng Tàyou, for making my stay so memorable.

A short vacation but left a deep impression on my family. Quiet and cool space, many activities for children. Enthusiastic, thoughtful, friendly and cheerful staff. Rooms are airy and clean. Will definitely come back soon.
The hotel is clean and beautiful, 4-star standard, the staff is super cute and enthusiastic. The breakfast is delicious and varied. Very satisfied.
I was very satisfied with my experience here; everything from the people to the rooms was wonderful, clean, and well-equipped.

Annata Beach Hotel is a great choice for families with young children. Its location is very close to the beach, just a few minutes' walk, making it convenient for recreation and relaxation. The rooms are clean, airy, well-equipped, and safe for children. The staff are friendly, helpful, and enthusiastic. The atmosphere is quiet and perfect for a relaxing vacation. There are many amenities nearby, such as restaurants and convenience stores. My family is very satisfied; we've stayed here four times and will definitely return in the near future.
Nice room, nice view, helpful staff. Great for relaxation and resting all day
The beachfront location is extremely convenient, and the reception and staff are very friendly and polite. I am very grateful to the hotel.

hotel_name: Holiday Inn Resort HO TRAM BEACH by IHG
review_text: The overall services are good, from the shuttle bus from HCMC, quick check-in, good food at the restaurant, pool for kids, many places for photo shooting, clean and comfy rooms, my kid liking the corridor way. There are many nice places internally. We also ate out for one dinner at a nearby seafood place, taking a taxi for 10 minutes. Good short 1 night stay for family with kids.

hotel_name: Marina Bay Vung Tau Resort & Spa
review_text: Marina Vung Tau is truly a place to "escape" from the hustle and bustle of city life 🧡 The resort is spacious, airy, and very clean; everything from the rooms to the grounds is meticulously cared for. The feeling of relaxation is immediate upon entering. My favorite part is the stunning sunset view; sitting and watching the sun set by the sea in the evening is incredibly relaxing and peaceful. The atmosphere here is truly resort-like, gentle and private, perfect for resting and recharging. The staff are enthusiastic, the service is good, and overall, it's an experience worth returning to when visiting Vung Tau 🌅
My first experience here was fantastic. Everything was great, nothing to complain about.
The hotel has a prime location, lovely and enthusiastic staff, especially receptionist Thanh. Thank you hotel for giving us a wonderful honeymoon
Spacious room, great view and service. Overall a good experience and I would recommend this hotel to my friends.

Just 2 hours away from HCMC, so very convenient for a couple’s or family’s weekend getaway. Another plus is the super decent buffet breakfast offered in the room charge (which is usually enough to cover lunch as well to us), so couples who do not want to take a 2-hour ride on a motorbike/car can just hop on a shuttle bus in HCMC and get dropped right at this resort, spend the whole weekend here without having to worry too much about where to get food nearby. Also, you can do a wide range of activities from dining, swimming, riding a bicycle, etc., here in the resort itself. Do note that this beach-side resort is actually a little far from the nearest residence area to walk on foot, so if you plan to travel around, come in a car/bike, or the hotel can help you with motorbike rental.

I had a very good experience at Fusion Suites. The hotel's location is convenient, right next to Xom Luoi market, within walking distance of famous banh khot shops and salted egg sponge cake shops. The room is clean and airy, the breakfast is delicious and quite diverse. The swimming pool on the 20th floor is very clean and beautiful, the staff is friendly and professional.
Friendly and enthusiastic staff, clean rooms, close to the beach so very convenient, the food here is delicious, no need to go anywhere else. 10đ
The staff is extremely friendly and enthusiastic. Today I checked out and received a weekend gift, there is nothing to complain about. The room is very clean. Everyone should come and experience it.

The room here is beautiful, spacious, clean. Fully equipped. The good thing is that it is near the front beach so you can walk to the beach, near the hotel there are many restaurants and convenience stores. The price is reasonable, it is worth staying for the price.

The room is beautiful, neat, clean, has a super cool view, very suitable for virtual living, hunting for the sun, welcoming the dawn. Exactly as illustrated and described. The staff is enthusiastic and cheerful from the security guard to the reception desk. The breakfast buffet has many Vietnamese dishes that I like, suitable for my taste. I booked a Riva double room on a high floor. The area of 40m² is spacious and comfortable with plenty of space for my children to play. The price is also reasonable, not too expensive. There is a welcome fruit plate, which is also a plus. The only minus point is that the wifi is unstable, it goes out when you are using it and then comes back. I will come back next time 💯
Suitable for relaxing weekend. Clean and quiet room. Good service. My family will come back next time.

hotel_name: Ho Tram Beach Boutique Resort & Spa
review_text: Quiet and cool space, classic style room, clean swimming pool, enthusiastic and friendly staff
Friendly and enthusiastic staff, delicious food, clean rooms. My family had a great vacation and was satisfied with the hotel service. We will come back again when we have time.
We had a wonderful time, this hotel is very nice and located just beside the beach. Service and restaurant are also excellent.

hotel_name: DIC Star Landmark Vung Tau Hotel & Apartment
review_text: Clean, convenient, close to the center, from the security guard to the staff are friendly. My whole family is very satisfied.
Absolutely wonderful. Beautiful room, full amenities, friendly and enthusiastic staff, diverse and easy to eat breakfast buffet. 9/10 points
The staff were very friendly and helpful. I had a great stay.

The hotel is very ok, everyone should experience it. The room is very nice, clean, quiet, I really enjoyed it when I was pregnant and went on vacation. The breakfast buffet is quite diverse, but refilled continuously on weekends. Friendly staff. Right on the central road, very close to the back beach, just outside is a convenience store. The quality is worth the price.

hotel_name: Milan Homestay - The Song Vung Tau
review_text: My trip was not planned at all. When my parents wanted to visit Vung Tau, I immediately went on traveloka to find a room to stay for the trip. I read a lot of reviews and experiences of everyone and decided to choose Milan Homestay. I arrived 30 minutes early and checked in 10 or 15 minutes before. The receptionist welcomed me very naturally, gently and thoughtfully. My room was on the 5th floor, near the entrance to the children's pool so my baby loved it, the elevator was also very convenient. Next time I visit Vung Tau, I will definitely choose Milan. Great🥰🥰🥰
too okie, friendly staff, beautiful hotel and delicious food

The first thing to praise is that the staff here are extremely friendly, cute and professional. Trang (Lucie(?)) checked in, Thuan helped with luggage, room service (I don't know the name) set up food for me on the balcony so that night I had a very chill meal. And Thuong did my checkout very friendly and professional, she suggested that I register for Banyan Tree membership to get a massage voucher and a drink voucher so that after I checked out, I wouldn't get bored waiting for the bus back to Ho Chi Minh. Oh, and the staff at the breakfast restaurant too 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻. All the staff at the resort smiled brightly at the guests, very professional. The room was clean, spacious, fully equipped, had a balcony overlooking the sea and the swimming pool.

Clean room, friendly staff. The hotel is close to many places to eat, about 10 minutes walk to the beach, when checking out I forgot something and the receptionist enthusiastically helped me send it back. I will come back to the hotel if I have the chance.

This is the second time I have returned to ibis styles hotel. Receptionists Khoi + Dat are very supportive, detailed and cute. The room is clean, the balcony view is very nice. The colors are youthful and dynamic. The restaurant staff serve well and support customers enthusiastically. I had a wonderful vacation and will definitely come back if I come to Vung Tau.
Clean rooms, reasonable prices, need more variety in breakfast buffet

The cheerful receptionist actively supports guests, the swimming pool is clean and beautiful, the room on the left side has a pretty nice sea view, the buffet breakfast is okay within the price range are the advantages. The downside is that the room is quite old, a bit cheesy, the TV only has TV without internet, the view room on the right looks right at the temple opposite the Guan Yin statue, making it seem uncomfortable. Also a place worth trying.
Staff is enthusiastic and cute. Room is clean and comfortable. Very satisfied. Will come back here again.

I really like Angsana Ho Tram, the staff are friendly and lovely, I really like the sauna in the room. My husband, I and our 4-year-old daughter had a very memorable birthday vacation, the resort even sent a birthday cake to my room

In the evening, there are also movie screenings and an integrated outdoor play area for children. Angsana clustered with Dhawa Hotel is a very suitable place for small families

Everything was great. The rooms were spacious, clean, and beautiful. The swimming pool was extremely clean and large, including a saltwater pool. The staff were friendly, professional, and sincere. The breakfast was varied, and every dish was fresh and delicious.
Super enthusiastic, clean room, reasonable price, the guys there are extremely enthusiastic and cute, the hotel is right in the center, many convenience stores and eateries around so it's great...

Affordable hotel for a 4-star hotel, nice rooms, clean, nice sea view, close to Tam Thang tower, next to it is a mini supermarket on the left side of the hotel, across the street is the park and beach, this place is not too crowded, very wonderful, friendly and lovely staff
The quietest comfortable rest in VungTau
The room is very nice, the staff is friendly and enthusiastic. If I have the chance, I will come back again. 10/10!

The space is very suitable for families with young children and the elderly, lots of trees, entertainment areas: game room, 1 saltwater swimming area, 2 freshwater swimming areas, outdoor and indoor sports areas, pickelball court, tennis court, movie theater with weekly schedule, statue painting area, paintball, ... organic vegetable garden right at the resort to serve guests. The staff is very polite and enthusiastic. It is worth the experience, and if there is a chance, I will return to Carmelina.

New hotel, clean rooms. Everything is great. My family stayed in a room with a balcony facing the mountain and the road view was very airy, cool and beautiful. The hotel has nothing to complain about. Next time I go to Vung Tau, I will still come back here.
Rented a room here 2 times already. The uncle and the hostess are friendly, the rooms are spacious and clean. Next time you will come back Vung Tau. 10 points

The magnetic lock door is easy to open, and automatically locks when I close the door so it's very private. I hope everyone will have the same experience as me.

The room is beautiful, looks very new. It's clean, has a dryer and an electric kettle. Great location, close to the beach, close to entertainment places. Very satisfied, I will return to the hotel when I come to VT🌷💗
Enthusiastic attentive staff, clean room with fruit, delicious restaurant food, good service security. The hotel near the sea is very convenient to go to the dining street
The room is beautiful, clean like the picture, close to the beach, the owner is very cute, if I have a chance I will stop by again

Every time I call the receptionist to ask for more towels or bottles of water, they arrive a few minutes later. The staff is never grumpy or complains, always polite and greets gently - small things but make guests feel respected.
Friendly, enthusiastic staff. New, clean, beautifully decorated rooms. Location near Dinh Co beach, convenient to move to nearby attractions. Extremely satisfied and recommend everyone to try it.
The support staff is extremely enthusiastic, the classic white decor style is very luxurious, the room is soundproofed well, great experience!!

review_text: Great service staff, convenient location, clean rooms

Clean room. Staff polite, friendly.

Clean hotel, friendly staff
It exceeded my expectations, it was amazing, everyone should stay here, I will come back!

Choosing here was the right thing, next year when I come back to visit my aunt I will continue to stay at this hotel. Breakfast is delicious, room is clean and quiet, receptionist and driver are friendly and lovely.
everything was great, everyone was happy and friendly, right in the center. New room, clean, spacious and airy. Reasonable price. I will come next time

The hotel told me to run out of rooms, so I upgraded my family to the resort without any cost, the facilities such as Spa, breakfast remained the same. clean, the staff is quite cute and enthusiastic, near the sea, quite satisfied.
Fantastic place! The hotel has its own beach. Food is tasty and cheap for the quality. Staff are very friendly and helpful. Will come back.
The room is so good for the price, the receptionist and cleaning lady are so cute, everyone 🥹💕 will come back when I visit Vung Tau
The staff is very friendly and enthusiastic, ready to support customers in any case when needed.
The hotel service is quite good, the staff is happy and takes good care of the guests.
The rooms were new and fully furnished, and the reception staff and owners were very attentive. The hotel has a pantry for evening meals. It was a truly memorable stay at Yen Luxury Hotel.

hotel_name: Havilla Homestay -  The Song Apartment Vung Tau
review_text: Fully furnished in comfortable beautiful room

The hotel facilities are old but still quite well-maintained and suitable for the price, with full amenities. The location is near entertainment areas so it is convenient to move around. Will come back if there is a chance.

First time here but I'm really satisfied with the location, clean and comfortable rooms, staff and receptionists take good care of guests, food and drinks are quite to my taste. I will definitely come back next time. I give the hotel 1000 points.

Thank you Anthony and the hotel service for being very dedicated in proactively sending me the hotel's location and information. The price was very good and when we arrived, we were upgraded to a better quality room, free mineral water, and easy and convenient transportation. This is an ideal vacation spot for those who want to save money and enjoy freedom!
Friendly staff, large-nice-clean swimming pool, delicious food at Maison. The only downside is that the air conditioner is installed next to the room so it's quite noisy.
I had a wonderful 3 days 2 nights stay here, the staff was friendly and lovely. Overall 10 points, I will definitely come back if I have the chance.
Location by the sea, convenient. Large swimming pool, small swimming pool area, safe. Room is spacious, clean, staff polite, enthusiastic. There is ample parking space. Here I am very satisfied.

The hotel is facing the sea, just walk across the street and you can swim. Near full amenities sthi GS25, hingland, Phuc Long. The room has a very stable price range, has a swimming pool view, delicious breakfast buffet. Good service, Enthusiastic staff. Overall, I will book again in the future when I go to Vung Tau

The hotel is in an easy-to-find location, quite close to tourist attractions. Near the market but my room was on the 5th floor so it wasn't too noisy early in the morning, and it was easy to wake up if you're a light sleeper. Clean and convenient but there were cockroaches in the room. Every day, 1 bottle of water/person is provided, 2 bottles for a room with 2 people. The furniture is all new. Will come back next time.
Very good room price, nice room, clean, odorless, receptionist is cheerful, thoughtful, enthusiastic, check-in is fast. Very worth the experience when coming to Vung Tau.

The hostess is very nice. The single room is clean, quite ok, but the soundproofing is a bit poor, guests walking outside the corridor still have sound. I just took a look at the price on weekdays, only 350 will come next time.

I really like this hotel. Everything is very spacious and clean, reasonable price. The receptionist is also very enthusiastic. The room is spacious and the bathroom has a strong water flow and the shower is really enjoyable. I will recommend it to my friends next time.
Everyone from the management to the staff is very friendly and welcoming. Thanks a lot, see you again.
Beautiful room, lovely staff, great hotel near the bougainvillea view, will come back again

The hotel has a beautiful landscape, a combination of mountains and sea, it can be called a resort, a beautiful swimming pool, large rooms and good hygiene, breakfast has few dishes but is delicious because there were few guests that day so it was not possible to cook many dishes. The wooden interior of the hotel has not been well maintained, the quality of the cleaning is okay, it needs to be improved for better hygiene quality. It is a good choice if you need a quiet place to watch the sea and rest, will come back when the opportunity arises, hope the hotel is well maintained and does not deteriorate over time.

The room is clean and new, the staff is also enthusiastic. But the hotel style is liberal. There is no security at night. The hotel is equipped with car locks and password door locks for each individual room. If you often overthink, consider it 😅. I found the area to be safe and quiet. Convenient to go to the back beach or front beach without having to go too far. Opposite the alley is Russian Donut. Walk and buy some delicious hot food.
Cheap hotel and good service, worth the experience

hotel_name: Poulo Condor Boutique Resort and Spa
review_text: With luxurious villas next to the swimming pool, fresh campus, stunning views, quiet atmosphere from the smooth white coastline next to the majestic mountain rocks. Rooms here are very large, comfortable, very nicely decorated and fully furnished. Me and my friend find it interesting here. The staff at the Resort are very polite, fun and friendly, helpful help. Breakfast here is very delicious and attractive. The rich menu is a great thing. From the Resort, there is a shuttle to and from town to visit and play. Poulo Condor Boutique Resort and Spa is a place to choose.

We came here for 2 nights and were very satisfied with the homestay. The room was clean, cheap. The staff was very nice and enthusiastic. We were really satisfied and will come back next time we come to VT.😊
The owner is friendly, enthusiastic, cheerful, the room is fully equipped, clean, near the back beach. Reasonable price, will come back if I have the chance.

The room was clean, new, and smelled pleasant. The owners were friendly and enthusiastic. The location was convenient, easy to get around, and close to restaurants. I would definitely stay here again next time.

review_text: plus points: spacious, airy room, friendly staff, suitable price minus point: bad smelly bathroom Overall OK, if I come back to Vung Tau to travel, I will also continue to come back to the hotel this!
The hotel offers a pleasant experience. The staff is enthusiastic and attentive. The rooms are clean, comfortable, and the sea view is especially impressive. I am completely satisfied.
The hotel is clean, the front desk staff is very enthusiastic and cute. Very satisfied
A clean hotel is a great thing. full facilities. Happy reception. See you one day soon.
The staff were very polite, the room was comfortable and very clean, and the bed was soft. 10/10, nothing to complain about.
Because of the good service and beautiful rooms, full facilities, I will also choose to experience here many times in the future.

review_text: The hotel is clean, the room is nice, the hotel owner is enthusiastic and cute

The hotel is beautiful and clean. Next time I come, I will definitely come back
Friendly and enthusiastic staff, clean and airy room, near the beach. Next time I will continue to book a room here.
Good hotel! Clean, early check-in. Enthusiastic reception.
Friendly, enthusiastic, extremely lovely staff. Clean rooms, beautiful view, very worth the experience.

The hotel is very comfortable. Worth visiting every time I go to Vt. The staff is enthusiastic and dedicated until I get in the car and leave. From cleaning the room to security. The two security guards are enthusiastic and funny in the morning and evening, taking care of the guests. Reasonable price, clean room.
The owners are cute and enthusiastic. I booked on the app so the price was only about 200k for 2 people. Next time I come here, I will definitely stay again 🩵🩵🩵

The hotel is spacious, beautiful, modern design, friendly wooden furniture, not flashy. Quiet area. Near the beach. Comfortable parking. It is convenient to drive 5-6km to the center by motorbike. The swimming pool is beautiful, clean, and there is no smell of bleach after bathing. Surrounded by dwarf coconut trees, cool and impressive. Enthusiastic staff, good room rates.
Great stay at Golden Rose, clean hotel, convenient location, extremely enthusiastic staff. Room is available so ready to support guests check in early

hotel_name: Nguyen Ha Hotel - Gần Bãi Sau, Vũng Tàu
review_text: I went with a family of 2 adults + 1 baby. Should choose a room with 2 double beds to stay on September 1, 2 and 3, check out. When guests checked out, the owners cleaned immediately and called me early to check in. The room and toilet were clean. From the hotel to the back beach is super close. To the front beach is about 1km, convenience store 200m. Worth the experience. And I will definitely come back ❤️

Clean, beautiful room, fully equipped. Great location. Quiet but close to the beach and square. The receptionist was extremely nice and enthusiastic. The only downside is that the toilet doesn't have a bidet.
The hotel is very attentive, comfortable, the staff is very enthusiastic
The room is clean, good, the staff is enthusiastic and attentive, thank you Maya for the good experience and see you again ❤️

Spacious and comfortable terrace suitable for BBQ. There are many restaurants and convenience stores around. The location is also close to the sea. Generally satisfied. Next time I have the opportunity to go to Vung Tau, I will definitely continue to support.

The hotel is located near Back Beach (200m from the hotel). The hotel has reasonable price, clean. The room is not too big but the space is just enough and the interior looks good. What I like most is that the owners are very friendly and enthusiastic.
Everyone in the hotel is cute and cheerful, good service 10d, convenient location, near the Xom Luoi market, the food around the hotel is delicious, good car rental service, reasonable price.
Hotel near Vung Tau back beach, easy to find, easy to go. Spacious room, lovely staff 🥰🥰🥰
Too great. Enthusiastic staff. Clean and airy room. Also received a small gift when leaving. Will come back soon😍

Rooms are spacious, airy, clean, fully equipped in room.
Location near beach and beach front.
Staff friendly and support when asked to put car help, good advice.
My family goes to 03 families, the trip is very good.

review_text: These are sublet apartments, so the interiors are high-quality, spacious, and well-equipped, just like a luxury hotel but at a surprisingly low price. I was very satisfied. The room view overlooking the swimming pool and the entire complex is extremely beautiful, at night you can even see the sun wheel sparkling from afar - my child loves it!

✅ Rooms: clean, fully equipped, soft bed, cool air conditioning and especially has a private balcony, very chill at night.

✅ Swimming pool: many separate areas, including a water play area for children. My child played on the slide, splashed water for hours without getting bored. The adult pool area has relaxing loungers, very comfortable.

✅ Breakfast: quite good, many dishes suitable for both adults and children (my favorite is pancakes and stir-fried noodles 😋).

✅ Location: convenient for traveling to Safari, VinWonders, Grand World, or simply walking along the beach is also very close.

✅ Staff: polite, quick support, creating a friendly and comfortable feeling.
🌈 CONCLUSION
A very suitable place for families with young children who want to relax. Children can play safely, mothers can rest gently. If I have the opportunity to return to Phu Quoc, I will definitely choose this place again! 💙

hotel_name: The Shells Resort & Spa Phu Quoc
review_text: Nice resort. Staff are very friendly and helpful when I want to heat my food. I also like the peaceful view.

hotel_name: Muong Thanh Luxury Phu Quoc Hotel
review_text: The staff is very friendly, enthusiastic and supportive. There is a free electric car for sightseeing, a clean swimming pool, and well-equipped rooms.

hotel_name: Premier Residences Phu Quoc Emerald Bay Managed by Accor
review_text: So great, got a free ticket to see the Kiss of the Sea show and fireworks worth 1.4 million. Khem beach is beautiful and calm, 3 year old can swim freely. The place for children to play is clean, spacious and diverse.

hotel_name: Venice Hotel Phu Quoc - Free Airport Shuttle & Sunset Town Tour
review_text: I had a great experience at Venice Hotel. I had some minor problems with booking a room but the staff were very helpful and friendly. The hotel was cozy, the food was delicious and the room was very clean. Thank you very much Venice Hotel.

The rooms were spacious and clean, and the breakfast was delicious and plentiful. The swimming pool was large, the beach was beautiful, and the staff were enthusiastic and attentive. I will definitely come back again.
The service here is excellent. The staff is very passionate about their profession. Thank you Melia for giving me such a relaxing stay

hotel_name: The Palmy Phu Quoc Resort & Spa
review_text: Talking about the room, I stayed in a sea view room. The balcony view is large and beautiful. There are 3 swimming pools and 1 next to the sea. It's great. The staff is friendly and enthusiastic. You can watch the sunset here because of the view to the West. But there is one thing I'm not very satisfied with: the central air conditioner doesn't run smoothly and cool quickly, but it's not too bad. The TV doesn't have internet, so it's almost unused. Overall, at this price, it's worth the experience ❤️ if I have the chance, I will still trust this place.

I would gladly stay here again. Staff were friendly and accommodating and were able to speak in English when I talked with them. Was able to rent a scooter through them simply and even when the scooter needed servicing, I was able to reach out to the hotel for assistance. The grounds are maintained very well and every day there were numerous staff cleaning and making sure everything looked great. Stayed in an overwater bungalow and the room was perfect for me. Air conditioning worked well and had all the amenities I needed. Breakfast was delicious with lots of options and the food served at other times was good and not overpriced compared to places nearby. All in all, an amazing place I would gladly stay again.

hotel_name: InterContinental Hotels PHU QUOC LONG BEACH RESORT by IHG
review_text: That incredible moment. The hotel was great, the room, the view, the pool, the food, everything was extraordinary. Also, the rooftop bar. Amazing vibe and view. The staff also very helpful. Not enough just stay 1 night there.

The hotel is right next to the entrance to the night market, in front of the hotel, a 5-minute walk to Dinh Ba and Dinh Cau, the scenery is absolutely beautiful. The room I chose had 1 single bed and 1 large bed, but the staff saw that our family called in advance to inform that 3 adults and 3 large suitcases would come first to leave their belongings and then go out, so they were extremely thoughtful and cute and arranged the largest available room. When we arrived, we checked in early. The staff created the best conditions and the attitude of all 3 staff members Hung, Hien, Kha, who worked the morning and evening shifts there were all very professional and friendly. I would like to sincerely thank Hotel Varia and the staff there once again for creating conditions for my family to have a very enjoyable experience there. If I have the opportunity to return to PQ, I will definitely choose Varia as a stopover and companion! 💝
I just had a thought here. The staff is supportive and gentle. Breakfast buffet has a variety of delicious dishes. Eating in the restaurant is also reasonable, not too high. Worth the experience

hotel_name: Sunset Beach Resort & Spa - Beachfront Pirate Fire Show
review_text: High-quality dining with a relaxed island vibe. We ate at the hotel’s main restaurant twice and loved it both times. Fresh seafood, beautiful presentation, and a great wine list with knowledgeable staff. The rooms were spotless, comfortable, and came with amazing sea views—an overall excellent experience.

hotel_name: Sonaga Beach Resort & Villas Phu Quoc
review_text: Great place to stay ! They are still building at the back of the complex but the beach front and rooms are silent and peaceful ! The rooms are luxurious and staff are friendly !
The receptionist was very enthusiastic, the room was also ok

The owner is enthusiastic, friendly and very supportive of our family! 
The back door of the room opens to a view of the sea, very relaxing, suitable for families who want to travel and relax.

I had a great night here! 
Especially loved the bed and the open bathroom 
The view from the restaurant to watch the sunset was excellent 
Thank you to all the resort staff for giving me a great experience
The room was clean, the location was strategic, foods were nice, and the staff was friendly.
My wife and I had a wonderful vacation at Pullman!

Villa is located next to a quiet, spacious lake, shuttle service from the villa to the lobby and vinwonder is quick, about 5-15 minutes after calling. Friendly and enthusiastic worker. On-time and comfortable airport shuttle support. There is also a safari and grand world shuttle bus with a frequency of every 30 minutes. We do not have to pay any additional transportation costs when coming here. Breakfast is also very diverse.

Nice hotel, clean, comfortable room. Nice swimming pool and beach. Friendly staff, good buffet breakfast, change dishes every 3 days, especially cakes of all kinds. Hotel location is convenient to walk to his palace, Bach Dang park, night market, Kien Xay noodle soup, restaurants Out of the sea… very close. In front of the hotel, there is a free bus route to Safari, grand world, vin wonders. Ticket service, shuttle bus at the hotel lobby to entertainment spots at reasonable prices, fast too. In addition, the hotel also has a free shuttle service to the airport. Will come back and recommend to friends and family 😊

hotel_name: JW Marriott Phu Quoc Emerald Bay Resort & Spa
review_text: I really like the service here, the view is beautiful, the staff is nice and polite, the food is good, I will come back here a lot more

A truly wonderful experience. All the staff are professional and friendly, greet you as soon as you meet them, speak fluent English, even the cleaning staff are very good at English. The rooms and views are beyond words, very luxurious. The breakfast buffet is diverse, suitable for my family's taste.
The room was very clean, the staff was friendly and very helpful. They delivered us to the bus stop free of charge in a buggy. It was truly a great hotel.
The room is spacious, modern, new equipment. Enthusiastic staff, high standard service!
The receptionist and all hotel staff are very cute and enthusiastic. I am extremely satisfied when using the hotel's services!🥰

hotel_name: Ocean Bay Phu Quoc Resort and Spa
review_text: Great stay, staff from Reception, Bellmen, to Service extremely friendly, delicious food.

hotel_name: Sailing Club Signature Resort Phu Quoc
review_text: The resort is very beautiful, spacious, luxurious, very good from the service to the front desk, service, and shuttle. If you want to eat or go to the night market, it will be a bit far. Resort has super beautiful Truong beach, 100000 points, will come back again.
Everything here is very good, the rooms are clean, airy, the view from the room to the surrounding area is very beautiful, it is worth recommending to others.

hotel_name: Tom Hill Boutique Resort and Spa - Sea View
review_text: The hotel is small and beautiful, clean, cute campus, friendly staff, the food on the day I went had few customers so few dishes but at that price range it was good.

The hotel is very clean, fully equipped with a dining room for cooking. The living room is for watching TV and entertainment. Just like at home. The swimming pool is clean and very enjoyable. The staff is very friendly. If I have the chance to go, I will stay here again.
The reception is friendly, the room is clean, the design is beautiful, the view is also beautiful. Near the sea, near the market, … In short, the experience is very ok!

The hotel has a large, airy campus with many trees, bringing a cool and pleasant feeling. Room was spacious, clean. On the ground floor, there is a direct door to the swimming pool, which is very convenient for those who are lazy to walk to the beach. Breakfast is somewhat simple but enough basic dishes, desserts and water. Next time will come back and recommend to friends.
Beautifully designed room, convenient location to go to the night market, breakfast is not many dishes but delicious, swimming pool has a beautiful sea view

hotel_name: Sheraton Phu Quoc Long Beach Resort
review_text: Great service and friendly staff. Kudos to all team for making our stay memorable.

Very friendly Front Office staffs including the male receptionist & the bellman. A very kind gesture from the bellman when he asked us to be careful when walking up the stairs since it was slippery after the rain.

Resort beautiful rooms, beautiful swimming pool, extremely friendly and cute staff. Bold Thai style. The food is pretty good. Especially Pac Thai, fragrant fried rice. Kakaka. Eat delicious morning coffee and change dishes every day. Tks all

I love everything about this hotel. the room ambience, friendly hotel staffs, location, size of the room and it comes with a bathtub! I stayed here for 2 nights and it was wonderful! I would definitely recommend this hotel. they also have coffee shop downstairs with the same vibe aa the hotel room and their coffee is good!
Clean, new room, mountain view, near the center. Food is okay, more dishes than expected for this price. Will come back if I have a chance to go to Phu Quoc

The hotel is full of trees and the front desk staff is friendly. Pros: Reasonable price, clean and big swimming pool, near Duong Dong town, green space; there is support for early check-in if available. Cons: Some rooms have mosquitoes, walk to the beach for 5-7 minutes, it's okay in the morning but still simple. If I recommend it to a friend, I will definitely recommend it!

hotel_name: Riverside Mini Hotel Grand World Phu Quoc
review_text: The hotel room is clean & comfy. It is near the Water Taxi Venice and the water show. A lot of restaurants and spas are nearby the hotel too. Mr. Loi and other staff are very friendly and accommodating. Mr. Loi has also helped us to book car transportation to the airport in the early morning with a good price. Will definitely stay here again next time when we visit Phu Quoc! Thank you for the great service!
The owner is very enthusiastic and friendly. Room is clean, fresh. Motorbike rental available. There is a very smart reception dog
Room with beach view, very cozy, and very clean. Staff is very friendly and informative.

hotel_name: Roma Hotel Phu Quoc - Free Airport Shuttle & Sunset Town Tour
review_text: The staff is friendly, the rooms are very comfortable, aesthetically pleasing, and clean. The amenities are complete, and the view from the window is excellent, with views of the ocean and the cable car passing by. The front yard of the hotel is also aesthetically pleasing for taking photos or making videos.
Great vacation with the service attitude and space here, green trees, next time I have the chance I will still choose Mvillage ♥️

Thank you An Phu hotel staff for my time spending in Phu Quoc. The staff was friendly and provided excellent service when I was there for 5 short days. I will definitely highly recommend it to all my friends and I will be back again soon.
Very fond of the campus here, many trees, beautiful beaches. Rooms are clean and comfortable. Enthusiastic and attentive staff. In short, ok!
The hotel owner is very sweet and enthusiastic. Rooms are clean, fully equipped and cleaned every day. If I come back, I will consider choosing this hotel first 👍👍

The staff were friendly and provided excellent customer support. The rooms were beautiful, well-equipped, and the amenities were high-quality. The location was convenient for visiting attractions. I will recommend it to my friends when they come to Phu Quoc.
The hotel is new, clean, the location near the pier is convenient for getting on the train. Will come back if there is a chance
Very good. The staff and the owner are very enthusiastic and take good care of customers. If you come here with a group of friends and prepare grilled food, you will definitely chill all night.

Nice and clean rooms, free mineral water is served every day, full of personal hygiene tools from the smallest simple thing, newly built everything is new, I am quite surprised because it is worth the price. Good service, reasonable price, right in the center so it's very convenient, walking down the hall is to the night market which is always bustling and fun. Especially, the staff is very easy-going, happy, coming to greet and talk to guests enthusiastically, especially Mr. Long, serving enthusiastically, whatever you need, he is there. Next time I have the opportunity to come to Phu Quoc, I will definitely visit and stay. Note that the room is usually full and clean, so please book early before you come, don't let the room run out because the service is good and the location is very convenient.
Conveniently located, walking a few steps is a seafood restaurant Off the coast, 300m from the night market. Breakfast okie with 3 star hotel

Amarin resort & spa phu quoc has cared for and taken care of guests very well: calling guests before arrival, organizing airport pick-up and drop-off at the airport when returning, guests who arrived on their birthday were given birthday cakes and candles by the resort, the resort staff are very hospitable. Amarin phu quoc is a place worth staying when traveling to Phu Quoc pearl island

hotel_name: Paralia Khem Beach Phu Quoc Hotel
review_text: This is a hotel that I really like, near the sea, beautiful sea, convenient to move around. Breakfast is normal but main meals are cooked well. Staff is enthusiastic and friendly. This hotel is located next to large 5* areas so it has many amenities. I will come back and recommend it to my friends.

The hotel is beautiful, outside the lobby there are many beautiful photo corners, the warm water swimming pool is very suitable for adults and children. Polite, enthusiastic staff Location near star beach, convenient shuttle tram Recommended to book here

Cheap price, enthusiastic owner, there is a beach behind for the kids to go snail hunting, which is fun. You can cook for yourself, right off the road there is a whole seafood market that is super cheap to buy and cook for yourself at the hotel.

hotel_name: The Tahiti Beach Hotel Phu Quoc
review_text: Highly recommended!! The hotel is new and beautiful, the equipment in the room is ok, the staff is enthusiastic, they support me to check in up to 3 hours earlier than the check-in time. However, the breakfast buffet in my opinion is a bit small and the seasoning is not very good compared to other parties, the view of the breakfast room overlooking the sea is very beautiful. Overall 9/10, will come back if I visit Phu Quoc next time.
Lovely owner, the hotel is located in the center of Duong Dong, right in front of Tran Hung Dao, easy to move, ok price.
Room is spacious and comfortable. The resort has many green trees and is airy. Watch the beautiful sunset. Enthusiastic and friendly staff.

hotel_name: Sun Viet Resort Beach and Spa
review_text: Great! I like the hotel for food and beautiful rooms.

Thank you Rosy Hotel! The hotel is very comfortable, early check-in is also allowed 😍 The room has a direct view of Kiss Bridge, no effort to see the view,, Thanks to Nancy who was super humble & helpful! Surely will come back again when I'm visiting PQC 🫶😊

Beautiful, clean hotel. New and luxurious interior. Especially the staff is very enthusiastic and friendly, supporting guests wholeheartedly. Breakfast is diverse and delicious. My family had a great vacation.

hotel_name: Moc Lam Homestay Grand World Phu Quoc
review_text: The service is the best, the owner is very helpful.. The location is close to everywhere.. Best hotel in Phu Quoc! ❤️ I will come back here again with my 3 children..
Newly built hotel. Clean. Price is very ok. Right on the main road so it is easy to move
Friendly enthusiastic reception, clean, quiet, comfortable rooms. Suitable for contemplation.

I booked a room on the occasion of April 30 - May 1. The room was clean and spacious, the owners were enthusiastic and friendly. I like the quiet space of the hotel and the bedroom. If I have the opportunity to go to Phu Quoc next time, I will also want to book this room again.
One of the cleanest hotels on the island. I will definitely come back again.

The hotel is spacious, beautifully decorated, clean, as shown in the picture, the staff is very friendly. I feel quite comfortable at the hotel, but going to the amusement park and taking pictures is a bit far, I went during the epidemic. Recently, the hotel does not have a free pick-up/drop-off service at the pier and airport as described. The whole cost of moving is quite high, it is recommended that you rent a motorbike to visit many places and save money.

hotel_name: Ann Hotel & Spa Khem Beach Phu Quoc
review_text: My 2 night stay was great, the hotel is very close to the sea, the beach has clear blue water and is very calm. The hotel is beautiful and very new, great service

hotel_name: Famiana Resort & Spa Phu Quoc - Complimentary Airport Shuttle
review_text: Wonderful place with a friendly staff and tasty food. My mom has some problem in movement but they still help her as much as possible. They also provide a nice view of the beach and the location is near many places.

hotel_name: Teddy 108 Homestay & Cafe - Grand World Phu Quoc
review_text: Spacious, near the sea, convenient for visiting the North Island and Vin's amusement park. The hostess is enthusiastic and supportive. The homestay is spacious, has an air-conditioned lobby, convenient for communal activities. The room is clean and fully equipped.

Except for the slightly remote and far entrance, everything else at Maison is very beautiful, very wonderful. The campus is large, with lots of cool green trees, many fruit trees, a large, beautiful swimming pool, and delicious breakfast. The bungalows are large, beautiful, private, and quiet. The back gate of the resort is the stone table stream, which is very cool in the summer and has clear stream water. The resort also has a BBQ garden, which is great for relaxation. I will choose Maison again for my next trip to Phu Quoc.

hotel_name: Salinda Resort Phu Quoc - Sparkling Wine Breakfast
review_text: I am having a pleasant and comfortable stay even though it is the rainy season here. Friendly staff, warm welcome. Breakfast at Salinda is also very satisfying. Attentive service and amenities make me want to come back here again and again

It's clean here, the breakfast buffet is delicious, vote 5*. Right in the center, easy to get around and take the bus to go out. Clean swimming pool with sea view. Next to the resort, there is a bar a few steps away. Last night the chill stopped happening, the cute receptionist reminded guests of their flight. 100 VND if I have a chance I will come back and tell my friends ❤️
Room is spacious and clean. Convenient to travel in Cable Car and An Thoi area.

Beautiful view, convenient location for checking in at sunset town locations, the hotel has motorbike and electric car rental services, the staff and owner are very enthusiastic, the rooms are clean and airy.
Nice clean room. Thoughtful supplies and service. The receptionists are very enthusiastic and happy. Breakfast menu is very rich. My family and I are very satisfied for the past vacation here.

hotel_name: Green Bay Phu Quoc Resort & Spa
review_text: The resort is full of trees, clean sand, suitable for those who love nature. The location is quite far from the center so it is suitable for families who want to relax.
We had a comfortable and pleasant stay here. Very convenient location, beautiful beach, spacious rooms, many cool trees around. Breakfast is also delicious. Very happy to have a good experience here.

I forgot to take a picture of the room. But the room is like the picture, brand new, clean, has a balcony that is very chill in the evening, overlooking the sea. The owner is super friendly and easy-going. He let us check out 1 hour late to wait for a taxi without charging any extra fee. They also rent motorbikes here, so when you arrive, just tell him and he will rent one for you. ^^
The support staff is very enthusiastic, even though we arrived a few hours early, they still helped us check in. The room is near the beach, clean and airy, with a spacious parking lot.

Nice clean room, affordable price is only 173k/night, enthusiastic staff and owner, room view is the Effen Tower in the distance, you can see the sea, the hotel is close to the night market, very convenient to eat and drink, right at the beginning of the alley next to the bus stop. Tahiti hotel bus is convenient for traveling from the airport to the hotel and from the hotel to the grandworld safari area, vinwonder....
Clean up near the place to buy train tickets Phu Quoc Nam Du and Hon Son. Good boss happy to re-calculate soft prices.
Very enjoyable experience here, everything was fast and quality. Lucky to have interesting stories with the host. Will definitely come back when visiting Phu Quoc next time.

The hotel is located right across from the pier so it is very convenient. The staff is friendly and enthusiastically guides you through the hotel's amenities. Motorbikes for rent at the hotel are only 35k/day, single bicycles are free. There is a free taxi to take you to eat or to the pier. Overall, the service is 10/10 points.

The hotel room is exactly as described, very clean, and every day someone cleans the room. Prices are very affordable. The hotel has motorbike rental service. Will continue to come here when going to Phu Quoc

New and clean Rooms have spacious facilities Fragrant towels Have a bathtub Good attentive customer service Early check-in support The hotel's area is right in the center and near markets so it is very convenient for special shopping - HT seafood
Everything was great, the staff were friendly and pleasant, the amenities were complete, it was very close to the airport and the city center, and I would definitely come back.

hotel_name: Rosie Hillside Seaview Phu Quoc Apartment
review_text: Booked a room with a sea view to propose and watch the fireworks, which was extremely beautiful. The room was spacious and beautiful, overall very satisfied. Reasonable price

We stayed at Kim Hoa Resort in Phu Quoc for 6 days and 5 nights. Overall, it was a pretty nice experience. The location is great—the beach is just in front of the hotel, so it’s very easy to access. The resort also has pools, which is a plus. Surprisingly, even though it was a holiday, the place wasn’t crowded, which made it more relaxing.

The only downside during our stay was the weather—it rained almost the whole time, so we couldn’t really enjoy the beach as much as we wanted. But of course, that’s not the hotel’s fault.

The staff were okay and accommodating, and the breakfast was decent. Most days it was a buffet, but on one day we had to order instead of buffet—still fine and satisfying.

All in all, a comfortable and peaceful stay. Would recommend if you want a beachfront resort with a calm atmosphere.

Small, beautiful hotel. Family-style management, the owner is very cute. Spacious and comfortable room. There is a swimming pool and cool trees. If I come back to Phu Quoc, I will definitely choose Ambedo

The attentive and friendly service of the staff left a deep impression on me. I was particularly pleased with the cleanliness and comfort of the room. The breakfast at the restaurant was also delicious and varied. I will definitely return and recommend this hotel to my friends and family.

hotel_name: Tahiti Central Sea View Phu Quoc Hotel
review_text: Hotel near center, cheap, breakfast ok for the price.
Great! The reception was fun, enthusiastic, the room was clean, airy and spacious. Next time, I will continue to stay in my room at Hong Bin
New hotel, clean, well located, comfortable, very comfortable stay.

hotel_name: La Veranda Resort Phu Quoc - MGallery Collection
review_text: Enthusiastic staff, accommodation has a private beach to watch the sunset, very chill. A worthy choice.

The staff at the hotel are super enthusiastic. Mr. Nam at the reception desk is extremely lovely. Beautiful space in the center. There is an airport shuttle. All tours booked by the hotel are okay in terms of both experience and price.

Friendly and enthusiastic staff. Top-notch amenities. Too good for a 3-star hotel. 
I ate breakfast 4 days, 3 days rated 8/10 and 1 day rated 10/10. 
Swimming pool near the beach, with a bar
Motorbike rental is good, with built-in phone holder
Enthusiastic luggage support staff
Beautiful room, fully equipped with amenities. 
A great experience.

hotel_name: Su Casa Phu Quoc Long Beach
review_text: My wonderful holiday here. The apartment we booked was fully equipped with cooking utensils including a microwave. The beach was very clean and beautiful. The swimming pool was only 300m walk from the apartment. The staff were very happy to welcome me and enthusiastically supported. Free shuttle buggy service around the area. Near the bustling Sonasea night market, Spa, supermarket...
Very great, rooms and surrounding area are green, clean, beautiful, delicious breakfast, chill..., friendly staff, swimming pool and cafe
The room is clean and small, much narrower than in the picture,. Suitable for backpacking and then sleeping. Families with small children are not very suitable

This is a great resort for people who like nature and simplicity. - All staff at all stages are enthusiastic and welcoming - The scenery is poetic. The garden has been meticulously cared for - the restaurant is next to the pool, minimalist and sophisticated design. Whether it's day or night, the restaurant still has a romantic atmosphere. Will come back when the opportunity arises

hotel_name: Teddy 96 Homestay and cafe - Grand World Phu Quoc
review_text: The owner and aunt are very cute, the room is clean, beautiful, and fragrant. Home uses grapefruit shampoo and conditioner which I really like. The owner and aunt enthusiastically let me borrow the pot and induction cooker to use the kitchen space. Next time I come back I will definitely stay at home again, it feels like I'm really at home
Hotel near crowded center, easy to move to south and north of the island, clean room, enthusiastic receptionist

Enthusiastic staff, resort with many trees, very beautiful and comfortable. Swimming pool with sea view, there is a restaurant next to the beach but it was during the big wave season so the restaurant was closed. The food at the resort is delicious.

The room is clean, spacious, like the picture, sea view, less than 1 minute walk to the sea. Free breakfast, very delicious buffet. Because the room looks like the picture taken by the hotel, I didn't take it.

My group of 6 people went to Bao Phuc Hotel to stay 2 nights, the hotel in the center, by the pedestrian street. The receptionist, named Ton, enthusiastically supported the information as well as arranged for the group to stay at the hotel. I will recommend to my friends if someone has a chance to go to Phu Quoc.

I have been to Phu Quoc many times but this is the first time I am most satisfied with the bedroom in this Grand World area, everything is very ok, the owner is friendly, the drinks and coffee are delicious and the prices are ok, recently they sell full breakfast, the rooms are clean, fragrant, modern and new equipment, and the prices are extremely friendly, I will definitely come back here ❤❤

3km from the night market, there are many western and Vietnamese restaurants around. Convenient to move. Located in an alley, so it is very quiet, has a clean swimming pool, enthusiastic service staff. The minus point is that the old car rental needs to be checked carefully, I went to the 2nd day to change the car because the problem did not come up. The rest are all great.
The space of the resort is very wonderful (quiet and in harmony with nature). Clean room, friendly staff. There is a private beach that can be used for swimming and watching the sunset
Beautiful and quiet place for family vacation. Friendly staff.
Resort clean, quiet. Very convenient to go to Night Market, Dinh Cau. Also a good choice
The staff are very cute. Clean room, with a spacious swimming pool. Thoughtful service. Next time I go to Phu Quoc, I'll stay here again. The price is cheap 🥰

Identical room, clean, comfortable. The hotel always burn citronella oil, very pleasant, Breakfast is also very delicious. The staff are polite and friendly. I checked out at 12am, but the hotel still supports the airport at 16h. Anja is definitely a perfect choice for relaxation.

Great hotel, friendly staff. The room is as pictured, and especially extremely clean. Although it is a wooden floor, there is no dust at all. Only one small minus point is that the old room door is a bit difficult to open and close. Breakfast has many delicious dishes and is quite tasty. The location of the restaurant is next to Hello, so if you want to eat, you can come and eat.
Rooms are spacious, airy, private beach area, Walk along the beach to the Blue Bar Beach Club. Entrance area many convenience stores. Near Vinpearl Safari pick up point
Nice room, open space, clean.

hotel_name: Hula Hula Beachfront Phu Quoc Resort
review_text: Nicely new resort in town with professional services. Resort is covered with relaxing green trees and room is decorated with modern styles. Totally worth it!

The hotel is super nice. The staff is enthusiastic and helps me a lot. The space is spacious, has a balcony so it is very airy. The room is clean and fully equipped. This is probably my favorite place among the hotels I have stayed in.

Very satisfied with Nadine resort, from the owner to the receptionist, and the cleaning lady are all very enthusiastic and cheerful. When I have the opportunity to return to Phu Quoc, I will definitely continue to support Nadine. I stayed in a Deluxe room with a garden view, but the view was of the swimming pool. Because I went during the epidemic season, it was quite deserted, the resort still served very attentively. The swimming pool is quite large, enjoy swimming. There is a shared kitchen space for everyone to buy seafood to cook if going in a large group. The resort's lights are yellow, creating a cozy space (although I prefer white lights). The TV is a bit old, not a smart TV, can only watch cable channels. In terms of location, it is very close to the center, quite convenient for traveling and eating.

Best hotel in Phu Quoc ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I stayed in Triland for 3 days, I’ve no complaints about the hotel. All the hospitality was very good, the place was beautiful too, you can see the sea from the window in your room and also watch fireworks at night. The location was in downtown near the nightmarket, beach, and many other attractions around. There was a motorbike rent in the hotel so it was easy to go everywhere by motorbike. The price was cheap as it compare with the view, the room, the facilities, and also it included for breakfast too. There were some menu that you could choose for the breakfast, If you are Muslim you’d better choose beef pho (Halal).

Nice hotel, spacious comfortable rooms, enthusiastic support staff. The location near An Thoi port is suitable for a tour of 4 islands. Nice view from the rooftop bar. The service attitude of the bar staff is good. The hotel offers free airport pick-up/drop-off one way to or from the airport. I was so busy playing that I forgot to take a photo of the review. Suitable for short stay.

The room is nice, all according to the picture, across from the hotel there is a night market and supermarket so it's not a hassle if you want to buy something and there are many restaurants and cafes around it is very strategic. Also near the beach can be walked
