Personally, I just learned from the local that with this range of price I can have another option from a resort right at Mui Nai beach. Till next time then
Enthusiastic staff. Rooms are clean and airy

hotel_name: Nam Nghi Coral Peninsula Phu Quoc
review_text: Staff is very friendly and fun. The place is beautiful, the room smell is very pleasant. However, the food is not good, not diverse, not worthy of the 5-star level
New, wide, with balcony, modern gym. In the central position, in front of the hotel there are always taxis, motorbike rentals, restaurants and cafes. Breakfast is not buffet.
Spacious room, with many amenities such as fridge, super speed kettle, dryer, safe ... good for rent. Quiet space, just 2 km from Sao Beach. I'm happy about the experience here.

hotel_name: Muong Thanh Luxury Nha Trang Hotel
review_text: When checking out, I forgot my wallet, vehicle registration and money at the hotel, the staff returned them all to me. When checking in, my family went with a large group and had a small child, the staff were very enthusiastic in welcoming and helping us. Thank you for your enthusiastic service.

hotel_name: Vinpearl Empire Nha Trang, Affiliated by Meliá
review_text: After this trip, we officially became big fans of Melia! We booked 2 suites for 8 people, were supported with early check-in and quick check-out, the room had a beautiful view overlooking the sea, the room was neat and clean, the staff was super friendly! We were also introduced to receive Melia voucher points of 200k and used them in the hotel area, everything was so nice, there was nothing to complain about, when going to Vinpearl area, we also got to go to priority queue, supported with Vinbus tickets ^^ I love Melia hihi

Nice view. You should rent a room with a sea view. The room is cheap, beautiful, clean, and cleaned regularly. The staff is super friendly, always asks about guests, and recommends many places to eat and play. I will come back here next time 💗💕

hotel_name: Muong Thanh Grand Nha Trang Hotel
review_text: The staff named Kieu was very enthusiastic and quickly changed rooms when there was a problem in the room. Attentive and friendly service.
Really worth the price! Breakfast is delicious! The location of this hotel is just perfect! Would love to stay again when coming back to Nha Trang :)
The hotel is clean, with daily cleaning staff. modern equipment. Breakfast is a bit poor

Friendly, enthusiastic and attentive staff
You should try the experience. I have been to many Vinpearl hotels but this is the most satisfying hotel experience

hotel_name: Muong Thanh Luxury Vien Trieu Nha Trang
review_text: Great hotel, beautiful beach view, one side mountain, one side sea, most beautiful at noon
Best hotel in the middle of the city. Room with both city view and sea view! There are 3 floors to serve delicious breakfast. I will definitely come back on my next trip to Nha Trang

Thank you so much, Muong Thanh Hotel! My family stayed for two nights on April 30th and May 1st during the holiday, and everything was great. The staff were enthusiastic and friendly. If I have the chance to return to Nha Trang, I will definitely choose to stay at this hotel again.
When coming to Nha Trang, my family always chooses Vesna. Clean and beautiful rooms, friendly and enthusiastic staff ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Will come back here, beautiful view, friendly, polite and thoughtful receptionist.

My family had a wonderful holiday in Havana. The hotel had a very safe underwater tunnel for children, and the check-in and check-out process was extremely quick. The breakfast was varied, abundant, and delicious.

The room is very clean, luxurious and smooth. There are so many delicious dishes. The receptionist, room service and security are quite professional. Extremely chill with just a few steps to the beach.

Great hotel, I arrived quite early but the staff still helped me check in early because I had a small child. The hotel was clean, the staff was friendly and enthusiastic. My room had a beautiful sea view. The breakfast was also quite delicious and to my taste. Overall, I will book again when I have the opportunity to come to Nha Trang.

The room was very clean, and the sea view room was very nice. The hotel was right across from Hon Chong beach, which had many locals swimming and was not as crowded with tourists as the beach in the city. The space was very chill.

My stay at this resort was a memorable and fulfilling experience. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the lush, tranquil surroundings and the harmonious blend of nature and modern architecture. The grounds were meticulously maintained with many trees, a lake, and beautiful relaxation areas. The rooms were spacious, clean, and fully equipped. The balcony overlooking the garden was a big plus, allowing me to enjoy the fresh air every morning. The beds were comfortable, providing a relaxing feeling after a long day of fun. The resort's service was very professional. The staff were friendly and enthusiastic, especially the South African manager who was always ready to assist when needed. The pool area was clean and airy, suitable for both adults and children. In addition, services such as the spa, restaurants, and bars were all of good quality, especially the diverse and delicious cuisine. Overall, this is an ideal choice for those seeking a relaxing getaway, close to nature, and with quality service. I will definitely return in the future.

My family has stayed here since December 14, 2024. I am very satisfied and like it. The hotel is clean. The receptionist is kind and very friendly. The view is beautiful. The breakfast is delicious. Thank you. If I have the opportunity to go to NT again, I will still choose Melisa hotel to stay again.

hotel_name: Best Western Premier Marvella Nha Trang
review_text: 6 days 5 nights vacation at the hotel was great, delicious breakfast, location near the beach, attentive staff

hotel_name: Vinpearl Resort & Spa Nha Trang Bay
review_text: 100% perfect holiday. We had a very relaxing time and the service was perfect.
My 3 days 2 nights experience here was wonderful. If I come back to NT, I will still visit the hotel again. Thank you very much.

hotel_name: The Empyrean Cam Ranh Beach Resort
review_text: My room has a view of the sea, the scenery is always beautiful. The staff is enthusiastic and cute. When I went on the weekend, although it was crowded, I was still enthusiastically supported.
Convenient location. Car parking available. Enthusiastic staff. Clean room. Worth staying.

More than wonderful. The receptionist and the security guard on duty on October 19 supported my family very well, because we had a small child and had to check in quite late. The rooms were clean, quite spacious and comfortable for a beach trip in Nha Trang. This will be the place for my family to stay on the next trips 😊😊

This location offers unparalleled convenience, just a short stroll from the beach. The friendly staff enhances the experience, making you feel welcome and at home. A team member, in particular, deserves recognition for their exceptional service. This combination of location and hospitality creates a truly memorable stay. I highly recommend this place to anyone seeking a relaxing getaway. Lastly, I would like to say thank you to Ms. Thoa.

Surprisingly good location. It's near to everything. This is the first time my family chose a condotel instead of a hotel. The kid loves the pool, very close to the beach. Highly recommend for families with kids.

I came during Tet, right in the center so the feeling of the hustle and bustle was great. It is an extremely ideal place to watch fireworks. My daughter kept talking about this place, and kept asking to go again. Next Tet when I come to Nha Trang, I will come back to stay here again.
The receptionist is super nice, she helped us a lot with checking in and out. Really helpful!

hotel_name: Diamond Bay Resort & Spa Nha Trang
review_text: Worth staying, suitable location for relaxation, good service
Well clean room. Good job! Fast and good. Well done to housekeeping team. We love it. Towels are clean, amenities sufficient. The front desk and breakfast staff were very helpful!
Great location with good facilities. Breakfast from the hotel offered a good variety, too. Can park your car in front of the hotel, so it was very convenient for car travelers.

hotel_name: Selectum Noa Resort Cam Ranh (Unlimited Access Water Park)
review_text: The rooms were clean, fragrant, and well-equipped. The staff were enthusiastic and lovely. This is the first time I've booked a resort I've been so satisfied with.
Absolutely wonderful, friendly staff, delicious food, clean swimming pool with no chlorine smell, my 9 month old baby had no problem bathing even though he has extremely sensitive skin
I had a pleasant stay here. Beautiful resort, especially the private beach is great

The room booked was a city view, but when I checked in, the sea view was very satisfactory, no extra charge. The food was delicious. I will come back and recommend it to everyone ^^. I wish the hotel prosperity.

The vacation at Xavia Nha Trang Hotel with Ut It was truly memorable and extremely enjoyable! ❤️ All the staff here are very enthusiastic, from the reception to the dining room, making us feel extremely comfortable. In particular, I would like to thank Mr. Tran Phu Long - always friendly, enthusiastic and supportive. Will definitely return to Xavia Nha Trang in the next vacations!
Everything in this resort is totally great, it is a perfect place to relax and heal after stressful days
The hotel is clean and beautiful, the staff is friendly and enthusiastic. There are many activities for children to play. My family has been here many times and still likes it and wants to come back.

Our family had a great experience at The Anam. Green nature harmonizes with red tiled villas and 3 large swimming pools with clear water. The sea is clean and clear, swim out to the deep water and still see the bottom of the sea. Attentive staff, always smiling. The kids club has many interesting activities and changes every day. This is an ideal family getaway. We will be back with more members.

hotel_name: Nha Trang Marriott Resort & Spa, Hon Tre Island
review_text: Marriot has a beautiful sea view, the staff is very enthusiastic, friendly and professional. Small but necessary needs are met quickly and sufficiently.

The hotel is great, the rooms are spacious, beautiful, clean, the smallest room is 45m2, very suitable for my family. True 5-star standard. Friendly staff, enthusiastic support. 
Diverse and delicious breakfast buffet.

My family had a great experience at the resort. I have a 5 month old baby and received all the priority. Friendly staff, delicious food, compared to the price and quality of the food I think it is quite good. The room is beautiful, airy, clean, friendly staff. I will come back to the resort again if I come back to Cam Ranh.

hotel_name: Pax Ana Doc Let Resort & Spa
review_text: A beautiful peaceful resort, the staff from reception to service, driver are all enthusiastic and friendly, the services and amenities are all very good!
My family has stayed here many times, the resort is very clean, the staff is professional and enthusiastic. The breakfast buffet is very delicious. Will definitely return to the resort.
Nice room, spacious and good quality at a cheap price. Motorbike rental is quite convenient.
clean hotel, delicious breakfast, polite staff, very satisfied with room upgrade, will come back next time

The hotel has a long, clean and beautiful beach, friendly staff, very good quality and delicious breakfast. The hotel has many amenities, many swimming pools, children's play areas and other activities such as water bikes, kayaks, yoga, game clubs, cinemas... The hotel's service is very good and thoughtful, we held a wedding here, the price is much lower than other places, the service is very professional, Alma helped us have a beautiful wedding, a happy vacation. Highly recommend

Stayed 5 nights at Starcity hotel—1st impression was a warm welcome from the security team, and the front desk team were so friendly it actually made me extend my stay. Thanks all you guys made my stay in Nha Trang so enjoyable 🫶 My 1st room was pretty nice already, but since I’m sensitive to dust and smells, Ms. Thắm (the manager) insisted on finding me a more comfy one—and she really did! Thịnh at the front desk was always smiling and patient helping me switch rooms, really appreciated your care. The housekeeping team did well cleaning the room & added thoughtful touches. Felt totally at home 😉

The hotel is very clean and beautiful and the reception staff are very polite and friendly, they enthusiastically supported me when I booked the wrong date, the cleaning staff also cleaned the room carefully. 5* for this hotel!
Really satisfied with the service and function at the hotel. Very worth the experience. Total VND 9.5 for the hotel.
The receptionists are friendly, the hotel is clean, comfortable, and has a pleasant aroma; the food is delicious and varied. I will come back next holiday.

hotel_name: TTC Van Phong Bay Resort - Himalaya Sauna & Steam Retreat included
review_text: Friendly and enthusiastic staff.
The hotel was very clean, quiet, and had a beautiful view. The receptionists, Tien and Kim, were very polite and lovely. It was a true 5-star hotel. I will definitely come back here again.
The staff were very friendly, enthusiastic, and welcoming. The rooms were clean and well-equipped. The location was convenient, near the Agarwood Tower and right in a bustling dining area.

hotel_name: An Lam Retreats Ninh Van Bay
review_text: Good service, beautiful scenery, value for money. The housekeeper is attentive and enthusiastic.

hotel_name: Titan Hotel ( former Golden Lotus Central)
review_text: Central location, reasonable price.
Great, if I have the chance my family and I will continue to choose this place. The staff is very friendly, the room is clean, spacious and beautiful!

hotel_name: InterContinental Hotels NHA TRANG by IHG
review_text: Great experience… We will definitely be back… Very attentive staff… Delicious breakfast… Right in the city center… Nice and clean rooms… Love it

hotel_name: Senkotel Nha Trang Managed by NEST Group
review_text: Spacious room, clean, friendly staff. Location near the beach, near the square, near the night market so very convenient for walking around at night.

My family had a great summer vacation in Nha Trang. This is the second time I stayed at Aaron Hotel. The room was clean, centrally located, the staff was polite and enthusiastic, and included a delicious breakfast. I will continue to book a room here for my next trip to Nha Trang.

I booked a city view room but the hotel upgraded it to a 1/2 sea view room for free. The room is new, clean, beautifully designed, fully equipped (even with an electronic scale which surprised me)
The receptionists were very nice and enthusiastic when my family needed help with adding an extra bed for the baby, the hotel has an essential oil diffuser which is very comfortable.

Overall, it is worth the money. Everyone can experience it here.
The hotel is clean, beautiful and quiet. The staff Chi and Hung are very nice and friendly. Great experience!
The hotel has a nice view, friendly staff, enthusiastic customer support. Good price. Will come back if I have the chance.

My family stayed at Ibis Nha Trang for 4 nights, I stayed with a view of the sea and right on the stage. The hotel is comfortable and clean, the staff is friendly and attentive to guests, there is nothing to complain about. The hotel's location is very convenient, you can walk because it is right at the night market, there are many restaurants, cafes and services around... 10 points according to my feelings.

* First of all, I highly recommend this place. Because the staff is so cute. 
* Check-in was at 2:00 p.m., but because I arrived early (11:00 a.m.), you were still very enthusiastic in helping me check in early. 👉 This alone is probably worthy of 5 stars. 
* The hotel room is clean, fully prepared with towels, meticulous and thoughtful. 
* The room has a balcony with a pretty airy view, located in a quiet location. 
* From here, it's very close to the beach. It's probably only 200m from the beach. 
* Next time I come back, I will continue to book here!

The hotel staff is very friendly and enthusiastic. I stayed on the 16th floor, the room had a large round bed, a balcony facing the sea and a direct view of the sea to watch the sunrise, and the moon at night was very beautiful. The breakfast buffet was delicious. The rooftop has a swimming pool and a small gym. Walking to the beach is very close and convenient. A truly memorable vacation!

hotel_name: Wyndham Grand KN Paradise Cam Ranh
review_text: The villa here is great. Although it is a bit far from the beach and it takes about 10 minutes to get to the villa from the gate, everything here is worth experiencing. Will come back again if I come to Cam Ranh.

The hotel is beautiful and luxurious, located near a very convenient intersection, a short distance from the beach and square. The swimming pool and bar on the top floor of the hotel have beautiful sea views.

We booked two nights at Rigel Hotel. We arrived a bit earlier than the check-in time, but the front desk kindly let us check in early at no extra charge. I really appreciated that. The staff were super friendly and helpful. They also offer motorbike rentals at reasonable prices.
Breakfast was perfect, you can basically find anything you need there. The room was spacious and very clean, with hot water always available. If you’re looking for a nice hotel at a fair price, I’d definitely recommend this place!!!

The reception and dining staff were extremely friendly and enthusiastic. The breakfast buffet was delicious and kept constantly warm. The rooms were clean, well soundproofed, and included a TV360, along with strong Wi-Fi. The location was convenient, close to Cam Ranh airport and many restaurants nearby (only a 5-minute walk).

10 points for the hotel. Small, cute room, enough for a family. Clean, cool. Enthusiastic and friendly staff. The hotel is near the beach, about 5 minutes walk to the beach. The alley is a bit small, only 4-5 seats can fit, but 7 seats or more should be considered. Will book again next time because I am so satisfied.
A pleasant comfortable short stay. The quality of the facility is quite good and comfortable. Staff are very welcoming

The hotel is better than my family expected. The rooms are spacious, neatly arranged, clean, convenient, the balcony has a drying line after swimming in the sea. The breakfast is not to my taste but it is okay, the breakfast view is chill. The room price I booked is quite reasonable so I will come back when visiting Nha Trang

Every time I come to Nha Trang, I stay here. Everything was perfect, especially the breakfast buffet was delicious. The staffs are enthusiastic and lovely hehe especially you have a sign called Sunny hihi

Luxury is a completely different experience from other places on the island. If you want a quiet, relaxing resort, you should choose Luxury. The staff is very enthusiastic from the reception to the departure. Because the number of villas is not too much, breakfast is also more comfortable. When taking the tram, you don't have to jostle like other places. A very valuable and worth-the-money experience for my family when staying here for 2 nights👍

hotel_name: Champa Island Nha Trang - Resort Hotel & Spa
review_text: Thank you for always being enthusiastic and supporting my family to have a wonderful vacation, thank you to the pottery lady, she is very enthusiastic and cheerful.
This is a perfect place to relax after stressful days. My experience is totally perfect without any complaint.
Clean hotel near the beach, enthusiastic staff.
It's so great a 5 star hotel, the staff is very nice everyone, the service is impeccable, the view is beautiful, good value for money. Will come back with this luxury view.
Okay, deserted, quiet. I don't know if it's during the off season, but when I go in and go out, I don't see anyone. Room is spacious, clean.
Staff are enthusiastic and attentive. Rooms are neat, clean and comfortable.

hotel_name: Happy Light Central Hotel Nha Trang
review_text: The room is very nice, clean as advertised, located in the bed can also look to the sea, the location should center around so there is everything. It really exceeds expectations compared to the amount spent. The only exception of the hotel is the rooftop swimming pool which is not clean probably due to few bathers so no investment. Next time to Nha Trang will still book here
The hotel is conveniently located near the beach. It has a beautiful sea view. The rooms are spacious and clean. The staff are friendly and helpful.

Hotel design is very nice, brand new, and the staff is very accommodating. They upgraded my booking to a suite room. The room is with very wide windows and a nice bathtub. Location is in the center, very accessible to all the stores, restaurants, and the beach. May Cafe in the lobby is really good with many nice drinks and a surprisingly affordable price. Wide choices of room service menu and again very affordable. 10 out of 10 without a doubt. Highly recommend!
Friendly, enthusiastic staff, attentive service, beautiful hotel, great to have been here
The front desk receptionists are very helpful and always smile to the customers. Friendly and warmly like at home. Surely will come back once visit Nha Trang again.

Quiet space, close to nature, extremely comfortable. During the chill day in the singing of birds, none of the resorts can be found outside Ninh Van Bay. Breakfast but birds are also free to dance around. Great service and service, from welcoming guests to seeing off guests. The food is delicious
Excellent, great service, attentive staff.
Cheap hotel, nice interior, clean. I am very satisfied.

Hotel staff are cheerful and friendly. The owner enthusiastically recommends delicious places to eat in the area. The hotel is right next to the beach, very convenient for people who like to swim. Small, pretty room, comfortable enough.
The bedroom is very good! The room is clean and thorough, the night shift receptionist is quite enthusiastic and cute!

The hotel is in the alley, a few steps to the beach. The price is cheap but OK, the hotel is clean, towels are changed every day. There are restaurants, grocery stores, souvenir shops, massage parlors, and hair ties around. There is a car rental service. Vinpearl is also close, a few steps to the Vinbus bus stop with a route straight to Vinoearl. In general, OK, OK, everyone. The two receptionists also supported wholeheartedly.

Good experience overall. The staff provided excellent service with warm hospitality. The room was cozy, tidy, and perfect for a relaxing stay. The location is very strategic, with easy access to shopping malls and local food spots.

Hotel staff are friendly and helpful. They gave us the room before check-in time and helped to keep our luggage in the early morning when we arrived. Also, you could ask them for help with bike rental at a good price too.
Clean room, good food, near the beach
Great. The hotel is suitable for the price. nothing to criticize!
The hotel has very good service, free cake every day, free airport shuttle, 1 lobster hotpot meal, breakfast... Great for the price of 3 nights!

hotel_name: Fusion Resort Cam Ranh - All Spa Inclusive
review_text: Fusion left me with an impression of a private and luxury retreat. It's a true valued spend. Spa and dinner are included in the room price. Very well wine choice in the drink menu. Food is so delicious. Fusion has always been my top of choice in Cam Ranh, will definitely come back.

hotel_name: GM Doc Let Beach Resort & Spa
review_text: Beautiful beach hotel, clean, quiet very suitable for relaxation. I'll be back.

hotel in the city, about 350m from the sea. Walk to the beach, not far away. clean room. I stayed 4 nights. The room has a balcony overlooking the outside very much. The receptionists are very enthusiastic, introduce me to island tours, help me buy tickets to Vinwonder, rent motorbikes to help my family discover tourist attractions in Nha Trang. I had a great vacation. Thank you so much Starlight

hotel_name: Emerald Bay Hotel & Spa Nha Trang
review_text: I just went to Nha Trang for 4 days and 3 nights. I looked at many hotels and finally chose here. I have to say that there is nothing to complain about. The room is just right, beautiful and clean, the bed is very comfortable, there is a breakfast buffet every day. The location is opposite the sea so it is very convenient to go to the beach to swim. The staff is friendly and enthusiastic, especially Tuyen and Uyen. I will come back here next time.
Easy check in. Room was clean and overall it's excellent. Friendly staff and nice ppl.
Hotel with nice view, nice room, reasonable price. Central location. Swimming pool is a bit small but super nice.

The staff are happy, comfortable, and supportive. The hotel is luxurious, the rooms are a bit small but the sea view is beautiful. Swimming pool is a bit cold. Pool view ok. Delicious, complete breakfast. Service ok. Location near the sea. In general feel comfortable to stay. Should try 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
Great, good service, friendly staff, cheap price, full amenities.

Cheap hotel, suitable for budget travel, quite clean, near Vinh Hai market, near the beach, many nice cafes, friendly receptionist, elevator, free drinking water, free hot water, free bowls and chopsticks in the dining room. However, the satellite house lights are dark and the wifi is weak, often intermittent. Overall, 4 stars compared to the quite cheap price.

The hotel is in a central location, convenient for traveling, swimming, shopping. The breakfast here is very delicious, the room is beautiful, the hotel staff from the reception to the room service are all very enthusiastic, friendly, and open. My family and I are very satisfied.
Staff are very friendly and enthusiastic. Rooms are clean. Breakfast buffet is diverse, delicious, and suitable for taste.
Hotel The Light Hotel is very good. I am completely satisfied and appreciated the items voted for this hotel

My family had a wonderful stay at the hotel. The biggest impression was the staff who were extremely enthusiastic and always ready to support. In particular, Trinh Van Hoan left a deep impression thanks to his thoughtfulness and professionalism - thanks to which we felt very comfortable during our stay. 

The hotel is located on a small street, so the sea view is somewhat limited by the surrounding buildings. However, the location is still extremely convenient, only 2~3 minutes walk to the sea - very suitable for those who want to enjoy the sea air every day. The room rate is reasonable, worthy of the quality of service. 

My family will definitely come back here on the next trip.
10/10 for hotel . Very nice seaview studio room. The price is very reasonable and the hotel owner is very nice.
Clean hotel, close to the center. Convenient to move. Enthusiastic staff helps with car rental. Only places to eat. Cheap. Will come back if I have a chance.
Great! Reasonable price, attentive service.

The hotel is located in a central location, very convenient for travel. Although my room is a bit small, it is full of amenities and has a view overlooking the outside. Our group of 4 people, check in also midnight, but you Hung receptionist is still very enthusiastic and thoughtful. The next time I visit Nha Trang I will be here again, 4 stars but the price is too soft. I really like!

The hotel is really great. After 5 days of relaxation here, I feel very satisfied. Reasonable price, facilities are very good, space inside and outside the hotel is also very nice and comfortable. Especially, the view and the space are extremely easy to live virtual: D The staff are super enthusiastic and special support is fast, do not need to wait too long this is something I appreciate. In addition, the hotel also supports more services such as booking assistance to Vin Pearl land at the front desk, tours, fast and affordable car booking, I am very thankful to you. for newcomers who come here for the first time as I have this support, I don't know where to go and save a lot of time and money. Next time if you come to Nha Trang Joy Trip is still my first choice.
convenient location, reasonable price. enthusiastic and lovely staff. Will come back again 😍
Nice location and convenient, central to center, good service.
The bedroom is clean, I was able to change the room size for free. The staff here are extremely cute. very thoughtful

Staff extremely enthusiastic. Especially the female receptionist and receptionist male friend named Ngoc Thach. Extremely thoughtful and very quick problem solving. I am very satisfied and will be back! Thanks Le’s Cham!

hotel_name: Cam Ranh Riviera Beach Resort & Spa
review_text: Resort Space beautiful beach location. The room rate is cheap compared to 5 stars, the breakfast and the restaurant are not very good for my taste, but in general, the service price compared to me is excellent.

hotel_name: Sky Beach D20 Hotel Nha Trang
review_text: The hotel has a spacious, airy campus, clean rooms, amenities, friendly and enthusiastic staff, very enjoyable stay, very comfortable!

My vacation only 1 night at Nha Trang city. I choosed Em Oi Hotel. This is a fantastic place to relax. The space is very and 4-star quality.
I was really fascinated by the view of the hotel, from the lobby, the reception area, the restaurant and the pool. The staff are very friendly and helpful to us. My bedroom is really satisfied with the beautiful view of the sea and the city. I will definitely return Em Oi Hotel in the next week's work.
Good service. friendly staff. Clean room. Have a chance to come back again

The room price is quite cheap for the quality of the room received so I feel very ok. The room is fully equipped, the house and bathroom are separate very convenient, from the hotel it is a short walk to the night market, agarwood tower and the beach... so it is very ok.
Hotel has a very nice view, the price is compared to the average level too ok, wifi good.

The hotel is right in the center with full facilities and very reasonable price. The surrounding area is very busy and you can shop or enjoy anything. Great service and very clean rooms. The staff is very friendly and supportive to customers. There are many Western guests and the mud bath service is very good. Will continue to choose here if I come back.
Friendly staff, clean hotel, reasonable prices
nice hotel, clean, room nicer than expected, will come back if I have the chance

Serviced apartment style room, separate kitchen and sofa bed. Spacious space, beautiful view, suitable for families, especially with 2 or more children. 
Good soundproofing room. 
Cool, stable air conditioning. 
Comfortable, warm, clean blankets and pillows. 

Fast stairs so even though it's 30 floors, there's no long wait or too many people. 

Delicious, diverse breakfast. Fast, polite service staff. 

Many activities in area D. 

My family has a 6-year-old child and a 6-month-old child and had a perfect 3-night experience :x
The receptionist is enthusiastic, supports guests when checking in, advises rooms suitable to guests' needs, thank you very much hotel
Enthusiastic service staff, clean rooms, the hotel is in a suitable location with plenty of food around just a walk away. It's a bit far to the beach but still walkable.
Very good quality. We are satisfied with the service and quality of the room.

Nice place to stay and very centrally located hotel. Only a few walks to The Square. The alley is full of good food. There is a Russian restaurant in the alley, which is super good. You can try it. Also, the hotel for me, is cheaper than the actual price. So 5/5 stars for this experience!

The receptionists are very lovely and enthusiastic. Happy sociable. I came here to visit my girlfriend so I didn't go to play much at the hotel. Thanks to Trieu Khang for giving me the wonderful relaxing moments, I should build an additional pool as well as tables and chairs for guests to sit in cafe or entertain something.

hotel_name: Sunrise Nha Trang Beach Hotel & Spa
review_text: The hotel is ok for 10 minutes, I will come back
great! a must-visit for everyone, will come back and recommend Regalia gold at Nha Trang to friends....

The hotel just started more than a month ago, everything is brand new (room, facility, lifts, etc.). Room is super clean, good Wi-Fi, TV with good internet connection.
Breakfast with various choices and tasted fantastic! Highly recommended
This hotel is affordable. The room is quite clean and beautiful, vintage style. Full facilities. I really enjoyed the experience with this hotel, will come back here when I come to Nha Trang. thanks
The hotel is located in the heart of Nha Trang city, everything was great.
Clean, quiet place, enthusiastic staff. The female food counter employee named Huyen is very cute
The room is clean, but the wi-fi is too weak to do anything... there are many restaurants around to eat and drink..
Attentive service, enthusiasm. The hotel is clean, comfortable and cool. Convenient location. Good price. Next time if I come to Nha Trang, I hope to still book a room here.

The staff was extremely friendly and lovely, and the service was enthusiastic. I just found it a bit strange that one day when I went down to the lobby around 8pm, the receptionists had all left, but it didn't affect me much. My family went when there were few guests, so it felt extremely private and comfortable. I will definitely come back to Sol when I have the chance.

A gorgeous hotel. A nice room and lovely grounds and pool. The restaurant and bar were great, serving gorgeous food. The staff were extremely helpful and very friendly. They organized tours for me very quickly. The location is excellent—a minute from the old town and a 10-minute walk from the beautiful river. I loved this hotel and Hoi An so much I extended my stay by 2 nights. Thank you for a great stay 🙏

Beautiful hotel set in splendid grounds. Close to the center and attractions with free bikes available if you don't want to walk along the busy streets. Complimentary drinks and good information provided at check-in. Great, freshly cooked food and variety of menu. Excellent value for money.

The villa welcomed me in the late afternoon. The receptionist was so cute 😊. My room was right next to the reception desk so it was very convenient to move my luggage into the room. It rained as soon as it got dark, so we didn't leave the room until 8pm to wander around the old town. The villa's location is very convenient for eating, walking around or going to the church which is also very close. I only stayed 1 night but the experience was quite good. In the evening, I asked the receptionist to stay there for a bit but they didn't mind (even though it was raining). Even the next day we checked out but didn't leave, left our luggage comfortably, there was even a private bathroom outside to change clothes and shower 🥰. Of course, you still have to check out at 12pm like other accommodations. A beautiful stay experience. Will definitely come back if I have the chance.

hotel_name: Nam An Mama Villa Hoi An
review_text: Great experience, friendly staff, great customer service, the room was neat, clean, and comfortable. Thanks

hotel_name: Shining Riverside Hoi An Boutique and Spa
review_text: friendly staff, clean room, comfortable experience, clean swimming pool. near the old town so convenient to move. everything is ok so come and relax everyone

The staff was very helpful and friendly.
The hotel was incredibly beautiful and clean.
The bike facilities were also excellent, and there was a shuttle to Old Town.
Great value for money. Room, service, and environment all exceeded expectations. Highly recommended for couples and solo travelers.

The hotel is near the night market in Hoi An. The room is clean and comfortable. The owner is very good. Book a car to the airport directly with the owner. It's half the price of calling Grab. I checked out at 6 am. The owner came down to wait first. He called a car for me. I'm very impressed with this place.

hotel_name: The Mansion Hoi An by Minova
review_text: The villa has a great location just 10 min walk to the center of the ancient town. The room is vintage decorated, quiet, and clean. The staff is friendly and helpful.
If I come to Hoi An next time, I will definitely choose this place to stay. There is nothing to complain about.

hotel_name: Bellerive Hoi An Resort and Spa
review_text: New and beautiful hotel, friendly staff. Swimming pool and fun activities are the highlights. Very suitable for relaxation.
Ms. Hoa so friendly, let me know seafood, so delicous🥰🥰🥰🥰, room so clean, peaceful

hotel_name: Hoi An New Life Homestay & Villa
review_text: The family host is very sweet and accommodating. I will be booking here again when I visit.

The room was beautiful, spacious and clean just like the picture. We even got a room upgrade. The hotel is very close to the old town, and they lend free bicycles, which is very convenient. The breakfast was not very rich. Will definitely come back next time.
The hotel is clean, the breakfast is comprehensive, and the staff is friendly. You can rent bicycles for free, and there are umbrellas in the rooms. Perfect.
Best! Clean! High end! Great food.
Absolutely beautiful, just like in the app, friendly and enthusiastic staff, cheap laundry. The hotel has bicycles available for everyone to borrow

hotel_name: Nghe Prana Hotel & Spa Hoi An
review_text: Friendly staff, clean accommodation, beautiful swimming pool, Hoi An style interior, great

More than great. The hotel is near the old town, clean, enthusiastic staff, spacious garden swimming pool, lots of beautiful virtual living corners.... I was very happy when the hotel upgraded the room to a room with a super nice balcony.

hotel_name: Hoi An Merrily De Art Hotel
review_text: I really like the atmosphere at this hotel. I went 1m, the staff was very cute, especially the breakfast was delicious, everything was great. Thank you Merrily for being a beautiful memory in my Solo trip in Hoi An. Will definitely come back! 🤍

hotel_name: Namia River Retreat - Wellness Inclusive Resort
review_text: It was a very lovely stay in Namia. The room & resort are very serene, beautiful & peaceful. We simply love the complimentary activities for the guests as we are able to explore the Vietnamese culture as well. It is a peace of mind because we do not need to book externally. The hospitality is excellent with Mr. Phat being our host as he did the room orientation tour, explained the resort map, and did his own suggestion of best places in Hoi An and we really appreciate it, same goes to Miss Hong as she explained the Hoi An area during sunset cruise and Miss Tran during guided bicycle tour where she brought us to morning market and the ancient town. Highly recommended if you would like to stay here for any occasion 😊
Nice room, clean, friendly and hospitable host

The whole stay was wonderful. Tuan, the owner, is always there, speaks very good English, and will help you with anything you need. We hired a motorbike through him and also got the vehicle hire to Da Nang airport through him. So easy to deal with, warm, and friendly. We are very happy we stayed here. The rooms are great, very clean, the toilets, showers, etc., and all the facilities are great. It's also really close to the main area in Hoi An. Totally recommend this to everyone coming to Hoi An. Thanks Tuan and Rokas Hoi An
Location near the old town. Swimming pool + free breakfast buffet. New room, clean, reasonable price. The owner is enthusiastic in supporting.

hotel_name: Eco Lux Riverside Hoi An Hotel
review_text: The staff was super welcoming and friendly. The rooms were big and clean and the experience as a whole was great.

The hotel is super close to the old town, the staff is super friendly and enthusiastic. The hotel lends free bicycles to walk around the old town, the room is clean and beautiful, good soundproofing, the view of the old town room to take pictures on the balcony is super satisfying without having to go to a coffee shop in the old town to take pictures 😍😍😍
The family has a baby and also loves the swimming pool here
Definitely next time I have the opportunity to go to Hoi An, I will book this hotel again 😊

A very strategic hotel, just walk everywhere, visit Old Town and in front of the hotel there is a night market, it is very easy to shop for souvenirs and have dinner, the hotel provides a coconut boat service which was an impressive experience for us.
The room is ok, clean, reasonable price, about 5-6 minutes walk from the old town. The staff is very enthusiastic.

The room is very good, spacious, clean, the bed is soft and comfortable to sleep on. The owner is cute and friendly. There is also a motorbike rental service. Very good value for money. Convenient for traveling to tourist attractions.
I am enjoying my stay here. The staff have been very nice and helpful. Overall, this is a hotel which offers good value and within easy walking distance to everything. Recommended.

hotel_name: La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa
review_text: Beautiful space, clean room, good service, friendly and enthusiastic staff

Twin room where each bed is 1m4. Vastly wide. The view from the balcony overlooking the river is excellent. Friendly and enthusiastic staff. Very close to the old town and evening snacks. Next time I come back to Hoi An, I will continue to stay here.

The owners are friendly and hospitable, with lovely smiles. The hotel is right near the old town, making it easy to get around. I booked the hotel to run the Hoi An Heritage Half Marathon, which required travel from 4am. Everyone supported me as much as possible. Thank you.
Near old town, clean room, convenient transportation, enthusiastic receptionist.
Beautiful architecture, harmonious interior, romantic green garden landscape, many included services, and friendly staff. Like decoration and music style. Will come back again.
Room is clean, fresh. Will come back another time
Enthusiastic owner. Room right at the night market street. Near the river. Convenient for travel.
The hotel is clean, cozy, comfortable, and the staff are very friendly.

hotel_name: Hoian Tranquil Lodge - Chon Binh Yen
review_text: Everything is great. Enthusiastic staff, beautiful scenery. The swimming pool is also very chill. Everything is ok, 10/10

The location is very close to the old town, can walk. The owner was enthusiastic, I checked in at 12pm because the flight was delayed but still waited. The room is neat and clean, the wifi is strong, there is nothing to criticize

Service was great. My family and I had a short but memorable vacation. 3 star resort but great service like 4 stars. Staff are very friendly and supportive. Location is also very close to the sights. Breakfast restaurant is very delicious. Especially the resort also offers a boat trip on the river in the morning, the afternoon, there is a free offer of Hoi An specialties. Great. Next time if I come back Hoi An will definitely continue here.

hotel_name: KOI Resort and Spa Hoi An
review_text: We were here earlier this month on our honeymoon trip. Room was spacious while nicely decorated with lots of roses and a surprised happy honeymoon cake from Koi, we’re heartily appreciated. Even though it’s rainy and wet, we decided to scroll around and enjoy the beauty of the resort during our special time here. Dining was also at ease, lovely pool view with reasonable tasty local dishes. A great shout out to every staff who all remained attentive, smiley and service minded til the the time we left. And especially Ms. Trang Phan - the professional Front Office Manager who extended a warm welcome to us at arrival then made sure our stay to be nothing short of perfection. Her dedicated hospitality is indeed a great highlight of our memorable time in Hoi An! Way to go Ms. Trang and Koi’s Team.
Good service, enthusiastic staff, clean room The location is a bit far from the old town, so you have to take a car, not walk
The staff is very friendly and helpful! The room is clean and convenient, just walking distance to the main attractions.
The host is cute and very enthusiastic, the room is clean and cool. If I have the opportunity to return to Hoi An, I still choose this place to stay
Good service, friendly staff enthusiasm. The hotel space is very peaceful.
Room was clean and nice. Location was superb as it was only 3-5 mins away from night market. Breakfast selection was great.

hotel_name: Hoi An Central Boutique Hotel and Spa
review_text: The hotel is located near the center, the staff is very enthusiastic and attentive to customers, the rooms are very clean and tidy. The breakfast buffet is delicious, but there are a few dishes. 9/10 points

hotel_name: Ahoy Hoi An Boutique Resort & Spa
review_text: Super new resort, extremely friendly staff, very attentive to guests, rooms are fully equipped with amenities, beautifully decorated. The resort has a very convenient bicycle rental or shuttle bus service to the old town. Lunch at the resort is delicious, attentive service. Will definitely come back if there is a chance

hotel_name: Tam Thanh Beach Resort and Spa
review_text: Beautiful scene, quiet, cool
Extremely friendly, cute staff, clean rooms, a great stay
Friendly staff, my family would like to stay 1 hour more than the specified check out time and be facilitated. Big swimming pool, clean room but the shower in my room is a bit broken
Too wonderful Atlas Hotel. I miss this blue hotel. Nice design room. good breakfast Overall great from staff to room.
Rooms and furniture are new and clean. Large space. The dining room is clean and fully furnished. Enthusiastic support staff!

hotel_name: Allegro Hoi An . A Little Luxury Hotel & Spa
review_text: The hotel is new, the pool is beautiful and wonderful, the decoration is perfect, the furniture is also very new, the hotel has Free fruit, water and coffee. The hotel offers airport shuttle service (surcharge) & free shuttle bus to An Bang beach, with free club & seating service for guests. The hotel also offers free bikes. The staff are very enthusiastic, also guide me a reasonable map to hang out. I had a great vacation. Will return to the hotel on the next holiday.

My husband and I decided to go suddenly so we only booked here. The receptionists are very enthusiastic. My room at 2 nights is a standard room a bit secret, but the next morning they took the initiative to change the room better for the couple when there is an empty room even though we haven't asked. The couple are extremely satisfied with the service. Location near the old town, many delicious restaurants. 5-star review. :)

I often stay here on weekends, firstly because the swimming pool is safe for children, secondly because it is quiet and fresh, the villa has lots of trees. The only minus point is that the breakfast buffet is not very polished, it needs a little more investment.
The hotel has an extremely convenient location, close to the peaceful beach, and the famous check-in points (The Deck House, Shore Club). Rooms are clean, airy, green space, close to nature.

hotel_name: KA Villa & Spa, Beachside Hoi An
review_text: Friendly staff, very close to the beach, clean rooms, lots of amenities, worth a vacation

hotel_name: Hoi An Golden Bamboo An Bang Beach Villa & Spa
review_text: Everything is perfect, the hotel staff are enthusiastic, friendly, and hospitable. Room as booked.

The owner was very kind and welcoming. I was allowed to check in early and store my luggage after check out.

Their dog is very cute.

Next time I visit Hoi An, I will definitely return there. 🫶
Great hostess. Beautiful room. Near the old town and other tourist attractions. It's raining so hard you can't go out to eat. Yes, I'll treat you to dinner. Thank you very much

hotel_name: Happy Life Memories Hoi An Hotel & Spa
review_text: The hotel is very beautifully designed, clean and comfortable, enthusiastic staff, will recommend to friends

We loved the friendliness of the hotel staff right from the point we arrived to the hotel. As we need to walk upstairs the entrance to the hotel, the staff immediately helped us to carry a few of our luggages to the lobby and we were immediately served with welcome drinks. The beautiful ladies at the reception also provided us a map of all the must-go places as well as accompanied us to the room to ensure everything was smooth. The rooms are lovely and clean. They decorated it nicely and gave us a free bottle of wine :), thanks! We loved the close proximity of the hotel to the night market which is just across the street and our stay was quiet and peaceful plus not to mention the awesome breakfast! Definitely will recommend it to others.

Great hotel with excellent service!
The room was clean and comfortable, and the staff were very friendly. Perfect location, close to everything. I’d definitely stay here again!
The hotel is very nice and clean, the pool was enjoyable, and the rooms were very comfortable.
Next time I visit Hoi An, I will choose to stay here again. The most satisfying homestay I have been to. The owner is lovely and friendly. The room is clean, airy, and wonderful.
2 years ago, I really liked the hotel, this year I still choose a hotel to stay. Feeling the same and seeing the hotel much nicer than before
The hostess is very friendly, the room is clean. Near the night market and Hoi An ancient town. My family is very satisfied.

It feels familiar like home, because this is originally a house following old French architecture, with 2 front and back sides, the front side is the reception area and hotel lobby, the back side is still the entrance gate and it seems This is the original face of the house. The garden architecture, swimming pool, and interior all bring a pleasant feeling. The staff is super cute, friendly, and has free bicycles. Walk less than 5 minutes to enter the old town. I highly recommend that those who read these words choose to stay here.

My room has a balcony but the view is where the construction is under construction😁. The hotel has good service, friendly staff, I bought an extra breakfast with pho/noodles and coffee, very delicious. I was also able to borrow a bicycle for free to walk around the street and send my stuff before check-in time. Very pleased.

Glad that we booked this hotel. It was a great rejuvenated place for 5 of us (we travel with 3 kids). The bed is great, the rooms were nice and comfortable. The staff there were polite and helpful. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay here in Saga. Kudos guys 👍
The room is spacious and airy, the hostess is very sweet and enthusiastic.

The staff is enthusiastic and friendly. I checked out at 12pm but the flight was delayed and asked to leave my luggage until 7am. The rooms are spacious, clean, airy, and have a swimming pool. The toilets and bathrooms are clean, with hot and cold water. About 10 minutes by motorbike from the center of the Old Quarter. Free bicycles, good wifi. Recommended.

We enjoyed our stay at the hotel. The service was excellent, and the staff were very friendly. The room was large, the bed was comfy, and it was quiet at night. The location was ideal, only a short walk into town. The pool was also very picturesque being in the middle of the buildings. We would definitely go back.
it was a great time to spend our stay here with friendly staff; good location with strong services. I will recommend my friends to be here and this hotel will be my choice in my next trip in Hoi An
Resort is very nice. The room was gorgeous. All the staff were very friendly and welcoming.

The host was really friendly, she asked us which way we were going to go so she could share some useful advice and suggest the shortest way to go. Additionally, the hotel location is quite close to Hoi An ancient town. I highly recommend this homestay, the price was so cheap as well, it only cost 360,000 VND for 4 people.

hotel_name: Little Residence. A Boutique Hotel & Spa
review_text: I'm in the suite room. Clean room service is a bit far from the old town, but there is a free bicycle service for you to walk around the old town. Nice and clean room in classic, quiet style. I put it in la residencia, but the place has stopped working and moved to litte Hoi An. The Litte group's hotels are fine.
East West Villas which provided best service. The food for breakfast was gift because it is very delicious. The Environment of Villas is covered by green color.
Excellent service from Vy, the receptionist. Clean and big room for solo travelers, good service also from all the staff, good location for the hotel.
A hotel worth the money from the service attitude of the staff to the facilities, 10/10 points. Will come back here soon, love it

hotel_name: Lantana Riverside Hoi An Boutique Hotel & Spa
review_text: We really enjoyed our stay at Lantana. Would definitely return in the future. The hotel staff were so friendly, helpful, and hospitable.

Lovely hotel, clean rooms, varied and delicious breakfast, very clean swimming pool. Extremely friendly staff, especially the security guard. Thank you a thousand times for a memorable stay. Will come back.
Friendly staff, nice room, full facilities, suitable for relaxation. Overall great.

The hotel is good. The receptionists are lovely. Say hello to a friendly smile. This hotel location is excellent, next to the tourist attraction. The night market is a short walk away and will take my family to stay here again.
The hotel is very beautiful, quiet, the receptionist is super friendly, I will come back again if I have a chance

I had an absolutely wonderful experience here! The staff were exceptionally friendly and enthusiastic—they guided me to my room, helped merge the two beds (since I booked a twin room), and even provided an iron when I needed one. The room was spotless, very comfortable, and featured a relaxing bathtub that added to the overall comfort.
One lovely touch was the welcome cake—it was delicious and made me feel truly valued as a guest. I will definitely come back the next time I visit Hoi An!
Luxury, clean, beautiful hotel. The receptionist is enthusiastic and cheerful

The receptionist is enthusiastic and cheerful. The owner is extremely sweet and is always greeted when he comes in and out. The room is clean, the price is reasonable. Easy access for cars, close to the old town so very convenient. I only stayed to experience the old town so that was ok, I didn't ask for anything more. Well, there is an indoor swimming pool for children who like to swim.
Spacious hotel space. Room is clean and nice.
Clean guesthouse, friendly and lovely owner like family! Free bicycle rental. Close to the old town, next door there is a delicious pho restaurant.

The room was as per pictures. A nice quiet area, away from the busy tourist part of hoi an but close enough to walk or bike into the old town (with free bicycles!). Bathrooms, amenities, room size and balcony were great. The bed was a little hard if you are used to a soft western mattress. There’s a nice little pool outside and breakfast included was great! Most of all, the staff were so friendly and helpful. This would be a great place for solos, partners or families/groups!

hotel_name: Anmira Hoi An Village of Arts and Culture
review_text: If you have little time to rest and want to find a relaxing and peaceful space, this place is the best choice. Everything is very good from the price to the food and the staff. Thank you very much Resort.

Homestay is very affordable, nice room, pretty decor, the owner and her daughter are enthusiastic in supporting, bicycles are available for rent and the room is cleaned daily. I arrived nearly 2 hours before check-in time, the owner supported free check-in. Next time I visit Hoi An, I will definitely continue to stay here.
The hotel staff are very enthusiastic and always welcoming to guests. The experiences here have given me a feeling that is very true to the name of this place.

I accidentally found home but must say it's great
💯 Staff: super enthusiastic and cute
💯 Location: near the old town, can walk or bike
💯 Service: convenient bar, I didn't use it but tried the shower gel, very fragrant, free bike rental, clean swimming pool
💯 Hygiene: super clean
💯 Space: quite old, primitive brick and stone but still modern and airy
💯 Price: reasonable for the service

The bottom line is that I will definitely come back 😊😊

I will rate based on the following basic points: 1. Service quality: Enthusiastic and friendly staff, nothing to complain about. 2. Room quality: clean, all necessary items are available, especially I really like the decoration of the room and the whole hotel. It feels very elegant, luxurious and artistic. 3. Location: a short walk to the old town, if you love taking pictures, besides the old town, I think the area near the hotel is also beautiful, or take pictures in the hotel, the room is also very beautiful. 4. Other services: very convenient when almost all services such as motorbike and bicycle rental, airport shuttle, coconut forest tour, Cu Lao Cham island are available at the hotel, the price is quite reasonable. Overall, I give it 9/10 points.

hotel_name: Ally Beach Boutique Hotel Hoi An
review_text: We had a great night out. Room is clean. Bellboy and attentive reception. Hotel staff meet passengers welcome. Regardless of Vietnamese and foreign guests. Will come again next time!

hotel_name: Le Pavillon Hoi An Gallery Hotel & Spa
review_text: The room is nice and clean. I went during the low season so it was very quiet and the service was good, the staff was enthusiastic. The location is not too far from the old town so it's easy to walk, also quite close to Hoi An Memory Island so it's very convenient to travel. Highly recommend for honeymoon couples or self-guided Hoi An tours.
The room is spacious and comfortable. The hosts are very enthusiastic and hospitable, ready to help when I changed my flight time. I will definitely come back next time.
Here is cozy same as the name. And they give free bike. They have taxi service with charge but it is so convenient. I love swimming pool here. Distance to ancient town is not far. Very good place!
The hostess is very clean and the guesthouse is conveniently located
Beautiful, quiet, comfort, tenderly.

This is my first time in Hoi An and I chose to book a room here. Good service, comfortable rooms, close to the old town, very convenient to travel! If I come back to Hoi An, I will still choose to stay here.

This is really a very healing villa, the owner is extremely enthusiastic, I arrived in Hoi An late at night but she still waited for me to open the door, the geographical location is super close to the Japanese Covered Bridge, not to mention the swimming pool in the villa is extremely sparkling and cool, the rooms are clean, when I returned, the owner also helped me book a cheap taxi to Da Nang, this is an extremely chill villa not only for families but also for couples.

Extremely wonderful, my lover with car sickness is quite tired, the female friend of the hostess is about to give priority to the room before the break, but also makes a cup of ginger tea for the lover to drink for the tiredness, the room is very clean will, do not think with the price of 250k / day, I can get the same quality room. The hostess and the hostess are extremely friendly and cute, give 9 room points and 10 points to cug the way of service of Red House
The owner is very hospitable and enthusiastic. The room is not too modern but very clean and tidy. If I have the opportunity to come back, I will still choose to stay here.

hotel_name: Laluna Hoi An Riverside Hotel & Spa
review_text: Nice hotel clean staff enthusiastic agile. Near the old town on foot, super delicious breakfast !!! Will come back ạ

hotel_name: Hoi An Golden Holiday Hotel & Spa
review_text: Friendly staff, very enthusiastic and attentive support. Beautiful, clean and comfortable interior rooms. Good service. A very worth staying place when traveling to Hoi An

hotel_name: Little Riverside . A Luxury Hotel & Spa
review_text: Lovely and great hotel experience. May, our front desk, was very smiley, friendly, and accommodating throughout our stay. Every single thing was precisely done, and they ensured our needs had been met throughout. The spa experience was really good too. Do check them out as they have plenty of spa options, and for in-house guests, there's a discount which was very helpful. Overall, we truly had a great time there and are definitely looking to come back to Hoi An again 😊

clean room. The hostess uncle is very enthusiastic, extremely cute. My car has a cake. In the morning, the landlord also took the car to the car repair shop. I really appreciate your cuteness. Western-style breakfast food. delicious.
Friendly staff to welcome us at the hotel, great location. Highly recommend!
Clean, neat and beautiful accommodation. Delicious food. Location to the old town, about 450m away.
The reception was happy, enthusiastic, friendly, attentive, especially free bikes available. Located outside the old town 500m so very quiet, clean and fresh air.

The room is perfect for relaxing during vacation time. The reception and staff were so polite. The room was very clean. I really love the elegant bathtub. The environment is so natural with traditional Vietnamese culture. The place is very near Hoi An Old Town.
Room like picture. The room was steamed with a very fragrant lemongrass scent. Hosts are friendly and enthusiastic. The hotel offers bicycles to guests.

the staff is very helpful and friendly, I traveled with my parents and kids and booked a family room and a double deluxe, the room is spacious, clean and nice, the breakfast is delicious, laundry and bicycles are also available to get around. I will come back here again when I go to hoi an.. thank you very much, a pleasant experience
Experience Hoi An with Areca homestay is a great and right thing! Next time will still choose this place if visiting Hoi An

I really like this place. The room is fragrant and clean. The bathroom has a water heater. There is a refrigerator. Mini kitchen. The location is very strategic. Lots of food and grocery stores, there are many banks so you can go to the ATM. The owner is very friendly and helpful. They have a partnership with a private car so it makes it easy for us to order. Overall, I highly recommend this homestay.
Room is clean. Friendly staff, extremely enthusiastic, support for any request. Convenient location. (Close to the night market, near the old quarter)
Enthusiastic staff always smile when meeting guests. Professional service, clean rooms, good morning at the restaurant. I will come back here!
Really great! Cheap price, super enthusiastic owner, clean room. Nothing to complain about. If there were 10 points, it would be 10 🥰🥰🥰
Everything is great, have the opportunity to stay here again
Everyone is very friendly, worth the money. If I have the chance, I will come back next time 💗
The room I booked was beautiful but very airy, and it was close to the old town. The hostess is friendly and funny. If you have the opportunity to come to Hoi An, try to book a room to experience it!

Excellence. VaiA Boutique Hotel Hoi An is near Old Town Area. Free bicycles, free coffee and tea all day drinking in the lobby, free cocktail every day at 3-5 PM, free breakfast, room is good. We booked through app for 3 nights. Buy Banana Hill Tour. And the car to Danang Airport through the hotel. Thanks the staffs for very good service.

Your second home in Hoi An Ancient Town - Nu Ni Homestay. Staff and service are worthy of 9.2 * by customer votes. By the way, I would like to thank Nu Ni Homestay for giving my family a wonderful vacation
Rooms are clean, spacious, cleaned regularly. The host is friendly and enthusiastic. Airport shuttle available. Will stop by if you have the opportunity to return to Hoi An.
Cool view room, affordable price, extremely good service. There is a chance to come back.
I have a great thought at the hotel. Friendly reception, wholehearted, feeling like being at home. Nice view, clean and airy room. Too reasonable for the whole family and for young people.

The room is clean and nice, the view of the field is cool, the space is quiet, civilized, the owner and the receptionist are always supporting. Highly recommend and will come back when the opportunity arises. Free street bike. Quang noodles for breakfast + delicious coffee.

hotel_name: Tam Hong Phuc Homestay Hoi An
review_text: Location is good, near the ancient town. Room is spacious, clean & comfortable. Since it's a homestay, please not that upper floor is only accesible by stairs.

hotel_name: Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort and Spa
review_text: I’ll definitely come back. The resort is beautiful overall and staff are helpful and friendly.
The owner of the homestay is super cute. Free bicycle rental, aunt and uncle also give many places to eat and drink. Super recommended for everyone 🥰

hotel_name: Silk River Hoi An Hotel And Spa
review_text: The hotel is a bit far from the old town but it is great for my family, suitable for resting. If I have the opportunity to come back, I will still choose Pearl River.
Great and friendly. Anyone who loves nature should experience it. The owner is very enthusiastic. They even lend bicycles for free.
Clean, attentive and enthusiastic service. Very satisfied and will come back again.

Lovely place with nice hosts. This location is close to nature and takes you 10 mins to go to Hoi An centre by motorbike. Simple yet delicious breakfast. There is only one thing needs to improve is the smell of the new furniture.
Everything is great, right in the heart of the old town, book will
The uncle and aunt are enthusiastic, cheerful and cute. The hotel has a natural swimming pool with bonsai trees. Great experience.

hotel_name: Gia Huy Riverside Hotel Hoi An
review_text: The hotel has a cool river view, located quite close to the Old Quarter Center. Outside there is a fairly large garden suitable for morning coffee and BBQ parties. The swimming pool is quite large and clean, with water levels from 0.6m-1.8m, children can swim. The public area has a fitness area (with treadmill and weights), billiards table, and a very nice tea area. The Reception and Security staff are very friendly and enthusiastic. Breakfast is selected from the menu when checking in, the menu is quite delicious and rich with full main dishes, cakes (banana/pineapple), desserts (fruit, yogurt, jelly). Overall, it's okay, a great experience.

The location is super close to the beach. Private, quiet. The room is clean, beautiful, full of needs. The beach restaurant right below is delicious, the two sides have seafood restaurants. Will be back 👍👍👍

I only stayed for 1 day but still received very good service. If I have the opportunity to return to Hoi An, I will definitely return to Hoi An Heart Lodge. To clarify, I am a customer, I write a lot because I like it, I was not asked or booked to review anything ^^, and I highly recommend it to anyone who intends to rent a room when traveling to Hoi An!
