Clean room, location near the center. However, the shower in room 501 is a bit weak, please fix it. Otherwise, everything is OK. The hotel staff is friendly and enthusiastic. The staff helped me send my luggage to HCM when I forgot my luggage. Thank you very much
Great experience! New room, clean, comfortable, happy and friendly staff.
Favorite places to stay over here

The hotel is very comfortable, I reported late check out at 1:30 pm, the staff still happily agreed. Even though I planned to go out to another hotel to stay, but after eating and drinking, I went back to the hotel staff to make me feel satisfied.

hotel_name: Cat Ba Paradise Hotel - Sky Bar & Massage
review_text: I had a pleasant stay here. The hotel exceeded our expectations. I was upgraded to the best room. Friendly staff. The breakfast buffet is varied and excellent. The 1-day bay tour program introduced by the hotel was fascinating and we were lucky enough to see the sunrise in the afternoon. Thank you Paradise Cat Ba hotel and Mr. Linh Dao's Green Trail travel company. We would highly recommend this hotel to everyone. A 4 star hotel that feels like a 5 star hotel. Everything was perfect.

“A romantic and memorable vacation!”
My lover and I had a wonderful vacation at the hotel. The space is cozy and private, very suitable for couples who want to relax and enjoy. The rooms are clean, the sea view is extremely beautiful, especially the sunset from the balcony is very romantic. The staff is friendly, cute and always ready to support. The hotel also suggests many interesting activities such as motorbike rental, Lan Ha Bay tour... Will definitely come back when I have the chance!
The receptionist was very enthusiastic, the room was clean, quite chill, reasonable price, had an elevator, hair dryer, refrigerator,... Basically, it was worth the price, recommended to choose 😊
The hotel has a very relaxing rooftop area, and there's also a shared kitchen. The place is larger than I expected, clean, and peaceful.
The hotel is centrally located. The room is clean and beautiful. Full service. The owner is very attentive and friendly.

The owner is very cute and super enthusiastic. The room price is cheap but the quality is very, very good. The room is always cleaned by the girls. The room is also located right in the center of Cat Ba town, convenient for traveling. Will definitely come back to this hotel. 
Oh, everyone should book a tour to Lan Ha Bay from the hotel owner, because the price is very cheap, suitable for students like us, even cheaper than other places to book tours.

hotel_name: Tan An Palace Hotel & Serviced Apartment
review_text: It was great! The female receptionist was very enthusiastic, let me change the room with a better view, let me check in early. Room is clean. Thank you hotel

I recently stayed at a homestay, and it was an incredible experience. The staff were warm and welcoming, making me feel right at home. The rooms were cozy and spotless, offering a perfect place to relax. I highly recommend this spot for anyone looking to unwind and enjoy authentic local life!

The hotel is airy, clean and very close to the sea. From the owner to the staff are cute and friendly. We all need advice is very enthusiastic so our experience with Cat Ba is even more wonderful. The hotel is also very close to the sea, so anybody who wants to walk the sea is very convenient.
The hotel is clean and quiet. Enthusiastic and cheerful reception staff. When I return to Hai Phong, I will book F&F again

I found the room here to be clean and comfortable, with good service. Price is also cheap. Will recommend to friends and relatives. Thank you very much to the hotel and traveloka, we had a wonderful vacation in Hai Phong.
I booked for my brother, received quite good reviews from him, good service, close to the center, lovely staff, quite clean. Will book again to stay if I return to Cat Ba.

The room was very clean and quiet, the bed was smooth and I slept very well, because I often lost sleep, but here I met my standards for very comfortable cushions. Breakfast is quite good, many dishes. Maybe I will come back here when I go to work. Reasonable price, especially for business travelers who need good sleep.

hotel_name: The Moon Boutique Hotel Cat Ba
review_text: I am satisfied with my experience here. The staff are very friendly and proactive in supporting customers.
The staff is very friendly, the breakfast is delicious and rich, the rooms are clean and airy. Will visit again when coming to Hai Phong!

A very wonderful experience at this hotel, the staff are very cute, enthusiastic, cheerful and friendly. The room is clean and beautiful, cleaned every day, fully equipped, breakfast is selected from the Japanese cuisine menu, very delicious.. there is a free washing machine and dryer, free swimming pool... I really like this hotel, will definitely come back when I have the opportunity to come to Hai Phong again. ❤️

Outside there is a water park for both adults and children. Rooms are clean and airy. Especially the road to the resort is very green. This resort does not have a private beach located inside the resort but must be outside, a bit strange so I do not swim.

Beautiful queen room, reasonable rest, clean bathroom. Room fully equipped with hair dryer, shampoo, shower gel, towels and toothbrush. Hot and cold air conditioning is available. Homestay owner lives right next door, very enthusiastic support and guidance

The hotel is very clean, neatly arranged. Comfortable room. Walking out Vincom very close. It is convenient for business travelers who want to stay in the city center but get a good night's sleep. Walk to work area near. There are many restaurants and beer taverns in the surrounding area. Will return to Cozi

Menvra Hotel is a newly built hotel in Hai Phong. Rooms are spacious and clean. Elegant, warmly colored. The price is quite reasonable, not too expensive. The dining room is quite big but the buffet breakfast is still a bit less abundant. Enthusiastic staff, quite cute. Walking nearby, there are also many eateries. Have the opportunity to visit Hai Phong will also return here.

The hotel is clean, the staff is friendly. The reception area is attentive, the room is clean, the service is professional, the breakfast buffet is quite good. I was assigned a room overlooking the balcony on the 2nd floor, which is a very cool garden. Because I was in a hurry, I didn't have time to take souvenir photos, but when I experienced it, I guarantee the hotel is very ok. I will come back next time.
Great. Clean room, no mosquito, I sleep very well. Very good food, gnat clean. Have a chance to return to Cat Ba will stay longer.
The hostess was very friendly and hospitable. She recommended some places to eat and go out. If a large group requested to eat at the hotel, she could cook for them. The rooms were clean and tidy.

This is a five stars hostel for a tiny price!! Clean and beautiful dorm with a nice particular, really enjoyable bathroom. Staff is very helpful and some of them speak a very good english. The cherry on top is the pool! It's quite a climb up, but it's really worthy! The view is amazing. The position is very quiet and about 3k from the city centre, perfect if you have your own bike or bicycle. The breakfast was included in the deal, with a nice coffee, omelette and bread. Just perfect! Super satisfied! thanks
The room is very clean and comfortable. Its location is wonderful, in the center of the city. From my room, I can see Hai Phong theater. The receptionist is very friendly and helpful.
Both the landlady and everyone else were very polite, attentive, and helpful during my stay. I thoroughly enjoyed my experience here. Highly recommend it to everyone.

The hotel is located on a main road, has its own parking area, and is surrounded by many restaurants and cafes, making it very convenient. The hotel is extremely clean, and the staff are lovely and enthusiastic. The food is also very good; there's nothing to complain about. Compared to other hotels in the same category, this one is excellent.
Nice room, clean, fragrant, fully equipped, safe area. Enthusiastic staff
The hotel is more beautiful than in the photo, clean and airy, enthusiastic staff 😍
Friendly enthusiastic staff, I was upgraded to a room with a beautiful sea view. Cheap and clean rooms.

The room was clean, had a good view, and was well-lit. The owner was friendly and very helpful. The location was in the city center, making it convenient to go anywhere. If the room was cleaned early, I could check in before the scheduled time without extra charge. Good service.
Family-friendly hotel and close to the center for commuting
Small and pretty hotel, located right in the city center, opposite is a very convenient supermarket, the whole street seems to sell chrysanthemum tea so you should stop by and try it.

hotel_name: FLAMINGO PREMIUM LAN HA BAY RESORT
review_text: Really great! I was supported to check in early! Delicious food, beautiful space
Great, comfortable, pleasant. I am satisfied
The hotel is beautiful, clean, spacious, fully equipped. The price is not high, overall very satisfied, will continue to rent here if I have the opportunity to return to Hai Phong!

Beautiful space, peaceful and airy!
Rooms are clean and comfortable enough!
Enthusiastic service staff, agile, good response to all customer requirements!
Glad to have stayed here!
The picture is the same as on the app, from the owner to the security guard to be funny and kind.
Spacious, comfortable room, similar to photos taken. Looks like a new hotel, everything looks new. The receptionist is very friendly and helpful. The corridor has pictures of beautiful, bright spaces
Large, cool and clean room, nice view. We will be back
The hotel is located at Beo wharf, very convenient to visit Lan Ha bay. Beautiful, peaceful sea view, quiet space. I will definitely come back.

I was really satisfied and enjoyed staying at Cat Ba Hostel. Clean room, located in the center. Especially cheap and the hotel boss is very friendly, fun. If I come to Cat Ba again, I will definitely choose this place to rest for my trip. Thanks to the hotel for giving me the same comfortable feeling at home.

We're on the right time to change the season so the atmosphere is extremely cool, again on the full moon day, the moon is so romantic, so it's perfect. The first impression is very peaceful, the surrounding scenery is very beautiful. Climbing to Ngu Lam peak is also a bit tired but it's worth it. Very nice. The second impression is that the breakfast is very delicious, and the food here is very wedge, the room is quite clean, the staff are also nice, 10 points, Hoi Ho. Will definitely come back when coming to Cat Ba
Staff friendly, enthusiastic. Rooms will be. I will stop by for a chance, great hotel!
I am very satisfied with the hotel as well as the front desk service is very dedicated ❤️

The hotel has good service: attentive, enthusiastic staff, professional service. Room cleaning both morning and night (a bit surprising😅) My family stayed in a family room at the end of the house, with a partition between the living room and the bedroom; very convenient for families. The room interior is brand new. The bathroom has an automatic toilet, is spacious, and has a bathtub. There is a basement with games for children. Warm water swimming pool. Breakfast depends on each person's taste, with many dishes. In general, I have experienced many resorts and 5-star hotels. I find it very worthwhile here. Will come back and will still choose to stay here. Nothing to complain about.

The hotel is conveniently located. It costs $2 to get to the market by taxi, or you can walk there if you want a bit of exercise. The room facilities were great—new, clean, and well-functioning. I heard about the disruption in hot water supply in other hotels, but it was not the case in The Luxe—hot water was always readily available. There was no air conditioner, but in fact, we didn't need one. The weather was cool enough during the daytime and cold enough at night, and the room was airy if we opened the window a bit. The price was so friendly when compared to the quality we enjoyed. We'll come back to this hotel the next time.
Perfect for a trip.
Excellent reception and service. Superb customer care. Deserves 5 stars. Will stay again when visiting Da Lat.
Great place to stay, the staff is helpful, rooms are clean, comfy, and affordable! Very recommended!
reviewer_name: I Gusti A. P. S. D.

review_text: Beautiful clean resort. Staff were friendly and helpful. Wonderful experience
The staff are cheerful and enthusiastic. Tuan and Nhu support customers very well and professionally. Truc and Duyen are friendly and cute.

The staff were very friendly and enthusiastic, especially the food and beverage service staff; breakfast and afternoon tea were excellent. The rooms were very cozy, and there was air conditioning even when it was hot. It was a truly wonderful holiday.

I booked a room at this hotel because I was on a trip to Da Lat. It's very close to Da Lat Market, just a 5-minute walk away. The room was clean and airy. When we arrived, it wasn't check-in time yet, but the female staff member helped us get our room early. The hotel staff were very lovely and helpful. I will definitely come back.

The Manor is a great choice if you're looking for a quiet, relaxing place that truly captures the essence of Da Lat. The rooms are beautifully decorated, minimalist yet sophisticated, clean, and fully equipped. The staff are friendly and helpful from the moment of check-in. Definitely worth returning! Rating: 9/10

I stayed here for 2 nights. My first impression was that the staff here from Security, Reception and other staff I met were all very friendly, polite, professional. The bedroom was spacious, well soundproofed, the bathroom was nice and clean... If I have the opportunity to come to Dalat, I will choose this hotel as my place to stay.
The staff are very cute, always smiling and saying yes and no to customers. They also care about giving advice and directions to us. Will come back every time I come to Da Lat.
It’s a very nice place, clean room, beautiful view, good service, and friendly staff. I will choose this hotel again for my next trip in Dalat ❤️

hotel_name: Nesta Valley Dalat Hotel - Formerly Golf Valley Hotel
review_text: The staff is super cute and enthusiastic! All my problems or questions were resolved quickly, with enthusiastic support! The food is delicious and close to the center so traveling is also convenient. My family's experience this time was great!
The staff is very good, enthusiastic, friendly, polite... timely support for customers when needed... very valuable for the hotel in this regard.

Will definitely come back next time. 
Clean room, balcony and window view is beautiful and extremely chill. Room is fully equipped and clean as described in the hotel's photo. Room does not have a musty smell even in the rainy season. Hot and strong water. 
The hotel supports early check-in when there is a vacant room without additional charge. The room is cleaned quickly. 
The hotel has a waiting area and a clean bathroom for those who arrive early but have not checked in yet. 
There is a comfortable parking space for cars and motorbikes. 
Overall, it deserves 10 points.
It was great, got early check-in without any extra charge and also got upgraded room without any extra charge. If anyone reads this comment, I recommend booking right away.
The staff were enthusiastic and lovely. The rooms were of good quality, clean, and definitely worth experiencing again next time.

9/10 points. Extremely comfortable experience, friendly receptionist, if you have a room, you will check in immediately. The room is clean. The first day I arrived, the cold water was turned off, but after calling 5 minutes, someone came to fix it. The only minus point is that it's a bit far from the market and can't walk, but because it's open 24/24, renting a motorbike can solve everything.

I wanted to experience so I stayed at a hotel every day, but when I stayed at Golden Imperial, I really liked it and was extremely satisfied with the service here. My baby is a picky eater but praised the food at the hotel for being delicious and clean. The staff even made porridge and brought it to the baby's room 🥰. When I came back from playing, a staff member brought cake and chocolate to the baby's room. I was so happy that my family booked another day to stay hihi 😋. My family was very happy and comfortable staying at the hotel! Thank you and grateful to you for bringing this wonderful experience ❤️
The staff are super friendly. I only come back here to stay. They even gave me a succulent plant to take home when I checked out.

The rooms were beautifully designed, and the carpets created a clean and warm atmosphere. The amenities were more than "fully equipped." The staff were friendly and welcoming. My wife received lovely birthday wishes along with two delicious panna cottas. Thank you to everyone, and I will definitely return here again soon.
The hotel is fully equipped, clean and has enthusiastic staff.
Great everything from staff . Room . Location

I want to express my good experience staying in this hotel. I was on holiday with 2 children, incredibly beautiful nature, fresh air, a magnificent view of the golf fields. My children really liked that hotel included 2 swimming pools: outdoors and warmed-water indoor. There is also a children's playroom. The breakfast is great, a lot of choice. Lunch and dinner in the ala carte restaurant was also at a high level. The hotel staff is very attentive and good-mannered. The guys at the reception, the restaurant and bar workers, the pool staff—you are very cool and we want to say a big thank you from our family. You made our stay at the hotel unforgettable. We would like to express our special gratitude to Eric. Eric—you are a professional in your field, you care about absolutely every visitor in the hotel and try to make maximum efforts to ensure that the visitor's stay is very comfortable. My children ❤️ you very much, we will miss you! We wish you professional growth and grateful clients. Thank you for your kind heart 🙏.

The cheap room is quite airy, the bathroom is big and clean, the staff is friendly and enthusiastic, they help with everything, the hotel has a private kitchen for cooking or getting free drinks, there is a refrigerator for storing things, the bed is big and the room is bright and doesn't smell. When I returned, I was also given a stone lotus plant, hehe. In general, this hotel is very good.

hotel_name: Le Recit Boutique Hotel de Dalat
review_text: It's a great place to stay in Dalat! Nice room, friendly & helpful staff, and good breakfast.

This hotel was the most satisfying one for me during my trip to Vietnam. I really recommend it. First, the location is close to the market, which gets really lively at night—there's a lot to see. There are also many restaurants nearby like McD, Starbucks, and others. The room is really premium, including the toilet (though not a dry toilet), and a wardrobe is provided, so everything is complete. The staff are very helpful, especially when I asked for an early breakfast—they were really quick to assist me. If I go to Dalat again, I'll definitely stay here.
Enthusiastic staff, very clean rooms. Beautiful, airy. Will come back. 5 stars deserved

The staff and management in Da Lat are lovely and enthusiastic. The rooms are really warm, clean, and well-equipped, and the location right by Xuan Huong Lake is incredibly convenient. I will definitely consider this a place to stay regularly.

Thank you Mua Dalat for giving us an unforgettable, cozy and familiar experience in dreamy Dalat.
Mua Dalat has successfully completed its mission of bringing wonderful experiences and accommodation services. You have truly conquered our hearts and become an indispensable part of this trip from the first impressions with your warm, cozy and friendly welcome. Not only that, your choices, suggestions and support have helped us add new "spices" to create an irreplaceable memory in our minds.

Thank you for being an important part and a companion in our trip. We will always trust and choose Mua Dalat in future trips.

Dear Mua Dalat wellness hotel,
I would like to show my expression and appreciation to you for giving us such an unforgettable, cozy and familiar experience in dreamy Dalat.
Mua Dalat has truly finished your own mission of delivering wonderful stays and experiences. You have truly won our hearts and become an indispensable part of our couple trip - from the very first impressions with your warm hearted, welcoming, kind and friendly hospitality.
Moreover, your suggestions, recommendations, and support added fresh “flavors” that help us create an irreplaceable memory in our minds.
Thank you again for being such an important part and a true companion on our journey. We will always trust and choose Dalat Season for our future trips.
Sincerely thanks,
Leo & Amy ❤️

Staff is very friendly and helpful. They helped me much to reschedule my booking which was already reached the no-return point by rule. Much appreciated. In addition, everything is excellent: great car parking, good location, nice breakfast, clean and soundproof room... I have nothing to complain, not a single word. Keep up the good work!!!!

hotel_name: Nature Hotel - Luong The Vinh - Dalat
review_text: The experience was outstanding. I have stayed here for 4 days and the receptionist was helpful and lovely to me. I will be back to stay here for sure.

I had a really great experience staying at the hotel. Receptionist staff so friendly and helpful. Got a free upgrade room to a Deluxe room with a balcony. Recommend this hotel for a holiday in Da Lat.
Friendly staff, the hotel is located right in the center so it's convenient to move around. Especially the hotel is beautiful - clean - new 😍 give 10 points.
Gold View Hotel Da Lat is a hotel well worth experiencing; the rooms are clean and beautiful, the valley views are incredibly relaxing, and the staff are friendly and enthusiastic.

My family stayed from April 9 to April 12, 2025. The receptionists, housekeeping staff, and the lady and the breakfast cooks were very enthusiastic and friendly. The room was clean and bright, and the breakfast was delicious.
Amazing place! I loved the guy, he was really helpful and the room had everything I need: water, coffee, toothpaste…

I booked a hotel for my grandparents 6 people 3 rooms In the evening they came back to the room and found it deserted because it was surrounded by a mountain lake, so why did I book such a deserted hotel in the morning, when I woke up, I felt so beautiful and chill. so I'm so sorry, grandparents walk around and then come back for breakfast, so it's late. Overall, it's great, so stay home everyone

Loved the Dalat Palace Heritage Hotel! The French colonial vibes were super cool, and the staff were awesome – super friendly and helpful. They really made our stay relaxing and enjoyable. We'd definitely stay here again next time we're in Dalat. If you're looking for a luxurious and memorable place to stay in Dalat, this is the place!
friendly staff, room with nice window, cheap price, soft mattress, clean, luxurious

Friendly and enthusiastic staff. Nice hotel location, near the night market. Clean, modern room, fully equipped, with airy windows, air conditioning. Daily buffet breakfast, with changing dishes, constantly refilled so very comfortable.

The hotel is centrally located, so it is very convenient to travel to tourist attractions. The staff is extremely enthusiastic, supporting customers wholeheartedly and quickly. The hotel is new, luxurious, and classy. Will come back next time.
I found the hotel rooms clean, tidy, and the housekeeping was neat and tidy. I was satisfied with the breakfast buffet. The dishes were not very diverse and monotonous.
The lady staff is very sweet. She served us hot tea while we were waiting for our Grab at the lobby. The room and toilet are both so clean. Do not hesitate to book at La Pensee.
I had high expectations, but the atmosphere of the hotel grounds, the rooms, the hospitality, and the food all exceeded my expectations!

The hotel is so nice, there is a campus of trees, the pier is very beautiful. The breakfast is also delicious and has many dishes. Very suitable for relaxation to avoid the hustle and bustle of the city center.
The hotel has an ancient atmosphere, clean and cozy rooms, enthusiastic and supportive staff, car parking, and delicious breakfast.

The hotel is close to the center, convenient to travel and has a car park. The room is a bit small but clean, with the price like mk book is about 650k for 2 beds, it is reasonable. If you go to a group, stay for a long time, book this price okay

The hotel's location is right in the center, very convenient, and the staff are friendly and enthusiastic. The room and furniture are new, but the water supply and drainage system is not good, there is a bit of a smell in the basement area
The hotel is located in the center, convenient for shopping and traveling; Clean rooms, friendly staff, diverse and rich breakfast buffet, will return soon.

The staff is very enthusiastic in helping guests carry their luggage to the car both when arriving and departing. They will take the initiative to carry luggage when guests shop a lot and offer to help keep it until the day of departure for convenience. The room is spacious, comfortable and clean.

I booked a small room but got a free upgrade to a larger room with a kitchen.
Location 10 points from DL market and the square, probably 200-300m super close
Rooms are clean, comfortable, friendly staff

Beautiful hotel, polite staff, quiet and relaxing space, beautiful lake view; buffet not too many dishes but basically complete, delicious taste, luxurious space, Room equipment is not new but clean, luxurious

hotel_name: Nature Hotel - Nam Ky Khoi Nghia
review_text: Clean room, spacious, good price, the receptionists are very enthusiastic and cute, first time traveling to Da Lat, choosing this good hotel is so satisfying, will take note and support long term

The room was very clean. The hot water system was great. The room was closed so even if it was foggy outside, the room was still very warm so I slept very well. The staff were very enthusiastic. I will come back if I have the chance.

hotel_name: Ana Mandara Villas Dalat Resort & Spa
review_text: The resort is beautiful and quiet. Every morning when I wake up, the first sound I hear is the sound of birds chirping, a very relaxing healing sound. Going on weekends, there is usually a BBQ party with fresh and delicious seafood, with free hot rice paper, which is great. I have been here for the 3rd time, but every time it brings a very new feeling. The breakfast is delicious, the villas are all beautiful, and the staff are enthusiastic. Next time, I will continue to book here when I have the chance.

Baru saja melakukan perjalanan 4 hari 3 malam. Lovely staff (karyawan ramah), clean room (kamar bersih), beautiful (bagus), beautiful view (pemandangannya juga bagus). Just like the picture I booked (persis seperti yang saya pesan di gambar). Arrived at 10am to rent a car and go out to eat, at 12pm the staff called to check in early (tiba pukul 10 pagi, menyewa mobil dan pergi makan, pukul 12 siang staf menelepon untuk check-in kamar lebih awal). Going to the center and Da Lat Market is super close, just a few minutes by car (pergi ke pusat kota dan Pasar Da Lat sangat dekat, hanya beberapa menit dengan mobil). Next time I will come back (lain kali saya akan kembali). Overall a fun experience (secara keseluruhan, pengalaman yang menyenangkan).
The hotel is near the center, convenient to travel, open 24/24, lovely staff, clean and tidy rooms, very worth staying, reasonable price. Overall, very satisfied.
New hotel, clean and airy, enthusiastic and cheerful staff. Will come back when coming to Da Lat
The staff is cheerful, enthusiastic, and gives good guidance. The room is spacious, clean, and has full amenities. The price is reasonable and very suitable for families.
The hotel is super fragrant, super clean, beautifully decorated and fully equipped. The staff Han takes care of is super enthusiastic. I am very satisfied when staying at the hotel ❤️

Hotel Du Lys Dalat shines like a gentle melody in the middle of a peaceful mountain town. It offers:

• Perfect location, convenient for every step in the heart of Dalat.

• Luxurious, cozy space, harmoniously combining tradition and modernity.

• Dedicated, sophisticated service, making people's hearts calm down with the breath of the mountain town.

• Reasonable price, worthy of the experience that visitors receive.
The hotel is okay, convenient for moving anywhere in the city. But the room soundproofing is too poor, the neighboring rooms make noise, they can hear everything.

The hotel is located in Hoa Binh area, so at night you can walk around the surrounding areas and Da Lat market. Hotel interior is new, beautiful, clean. Hotel staff are polite, cute and very helpful. However, Tang Bat Ho street is a bit small and in the morning it will be quite crowded with people going to eat wet cakes, so if anyone has a car, note that this section can be a bit difficult to get a car. Hope the hotel maintains its form. I will still come back to the hotel in the upcoming vacations in Da Lat.

We arrived at 5.30 AM and the staff was welcoming and allowed us to check-in early. The room was clean and comfortable with all the amenities we needed. The hotel's location was convenient and well connected, making it easy to explore nearby attractions, restaurants, and shops. What really stood out was the staff was ever so pleasant, always ready to help with a smile. My sister and I had a wonderful 3 nights stay and would happily return on our next trip.

The staff were enthusiastic and lovely. The rooms were clean and well-equipped. The other day we arrived early and the receptionist helped us upgrade our room for free. The location is also convenient. We will definitely visit again next time.

It is a guesthouse-style accommodation that gives a comfortable, clean feeling. The rooms are spacious and the price is not expensive. I highly recommend it. It is very suitable for bringing friends to hang out here. The accommodation is not far from the mall and the city center, but we recommend using a Grab. We can walk to Crazy House and nearby local restaurants.

Very satisfied. The room was spacious, new, clean, had a sauna, and the decor and lighting were very pleasant. The staff were lovely and enthusiastic. It would be great if there was a mini heater in the room during the cold season.

The hotel is very good and quite reasonable for the price, everyone who comes to Da Lat to play, I think they should stay here, it's close to the center and quite convenient to travel, that day I arrived early and the hotel supported early check-in and didn't charge a fee, 10 VND for this delicacy. The receptionists here are very cute and enthusiastic, especially this guy named Phong is extremely cute, he even lent me his camera and edited the photos for us😘
If I have the opportunity to return to Da Lat again, I will visit here again
Room is very ok, staff is enthusiastic. Parking is a bit far so it's a bit inconvenient but overall rating 8/10
A very quiet and comfortable place, poetic scenery with many beautiful corners for you to live virtual. Clean and comfortable room
The staff helped us find a place to rent a motorbike. We were helped to order a taxi to the airport. The staff even gave me free sandals. Very kind and friendly.
The receptionist is gentle and friendly, the room is clean and fragrant

hotel_name: NATURE LAND 2 - Song Anh Hotel Dalat
review_text: When I first entered the room, I was really impressed by the layout and color of the appliances. neither too fussy nor too simple. The price I set on the app should be quite reasonable. Clean rooms. Another plus point is when I have to extend one more day, the hotel has charged the same price on the app. really great. I will definitely book this hotel on my next Dalat trip.

Highly recommend! I stayed in Room 402 for one night (July 25-26) and was thoroughly impressed. The room itself was clean, comfortable, and offered great privacy with a nice balcony. Enjoyed the smart TV and spotless, odor-free bathroom. Totally happy with my experience and will absolutely be returning.
The staff here are extremely friendly and enthusiastic, the services are convenient, comfortable, close to the center, clean rooms. Definitely recommend to family and friends
The room is very nice. Clean, beautiful pine forest view. Great receptionist. Thank you for the experience.
Friendly and lovely staff, small and pretty hotel but very comfortable and great service. The breakfast buffet is varied, delicious and suits my taste.

The resort has a beautiful view, private location suitable for relaxation.
Friendly and enthusiastic staff.
The place is spacious, the owner is enthusiastic, and even rents motorbikes. Next time visit again

New hotel, clean, modern, spacious rooms, with underground parking. Near the hotel there is a place to rent motorbikes which is quite convenient. There are also many restaurants in the surrounding area, Xuan Huong Lake is also close, the market is a bit far, about 1km.
Everything is great, from location, room, facilities, parking, breakfast. Have stayed at nice dream many times and always want to come back when coming to Da Lat

Lovely room, clean, cute decoration. I have one suggestion: Home's indoor slippers, I don't know why every one of them hurts my feet when I wear them. It looks like it's bothering its feet, those blue sandals.

The hotel is clean and the facilities are very new, the price is better than the neighboring hotels, the TV has Netflix, the location is convenient, close to the center and the night market, on the rooftop there is a restaurant with a diverse menu, reasonable price. I arrived early at 7am and planned to leave my luggage but the hotel supported early check-in, the receptionist and housekeeping staff were very friendly. Will definitely come back.
Great. Spacious room, clean, central location, with underground parking. Friendly and polite staff!

About the facilities: Everything is meticulously cared for, from the clean, comfortable bedrooms to the cozy, polite dining room. Here, I feel like home – friendly, warm and pleasant. The breakfast is simple but nutritious enough to start a new day full of energy for the journey to explore Dalat. In particular, Emily Spa: One of the great highlights at Lumina is Emily Spa. After a long day of exploring Da Lat, we were completely relaxed with body massage, hair washing, and foot massage services. The staff were very dedicated, professional, giving us moments of relaxation and comfort to recharge our energy for the new day.
